pages.body:
# Casual UI single integration validation — 2026-10-14

Scope: approved optionA includes six saved heroes and schema23. All fifteen screens are integrated: the original thirteen, character creation/selection and base HUD. The original focused plan is preparation history. Native visuals still prioritize the agreed two viewport sizes. Main merge, publication and remote push remain excluded.

## Frozen final input for fifteen screens

The integration sequence is character PR2 `b87b581b` → common `b0d4da6b` → HUD `4279440f` → preflight `f786f69e`. Source handoffs are complete; execution results and visual acceptance are recorded separately below.

Frozen HUD commit `4279440ffe823fc4e82a0a81fc4c6f94c6410d44` was locally fetched and fast-forwarded into the existing task6 integration branch. All158 handoff hashes match. No repository, Library or player copy was created. Only the15 missing repository fixture files required by full EditMode and the HUD evidence directory were added to sparse checkout. The earlier45-filter plan does not limit the final full regression.

Preflight review found two presentation defects. Every skill effect now uses frame-status with a square mask, and ultimate DPS cast markers use frame-seal with a circle. `TrainingChartView.SetCasualHudAppearance()` owns marker roles during pool reuse and layout from the actual skill definition, replacing the per-second descendant scan. Two consumer regressions cover status/regular/ultimate roles and pooled reuse.

RuntimeGlobalHudSmoke now creates its mage in the disposable account and switches the tutorial owner. GlobalHud/DamageGraph fixtures alone set legacyExempt so they enter the ordinary Rift under test. Production character/tutorial policy and real saves are unchanged. This follow-up commit, `f786f69e`, was the frozen input for the full EditMode run. Its actual result and the focused rerun status are recorded below.

[Korean source and source-head table](Casual_UI_Integration_20261014.md) · [Shared design rules](Casual_UI_Skin_Rules_20261014.en.md) · [Shared APIs](Casual_UI_Parallel_Handoff_20261014.en.md)

Save PR1 `e3809624` and followup `93219e3f` are also locally merged. The integrated source connects created D4 tabs, gender-aware save ownership, held-click cancellation after owner changes, six-slot selection and CharacterPlaza budgets. The initial CLI editor-path error occurred before Unity started; that historical attempt does not describe the later completed full EditMode run.

All thirteen frozen screen owners (tasks 8–20) are integrated into `codex/casual-ui-validation-20261014` on common `0ccba80e`. Original owner workspaces and main remain preserved. Source integration does not establish visual acceptance. Tasks12/13 use ordered owned-source cherry-picks after verifying duplicate common patch identity; other heads are merged. Task8's frozen dirty snapshot is preserved in `10ce5443` with patch/hash receipts. Portraits include N23/B06 from the complete `57bba034` tree. Equipment resources are shared without duplicate PNG copies.

Root followups connect training HUD, pause panel, result chart and skill cards to scoped skins, retaining geometry and gameplay. Development-only `-hellscriptCasualUiFocused` narrows large viewport matrices to 440×956 and 2868×1320 in KO/EN while retaining transaction, equipment, reward and save/restart assertions. The latter simulates DPR3 insets (102 left/right,54 bottom,0 top) on macOS; it is not physical-iOS evidence. Outdated fixtures follow current D4 learning/tier contracts. Approved art expectations use direct provider paths, preventing legacy fallback from passing. Result counts reflect executed cases.

`CasualImportedAssetTests` adds seven import checks for equipment359, portraits35, entry43, aspect1 and the training backdrop. The static integrated GUID audit found zero duplicates across4,764 meta files.

**One full EditMode run completed: 5,890 total, 5,869 passed, 18 failed and 3 skipped.** Process elapsed time was **7,319.615 seconds**. Actual evidence: `Builds/Validation/CasualSkillSkin/integration-ready/final15/editmode.xml` and `editmode-process.json`.

Focused history: `focused-1` 41 total / 38 passed / 3 failed (459.250s), `focused-2` 11 total / 11 passed / 0 failed (221.981s). Focused-1 covered failed methods, the missing10 CasualEdict cases and3 import checks; subsequent runs cover remaining failures only. The full suite was not repeated. The initial integrated native build succeeded once;29 jobs ran (9 passed/20 failed), and5 dependent restarts remain unexecuted because their prerequisite failed. Visual review continues. One consolidated corrective build in the same app path is authorized; original and corrected results remain separate.

Reuse one existing Library and one app output. Use new absolute disposable save paths, muted audio, one smoke entry per process and sequential runs; restart only the corresponding fixture save. Record waiting, import/compile, test, build and capture separately; rerun failed scopes only. Main merge, web builds, publication and remote pushes remain excluded.

Historical reference: an unrelated external full test took about90 minutes (5,752 total,5,748 passed,1 failed,3 skipped), with one obsolete localization-key failure. Another external40-case test passed at08:24:29Z; a separate baseline full test was still active at08:34Z. These are past observations, separate from the integration results above, and do not describe current execution, locks or resources. External processes and settings remain unchanged.

Visual acceptance still needs actual corner, KO/EN wrapping, font contrast, input and scroll checks. Remaining nested-popup/help/result-detail and non-equipment-art differences in owner handoffs are not silently considered complete. No five-column aspect layout or font-size reduction exception is approved. Evidence stays in the existing task output; `task-6/artifact-lifecycle.json` records retention. No source/cache deletion or extra project/cache copy occurred.

Historical six-slot source checks: Runtime/Editor/Tests compile0 errors, warnings89/28/43; UI contract15/15 in28.194s; refresh16/199; diff pass. Tests alone were recompiled after strengthening the pointer regression against a migration-notice false positive. Ownership, missing-class, creation, failed-save, held-input, transaction-effect, live-run and six-level cache regressions were added at that stage. Those were static checks; PR2 delivery of the41 art assets and HUD integration are now complete. Current Unity status is the full result and focused run history above. Historical static receipt: `Builds/Validation/CasualSkillSkin/dotnet/hero-slots-followup/receipt.json`.

## Repairs following the full run

Use the actual bundled Jua cmap for symbol fallback while preserving TTF bytes. Preserve the Casual HUD default512 cap and authored nine-slice borders during reimport, verified by two real reimport cases. Correct six Unity null patterns and require CanvasRenderer on two custom Graphics. Reuse the exact shield boundary; include six shortcut controls and their spacing in the layout assertion. Give landscape boss codex notes34 units instead of31 and cards85 instead of82.

Account fixtures create required heroes through normal APIs and reconcile schema22 unlocks before snapshotting, retaining exact archive/hero/guide comparisons. Recover10 CasualEdict cases by fixing an invalid GUID, with EditMode callbacks enabled only on test instances. The boss landing case retains48 arenas,384 candidates,300 seconds and all assertions while reusing one fixture per arena and reporting phase timings.

Development-player disposable fixtures follow current creation/tutorial flow. HUD position-save failures remain visible during battle. Opt-in native acceptance covers four independent fold/drag windows, failed writes and relaunch restoration, plus six seals, insufficient◆, dead/low-health and full status scrolling. Initial native results are recorded below; corrective native acceptance is still unexecuted.

The latest observed result by testcase name is **5,899 passed,0 failed,3 skipped**. The intentional skips are the authoring probes `PuzzleContentTests.Probe` and `PuzzleOperationTests.ProbeOperations`, plus `WebGlOptimizationMeasurement.Capture`, which requires its measurement environment. The boss rerun completed48/48 arenas,384/384 candidates and336 actual attacks (Generate11.213s/Fixture17.144s/Restore167.229s/Attack3.168s). The original18 failures and focused-run history remain preserved. Latest static UI contract15/15 (25.112s), refresh16 bindings/202 files and full diff checks passed.

## Initial native matrix and consolidated corrections

Source `56df1d09b5c83082fa857fcd412f211630fb344e` built successfully in68.319s (exit0, `HELLSCRIPT_BUILD Succeeded errors=0`, reported1,235,949,588B). Before/after bundle SHA256 remained `5f7d14965c74eb2b6247d80b1e098eb75cb041033771da3a73f4530e06ca8724`. Preserve `final15/build-process.json`, `native/build-freeze.json` and `native/final-build-verification.json`. One empty-URI warning came from Editor Crash Reporting symbol-upload authentication after processing; it is retained separately from game exceptions.

The29 process runs totaled464.121s:9 passed/20 failed, with5 prerequisite-blocked restarts not run. Failed jobs: `aspect, battle-order, battle-position, battle-target, blacksmith, character, codex, hud-battle-layout, hud-dps-drag, hud-global, hud-rift-activity, hud-rift-dps, inventory, jeweler, recommended-controls, rift-result-actions, rift-victory, rune, shop-layout, shop-transactions`. Every initial receipt retains its source, logs, screenshots and exit code. Automated passes do not establish visual acceptance.

Product corrections cover edict body overflow/target labels/order refresh, battle minimap and plaza edict menu occlusion, and long HUD headers. Fixtures follow current entry timing, prove a fresh disposable save before scene startup instead of using the consumed CreatedAccount flag, exclude clone RESUME events and reuse the established RestoreFidelity saved-form comparison, validate shared split equipment text/responsive panes/current chrome, and satisfy current progression/point budgets and tutorial/attendance preconditions. Transaction/save/combat/input assertions remain. Actual screenshot defects found in initially passing surfaces join the correction scope; later evidence records final outcomes.

465 whitespace-only metas and4 reviewed IDE/Unity settings were restored after preserving the exact generated patch and hashes in `post-build-source-cleanup.json`. Original art/fonts, the original frozen app and real user saves were unchanged. Do not repeat the full EditMode suite. Reuse the same Library and app output for one consolidated corrective build, then verify failed and affected scopes; never represent old-player results as corrected-player passes.

The5,899 distinct passing names are5,890−3 skips+10 recovered cases+2 new cases. The new cases are `BuildResourceTests.CasualHudPanelsKeepAuthoredBordersAcrossReimport("panel-cream",26)` and `("panel-white",40)`, not duplicate counts.


## Consolidated correction preflight and legacy puzzle removal

After inspecting the initial player and pixels, layout/localization and fixture corrections were consolidated. Runtime/Editor/Tests compiled with0 errors and0 warnings in changed files; UI contract15/15 (22.77s), refresh16 bindings and diff checks passed. focused-3 ran7 affected fixtures: **89/89 passed**,62.418s process/14.198s tests. The full suite was not repeated. These89 existing names are reruns, not additional unique passes. Corrective player results will be recorded separately.

The legacy puzzle tutorial is **not yet removed from this branch**. Local Git shows removal66c2e59b, retirement note f0d39b1f and PR #132 merge bbe131de on local origin/main, but not as ancestors of integration baseline56df1d09 (common ancestor53d6a3e1). The removal lineage has not yet been integrated; there is no evidence this UI work reverted the decision. Full XML includes299 cases from7 puzzle classes plus TutorialPitTests (297 passed/2 authoring skips), including6 actual boss/three-wave final-trial cases. The first native size report lists31 puzzle packed assets/29,223,340 bytes. General boss leap/burrow regression and current new-account/onboarding are distinct. No broad tutorial deletion or test-only exclusion is performed. **Completion requires checking actual main HEAD after the parent merge**, including removal ancestry, runtime/review entry points, dedicated tests/assets and build registration. Latest remote main and post-merge confirmation remain unexecuted; no push or main merge was performed.

## Corrective player result and follow-up freeze preparation

The corrective macOS Development build from `75f2d5e5e79a3832a12f8a66351c8896dbe04a27` passed in67.999s/exit0. Before/after bundle SHA256 remained `a37e91aebcb85624e505b20672e68c8d3095f26f900770d36d737febc0e7f8c4`. Thirty jobs ran:15 passed/15 failed;4 dependent restarts were not run. Summed process time was669.818s. Canonical evidence is `final15/corrective/build-process.json`, `corrective/native/<job>/receipt.json` and `final-build-verification.json`. These observations do not establish passes for subsequently modified source.

Product fixes settle rotated HUD bounds before edict-camera placement, stop treating the upper-right edict as a full-width bottom inset for recommendation cards, reserve a rendered text line for status timers/stacks, inset minimap captions, measure repeat shortcuts after final font assignment, restore the entry close glyph and restore class focus when reselecting the same hero. Fixtures follow current guide/attendance/unlock preconditions, actual HoldPress input and shared split equipment text. Transaction/save/combat/input assertions and original art/fonts/GUIDs remain. The final character-click cause is still unconfirmed; the next player retains exact raycast diagnostics and waits for render readiness.

The old Rune empty-black ratio assumes a dark well. Keep every original predicate on the same-board/same-coordinate/same-crop dark control, then require unchanged occupied RGB8 pixels, existing absolute/bright-glyph predicates and non-regressing dim/empty colour separation on the approved Casual well. No arbitrary threshold or golden derived from the current failure was introduced. Restore the well in finally. Native validation of this new paired contract remains pending until the rebuilt player runs.

`focused-4` ran only6 affected fixtures: **100/100 passed**,54.796s process/10.002s tests. It includes one new case, `CharacterSelectionTests.ChoosingTheSelectedHeroRestoresItsClassAfterCrestBrowsingWithoutSaving`. The exact-fullname union of historical observations is **5,900 passed/0 failed/3 skipped**, not a repeated full suite on the final source. The Rune smoke-only contract added after this run is outside those6 fixtures. Full EditMode was not repeated.

The follow-up native selection contains25 jobs:15 prior failures,4 blocked restarts and6 affected passes (entry/restart, HUD scale, independent-window drag/restart, responsive shop layout). Retain9 unrelated prior passes with their original source/app receipts. Freeze the final source and consolidate necessary changes into one build using the existing Library and app output. Record new execution/pixel acceptance separately; actual-main UI integration and legacy-puzzle retirement confirmation remain pending.

The final group passed static Runtime/Editor/Tests compilation with0 errors (existing warnings90/28/43), UI contract15/15 (22.29s), refresh16 bindings and diff checks. One inventory-smoke missing-argument error in the first static attempt was corrected and revalidated. Receipt: task23 `validation/native-followup-static-3/receipt.json`.


## Follow-up player and final acceptance corrections

Source `412c54fbd7e4e193704965e4cb29becd8509a58d` built successfully in70.965s/exit0. Before/after bundle SHA256 remained `6d3289e7e8e9b064d57b062ecd9b7cc9485ef40bde70c08d5a97a664631740d3`. Of25 selected jobs,24 ran:16 passed/8 failed, and1 prerequisite-dependent restart was unexecuted; summed process time703.986s. Preserve original receipts/PNGs under `final15/followup/native`. A separate canonical Rune-fixture run passed all10 sections and paired pixel predicates but failed overall because English values retained `/초`; it is not counted as a pass.

The final batch reacquires committed inventory items after the review transaction and translates Rune units through existing keys. Edict rail captions retain their font/hit row while measuring wrapped height. HUD fold controls retain44pt hit targets with centred30/26/22pt round faces. Fixtures inspect the actual WorldView health bars, current gamble unlock, render-ready character start button and current result-divider structure. Recommendation controls retain the default full end-run flow and create a separate live-run checkpoint for actual restart coverage. No assertion relaxation or real-save access.

The Rune clarity authority is `Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Tests/Fixtures/RuneNativeClarity.json` (SHA256 `affacf7fb7f15257a45aa773bbf67f2718e7a6bf065ad5bd0b8e820774bd3477`). The previous integration fixture has different unlocks/crop coordinates and must not be mixed with it. Same-board dark-control comparison, approved Casual well and existing absolute pixel predicates remain.

`focused-5` ran only the new inventory2/Rune2/round-button1 cases plus affected button/store-binding checks: **40/40 passed**,48.726s process/7.913s tests. The exact-testcase-name historical union is **5,905 passed/0 failed/3 skipped**, not another full suite on final HEAD. Full EditMode remains one invocation. The later caption-guard correction excludes the empty factory label and receives fresh static compilation.

Final native acceptance will reuse the existing Library and app output for one consolidated build and failed/affected input, KO/EN, rotation and restart checks, recorded separately. These source changes do not yet establish a new-player pass. Parent post-merge verification of actual-main UI ancestry and legacy-puzzle retirement remains pending and distinct from integrated UI acceptance.

## Acceptance player results and text clarity repair

The `d2206cd3f60458620f0440a04cb5d77784c4be02` build succeeded in68.276s/exit0. Before/after bundle SHA256 was `5aaf2e0590dd269152816476cbfbd71d4e327521b183e64b3881ceaf633e6f0d`. All19 selected jobs ran:17passed,2failed,0unexecuted; summed process time662.097s. `final15/acceptance/native` preserves the receipts. Target selection omitted the real scroll before clicking an obscured row; shop verification rejected the correct shared atlas for B03, which has no dedicated artwork. The fixture repairs perform real wheel scrolling and require full-row visibility before the original raycast input, and retain purchased identity, actual artwork/UV, transaction and save assertions for the atlas path.

Actual PNG review found blurred small character text from font generation at the parent Canvas density before enlargement, overflowing English rune minimap names, and hard-to-read region names on the dark board. The character page now owns an independent Canvas density through the common construction helper, preserving font family, font size, color, screen coordinates and44px hit bounds. Existing content windows retain their construction, stack and input behavior. Rune minimap names wrap at the same font size with one physical pixel of horizontal inset inside the original control. Region names use the approved light, non-input label background. No artwork, fonts, meta files or GUIDs were added or changed.

The focused-6 nested Canvas diagnostic candidate failed3cases and was rejected without applying that approach to the product. focused-7 lost its process and produced no XML after disconnection; its evidence is preserved as `interrupted-incomplete`, never inferred as passing from log lines. focused-8 completed48cases:44passed and4failed in45.679s. Character density3 and shared UI/Store39passed; only rune glyph bounds failed4cases. After the rune inset repair, focused-9 ran only the5distinct density cases of that method:5/5passed in35.007s, test time0.429s. The full EditMode suite was not repeated. These observations are not a full-suite run at the final SHA.

Final static Runtime/Editor/Tests compilation has0errors (existing warnings90/28/43), UI contract15/15 in22.59s, refresh16 and diff checks passed (`task23/validation/visual-repair-static-3/receipt.json`). An independent source review covered common Canvas construction equivalence, ownership and the7-job native selection. One consolidated repair build will reuse the same Library and app path for target/shop/character/rune/inventory/victory/victory-resume. Source, static and EditMode results here do not claim that new player has passed. Parent verification of UI and retired-puzzle ancestry on actual merged main remains pending.

## Clarity player results and remaining native bounds

The `06d105ffe6134e6f40846d8f816703e3452ef0c4` build succeeded in62.584s/exit0 with all1,189 static input hashes unchanged. Bundle SHA256 `9313f1d6e55c848ed6df47eafcba6b145c0ba1908ff02a7dcd30ba16393579a8` also matched before/after verification. Seven selected jobs completed:4passed,3failed,0unexecuted; summed process time189.695s. Character/shop transactions/victory/victory-resume passed; target/rune/inventory failed. Original receipts remain in `final15/visual-repair/native`. Character26PNG hashes and direct review of five representative images confirm the small-text blur was repaired;205,275 gear-popup body pixels are identical to the prior player. The separate task23 review distinguishes static font/size/color preservation, real input assertions and viewed-image scope.

The target endpoint `30 seconds` did not fit its fixed50u width. The integration owner applies a narrow exception in `GameUI.EdictTarget.TargetNumber`: divide the existing endpoint lane below the slider into left/right halves. A broad EdictText postprocessor would affect other protected screens. Original14u height, fonts, sizes, aligned endpoints, wording, numeric ranges, save path and clipping assertions remain unchanged. The original file protection and this explicitly scoped integration acceptance repair are documented separately.

Rune glyphs could fit their individual buttons while an outer button protruded beyond the minimap panel. The old fixed240-source-unit padding is replaced with the actual unchanged button radius plus one physical pixel so all seven centers and controls fit the same panel. Hit sizes, text sizes, colors, wrapping and assertions remain. The five-density regression now checks seven controls and actual glyph bounds against the full panel in both locales and orientations.

Inventory cancel callbacks and review-plan construction do not save or consume items directly. However, active GameController plaza autosave every3seconds can update lastSeenUtc/Revision during the capture between whole-account snapshots. The failed job did not retain before/after dumps, so its exact differing field is unconfirmed. Only the selection/review/cancel section suspends controller Update and restores it in finally. EventSystem/UI handlers and the full JSON equality remain; unchanged Revision and failure snapshot dumps are added. Product cancel code is unchanged.

The four-source repair passes Runtime/Editor/Tests compilation with actual Unity references and0errors, UI contract15/15 in21.87s, refresh16 and diff checks (`task23/validation/remaining-native-static-2/receipt.json`). A direct internal-helper access error in the first static attempt was corrected to a private reflection test. New-player success will be recorded at its own build input; the full EditMode suite is not repeated.

focused-10 passed the same five strengthened testcase names:5/5 in35.343s. It adds0new identities; latest-name observations remain5,913passed/0failed/3skipped.

## Final integration verification handoff

The final player input is `49c08e20126179bc6d385e1bde2df653c29197ad`. The existing Library and `Builds/Validation/CasualSkillSkin/HELLSCRIPT.app` path were reused; build61.653s/exit0. All1,189 static inputs matched before/after the build. Bundle SHA256 `6ccb286b046cbc260330f2d0724e863aab5f13db39973767197c393f433e25d1` matched before/after the three jobs. Target/rune/inventory passed3/3,0unexecuted, summed process time124.346s. Original receipts, PNGs and `final-build-verification.json` remain in `final15/remaining-repair/native`. Earlier failed receipts were not overwritten.

Latest actual observations across35job identities are35passed/0failed/0blocked-unexecuted. Three ran on this final player;32unchanged consumers retain their prior-source passing receipts. Source SHA, bundle SHA and receipt hashes are recorded in task23 `integration-acceptance-final.json` and `remaining-repair-native-selection.json`. This does not claim all35ran again at the final SHA. Character clarity was accepted from the previous player's26hashed PNGs and five directly compared views; final target endpoints and English rune visuals are reviewed on this player. Rune passed10sections, paired clarity and actual panel-bound assertions. Inventory passed whole-account/Revision cancel immutability, input, transactions and persistence.

The full EditMode suite ran once (original5,890:5,869passed/18failed/3skipped); relevant focused tests resolved the failures. Latest exact-name observations are5,913passed/0failed/3skipped, not a full-suite run at final input. Rejected focused-6 diagnostics, interrupted focused-7 and historical failures remain separate. Static Runtime/Editor/Tests have0errors, UI contract15/15, refresh16 and diff passed. Native history includes one initial common build plus five authorized necessary consolidated repair builds, six total at the same app path and Library, summed process time399.796s. No per-screen/web build or project/Library clone was made.

Generated build residue (465whitespace-only meta files and four reviewed settings) was backed with exact patches/hashes and restored to clean source. Editor UDS shutdown and empty symbol-upload URI diagnostics remain in original logs and the task23 classification report, separate from gated player exceptions/font/assertion results. Actual user-save access, original art/font/GUID changes, permanent deletion, purchases/auto-recharge and push/main merge are0. Runs used muted/offline disposable fixtures and macOS Development synthetic input; physical mobile testing is not claimed.

Execution connectivity is recovered and no known failure remains in this integrated UI acceptance scope. **Parent verification of UI and retired-puzzle ancestry, runtime entry/replay, dedicated tests and resources/build registrations on actual merged main remains pending.** This thread neither duplicated nor marked that followup complete. Online design loading timed out in the prior handoff; local approved references and actual PNG review were used. Measured artifact sizes and retention reasons are retained in task6 `artifact-lifecycle.json`.

## Local main merge and puzzle retirement verification completed

Following the user's cancellation of the web build, authorization to merge into main, and request to verify puzzle removal afterward, integration is now on local main. pages.body:
# Casual art concept switch (2026-10-13)

Updated: 2026-10-14

[한국어](Casual_Art_Concept_20261013.md)

## Decisions

- The art concept moves from dark gothic to a **bright, cute, casual medieval fantasy for ages 12+**. UI, combat, saves, screen structure and the game's setting stay; only art changes.
- No player-facing option that keeps both concepts: the switch goes one way, and the current state stays reachable through a tag/branch on `main`.
- Playable heroes become **six**: male and female warrior, mage and archer.
- Of four candidate styles (chunky brawler / angular / comic-ink cel / shonen chibi) the user chose **D "shonen-manga chibi"**: Toriyama (Dragon Quest) plus Cookie Run: Kingdom attitude, 3.5-4 heads tall, rounded bodies with sharp accents (spiky hair, sharp eyes, a small fang).
- Rendering is two-step cel shading (flat colour plus one hard shadow tone), an even outline and matte materials. Shapes stay buildable at about 6,000 triangles and a 512 px texture per character so Hunyuan3D output can be used with minimal processing.

## Files

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| [title_key_art_v05_styleD.png](title_key_art_v05_styleD.png) | Title key art; the top 40% is left open for the logo |
| [battle_encircled_v02_styleD.png](battle_encircled_v02_styleD.png) | Heroes surrounded on a rift battlefield, ready for battle; monsters follow the roster families (skeleton, corpse, thornhorn, spider, drowned, wraith, fanatic, hell minion) |
| [Characters/sheet_1_warrior_m.png](Characters/sheet_1_warrior_m.png) | Male warrior model sheet: front / three-quarter / side / back A-pose, three expressions, weapon and shield |
| [Characters/sheet_2_warrior_f.png](Characters/sheet_2_warrior_f.png) | Female warrior model sheet |
| [Characters/sheet_3_mage_m.png](Characters/sheet_3_mage_m.png) | Male mage model sheet |
| [Characters/sheet_4_mage_f.png](Characters/sheet_4_mage_f.png) | Female mage model sheet |
| [Characters/sheet_5_archer_m.png](Characters/sheet_5_archer_m.png) | Male archer model sheet |
| [Characters/sheet_6_archer_f.png](Characters/sheet_6_archer_f.png) | Female archer model sheet |

Each image sits next to its request prompt (`PROMPT_*.md`) and a manifest (`manifest_*.json`) with the source path, SHA-256 and size. Earlier drafts (v01-v04, the A-D style comparison and the first line-up) were deleted at the user's request.

## How they were made

- Generated with the Codex CLI built-in `image_gen` (`codex exec -m gpt-6-astra`); every PNG is a byte-for-byte copy of the generated original. The tool does not report a model name, so each manifest records `unknown`, and like the other Codex art these are not yet approved for release.
- The six model sheets came from six parallel runs. The identity reference was the style-D line-up from the comparison round, and each sheet prompt describes its hero in words.

## Hunyuan 3D test (male warrior)

The front view of the male warrior sheet ([HunyuanInput/warrior_m_front.png](Characters/HunyuanInput/warrior_m_front.png)) went through Hunyuan3D (hy3d.tencent.ai) Image-to-3D V3.1. The user uploaded it by hand in the in-app browser; the face count was 1.5M (50k was intended, but the denser source only helps the bake). The 80.3 MB textured GLB and the preview live outside git in `AssetDeliverables/Hunyuan/2026-10-13/heroes/`; `tools/hunyuan_monster_ready.py --id HW01 --archetype Biped --height 1.8` baked the game tier (6,000 / 3,000 / 1,500 triangles, 512 px A, C, N, ORM) and auto-rigged it. Every QA gate passed (91 s).

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| [warrior_m_preview.png](Characters/HunyuanTest/warrior_m_preview.png) | Hunyuan render preview (512 px) |
| [warrior_m_HW01_contact_sheet.png](Characters/HunyuanTest/warrior_m_HW01_contact_sheet.png) | Game-tier LOD0 contact sheet: front, side, back, the 49-degree game view, walk, windup and strike poses |
| [warrior_m_hunyuan_test.json](Characters/HunyuanTest/warrior_m_hunyuan_test.json) | Creation id, face counts, source hashes, QA gate values |

Conclusion: the style-D traits (spiky hair, fang grin, blue scarf, star shield) still read at 6,000 triangles and 512 px. The monster pivot rig replaced the right leg bone with a template and the windup pose shows a stretched shard above the head, so heroes need a humanoid rig before they go into the game. Device performance and the licence (`productionApproved: false`) are unverified.

### Second pass: weapon-free input and hand capture

In the first result the low-held sword came back as a floating blade fused to the model, and the sword and shield tore in the walk pose. The game swaps weapons and gear, so hero inputs carry no sword or shield (equipment looks and the plain base outfit come later with the presentation work; the armoured look stays for now). Codex drew an empty-handed front A-pose ([warrior_m_front_noweapon.png](Characters/HunyuanInput/warrior_m_front_noweapon.png)), regenerated at 50k faces ([preview](Characters/HunyuanTest/warrior_m_noweapon_preview.png)).

Baked with the same tool every gate passes ([HW02](Characters/HunyuanTest/warrior_m_noweapon_HW02_contact_sheet.png)) but the fingers come off in the walk pose. Cause: heat weighting gave the finger vertices hanging beside the thighs to the hips, thigh and chest bones (about 35% of the vertices below the right wrist). `tools/hunyuan_monster_ready.py` gained `--hand-capture`, which gives every vertex within 16% of the height past the wrist along the forearm and within 8% of that axis (fingers curled forward included) to the hand bone. The re-bake [HW03](Characters/HunyuanTest/warrior_m_noweapon_HW03_handcapture_contact_sheet.png) keeps the hands on the arms in the walk, windup and strike poses. Without the option existing monster outputs are unchanged. Left over: a scarf shard stretching above the shoulder in the windup. Gear swapping needs one humanoid skeleton shared by every hero, so this rig is a preview only.

## Town concept

The current dark town redrawn bright in the same style. Layout and facilities are unchanged (cross-shaped roads, the rift gateway at the crossroads, warehouse, weapon stall, stone well, blacksmith and the four-dummy training ground in the north, the rune altar by the warehouse, four shops in the south, lanterns, fences and trees).

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| [town_overview_gameview_v01.png](Town/town_overview_gameview_v01.png) | The whole town from the game camera (about 50 degrees down), following the current layout |
| [town_plaza_eyelevel_v01.png](Town/town_plaza_eyelevel_v01.png) | Eye-level key art of the central plaza |

## Character selection mockup

Each class now has two genders, so the selection screen becomes: **pick a class, then pick a gender (male / female)**, then enter the game. There is no nickname field (it is created later, in a tutorial once the player has progressed). Design canvas: https://claude.ai/artifact/K17toUvjigyghBaRN1A8D4 (25 boards: portrait / landscape / PC × KO / EN, class and gender states, preparing, entering, active rift).

- The composition follows the current selection screen (`Docs/Implementation/Character_Selection.en.md`): back to title, motion and language buttons, heading, three heroes (the chosen one steps forward, the others step back), class buttons, details, START and the hint line. New: **two gender buttons** and six hero illustrations. Switching gender switches all three heroes to that gender.
- The details show three signature skills of the class (icons and names from the skill tree data).
- With a rift in progress, only that character can be chosen, as before; class and gender are both fixed and the rest show as locked.
- Copy reuses the existing strings (battle stance, entering the sanctuary, class taglines); the heading, subtitle, gender labels and "Entering…" are new proposals.
- Art: `CharacterSelect/hero_<class>_<gender>.png`, six 1024×1536 images with transparent backgrounds generated by Codex, plus the bright sanctuary courtyard `selection_courtyard_casual.png` (1536×1024). Prompts and manifests sit beside them. The tool does not report a model name (`unknown`); not yet approved for release. One hero (the female warrior) touches the top edge with her hair.
- Open: how existing saved characters (per-class level) should appear, and whether one account may hold several class-gender combinations.
- Superseded by "Character create/select screen: town scene" below.

## Character create/select screen: town scene (2026-10-14)

After login, creating a character and choosing one to enter with happen on the same screen. It is a homage to the Dungeons & Dragons arcade games: the party hanging out in town before setting off. Design canvas: https://claude.ai/artifact/M43Cy6wg7BJUqpKxofu21M (28 boards: 11 portrait, 12 landscape, 5 PC, Korean and English).

- The scene is a market street. On the tavern terrace in front, the male warrior downs a wooden tankard and the female warrior sits on a barrel with a drumstick. At the fruit stall in the middle, the male ranger haggles over an apple and the female ranger holds a melon and a basket. At the magic shop by the fountain in the back, the male mage reads an old book and the female mage inspects a potion. No hero holds a weapon.
- The first attempt (heroes lined up on an empty plaza, each carrying a prop) was rejected as unnatural. The rebuild starts from one painted scene in which every hero does something believable in a believable place.
- Landscape and PC show the whole scene on one screen. Portrait uses the same scene recomposed tall. The crests on the right (mage, ranger, warrior from top to bottom) move the camera to that class's pair and zoom in; farther rows zoom in more, so the move reads as a dolly into the street.
- The portrait crests are 65 px round buttons with the same ink outline as the other buttons, placed at the middle of the screen height 112 px apart; the focused class gets a class-coloured ring and glow. The per-class camera framing was shifted left so the crests never cover a hero.
- Unselected heroes are desaturated so they look inactive. Tapping one restores its colour and adds a white outline with a class-coloured glow, plus a class name tag at its feet.
- A hero that has never been played shows a + above its head. Tapping it plays a 1.8-second cheer pose on the spot with a line that fits the hero's personality, then the hero returns to its pose and Lv.1 plus a person icon appear above the head. The person icon opens the equipped-gear popup (8 slots: weapon, head, chest, hands, feet, belt, amulet, ring).
- Choosing a created hero shows the Play button at the bottom centre. Pressing it switches the hero to a battle-ready pose holding the equipped weapon (warrior sword, ranger bow, mage crystal staff) with a line, then to the entering state. While a rift is in progress only that hero can be chosen and the rest show as locked, as before.

Lines (new copy proposals; they become localization keys in the game):

| Hero | Created (cheer) | Entering (battle-ready) |
|---|---|---|
| Male warrior | 좋아, 한판 붙어 보자고! / Alright, let's brawl! | 다 덤벼라! 앞장은 내가 선다! / Come at me! I'll lead the charge! |
| Female warrior | 배도 채웠겠다, 덤벼! / Belly's full. Bring it on! | 몸 다 풀렸어. 전부 날려 줄게! / All warmed up. I'll send them flying! |
| Male ranger | 흥정 끝! 이제 사냥 시간이야. / Deal's done. Hunting time! | 한 발이면 충분하지! / One shot's all I need! |
| Female ranger | 조용히, 확실하게. 따라와. / Quiet and sure. Follow me. | 숨 고르고… 놓치지 않아. / Breathe… I won't miss. |
| Male mage | 책에 다 나와 있었다고! / It was all in the book! | 계산 끝. 불꽃 맛 좀 봐라! / Calculations done. Taste the flames! |
| Female mage | 반짝반짝, 마법 시작이야! / Sparkle sparkle, magic time! | 자, 마법 쇼를 시작해 볼까? / Shall we start the magic show? |
- Example account in the mockup: male warrior Lv.24, female ranger Lv.17, female mage Lv.31 (rift in progress); the other three are not created yet.
- This screen has no motion or language buttons. In the game the motion is always on and the language is changed in Settings (user decision, 2026-10-14); the two buttons on the current selection screen go away when the new screen is built.

How it was made:

- Codex painted the scene with the heroes in it as one picture. For landscape, the better of two candidates (larger heroes, more depth) was chosen; portrait was recomposed with the landscape scene as reference. Codex edits also produced clean plates without the heroes (`clean_*.png`).
- The hero layers are the scene's own pixels, cut out with macOS Vision subject lifting (`VNGenerateForegroundInstanceMaskRequest`, [tools/lift.swift](CharacterPlaza/tools/lift.swift)). They sit exactly over the painted heroes, so the selected and inactive looks match the painting. During the cheer, a piece of the clean plate hides the painted hero and a weapon-free full-body cheer pose (Codex) stands in its place. Crop boxes and seed points are in [tools/spec_*.json](CharacterPlaza/tools/spec_landscape.json); the processing script is [tools/prep_scene.py](CharacterPlaza/tools/prep_scene.py). The first pass clipped the ranger hoods and the portrait female mage's hat tip, which cut the outline. The script now grows a crop side the cut-out touches and lifts again, keeps only the part connected to the seed point, and gives pixels claimed by two heroes to the nearer one; a passer-by touching the portrait female mage is removed with an exclusion box.
- The lifting and patching are mockup processing. They differ from the game asset rule (native alpha only), so the game will rebuild this screen with the 3D heroes and animations.

| File | Content |
|---|---|
| [scene_landscape.png](CharacterPlaza/scene_landscape.png) | Town scene for landscape and PC (1536×1024) |
| [scene_portrait.png](CharacterPlaza/scene_portrait.png) | Town scene for portrait (1024×1536) |
| [clean_landscape.png](CharacterPlaza/clean_landscape.png) · [clean_portrait.png](CharacterPlaza/clean_portrait.png) | Clean plates without the heroes (for the cheer) |
| [cheer_warrior_m.png](CharacterPlaza/cheer_warrior_m.png) and 5 more | Each hero's cheer pose (transparent background) |
| [fight_warrior_m.png](CharacterPlaza/fight_warrior_m.png) and 5 more | Each hero's battle-ready pose with the equipped weapon (transparent background). The first male ranger request ("aiming the bow") was blocked by the Codex safety filter, so he was redrawn holding the bow with a thumbs-up |
| [crests.png](CharacterPlaza/crests.png) | The three class crests (warrior, ranger, mage) |

Each picture sits beside its prompt (`PROMPT_*.md`) and manifest. `PROMPT_cheer_*.md` also describes a prop pose requested in the same run; those pictures were dropped with the first attempt. The tool does not report a model name (`unknown`); not yet approved for release.

Open:

- The male warrior's tankard stays (user decision, 2026-10-14).
- The gear popup icons are still the old dark style.
- The portrait mage framing is zoomed 1.2× and slightly soft.
- The NPCs in the scene (fruit-seller, magic shop keeper, one passer-by) are not selectable.
- Checked only as static renders in local Chrome; the live behaviour inside the canvas and real devices were not checked.

## Open items

- Build the other five heroes the same way; decide the image hand-off first (manual upload, the Chrome extension's upload tool, or base64 injection), because the in-app browser cannot upload files.
- A humanoid hero rig and the player-model swap are separate tasks.
- The in-flight dark-gothic 3D overhaul and the daily monster routine conflict with the new concept and need a continue/stop/keep decision.
- The female warrior's midriff outfit needs a 12+ rating check.
- A mild depth-of-field blur remains on the foreground imps in the battle scene after two regenerations.

Baked with the same tool every gate passes (HW02) but the fingers come off in the walk pose. Cause: heat weighting gave the finger vertices hanging beside the thighs to the hips, thigh and chest bones (about 35% of the vertices below the right wrist). tools/hunyuan_monster_ready.py gained --hand-capture, which gives every vertex within 16% of the height past the wrist along the forearm and within 8% of that axis (fingers curled forward included) to the hand bone. The re-bake HW03 keeps the hands on the arms in the walk, windup and strike poses. Without the option existing monster outputs are unchanged. Left over: a scarf shard stretching above the shoulder in the windup. Gear swapping needs one humanoid skeleton shared by every hero, so this rig is a preview only.

Town concept

The current dark town redrawn bright in the same style. Layout and facilities are unchanged (cross-shaped roads, the rift gateway at the crossroads, warehouse, weapon stall, stone well, blacksmith and the four-dummy training ground in the north, the rune altar by the warehouse, four shops in the south, lanterns, fences and trees).

town_overview_gameview_v01.pngThe whole town from the game camera (about 50 degrees down), following the current layout
town_plaza_eyelevel_v01.pngEye-level key art of the central plaza

Character selection mockup

Each class now has two genders, so the selection screen becomes: pick a class, then pick a gender (male / female), then enter the game. There is no nickname field (it is created later, in a tutorial once the player has progressed). Design canvas: https://claude.ai/artifact/K17toUvjigyghBaRN1A8D4 (25 boards: portrait / landscape / PC × KO / EN, class and gender states, preparing, entering, active rift).

  • The composition follows the current selection screen (Docs/Implementation/Character_Selection.en.md): back to title, motion and language buttons, heading, three heroes (the chosen one steps forward, the others step back), class buttons, details, START and the hint line. New: two gender buttons and six hero illustrations. Switching gender switches all three heroes to that gender.
  • The details show three signature skills of the class (icons and names from the skill tree data).
  • With a rift in progress, only that character can be chosen, as before; class and gender are both fixed and the rest show as locked.
  • Copy reuses the existing strings (battle stance, entering the sanctuary, class taglines); the heading, subtitle, gender labels and "Entering…" are new proposals.
  • Art: CharacterSelect/hero_<class>_<gender>.png, six 1024×1536 images with transparent backgrounds generated by Codex, plus the bright sanctuary courtyard selection_courtyard_casual.png (1536×1024). Prompts and manifests sit beside them. The tool does not report a model name (unknown); not yet approved for release. One hero (the female warrior) touches the top edge with her hair.
  • Open: how existing saved characters (per-class level) should appear, and whether one account may hold several class-gender combinations.
  • Superseded by "Character create/select screen: town scene" below.

Character create/select screen: town scene (2026-10-14)

After login, creating a character and choosing one to enter with happen on the same screen. It is a homage to the Dungeons & Dragons arcade games: the party hanging out in town before setting off. Design canvas: https://claude.ai/artifact/M43Cy6wg7BJUqpKxofu21M (28 boards: 11 portrait, 12 landscape, 5 PC, Korean and English).

  • The scene is a market street. On the tavern terrace in front, the male warrior downs a wooden tankard and the female warrior sits on a barrel with a drumstick. At the fruit stall in the middle, the male ranger haggles over an apple and the female ranger holds a melon and a basket. At the magic shop by the fountain in the back, the male mage reads an old book and the female mage inspects a potion. No hero holds a weapon.
  • The first attempt (heroes lined up on an empty plaza, each carrying a prop) was rejected as unnatural. The rebuild starts from one painted scene in which every hero does something believable in a believable place.
  • Landscape and PC show the whole scene on one screen. Portrait uses the same scene recomposed tall. The crests on the right (mage, ranger, warrior from top to bottom) move the camera to that class's pair and zoom in; farther rows zoom in more, so the move reads as a dolly into the street.
  • The portrait crests are 65 px round buttons with the same ink outline as the other buttons, placed at the middle of the screen height 112 px apart; the focused class gets a class-coloured ring and glow. The per-class camera framing was shifted left so the crests never cover a hero.
  • Unselected heroes are desaturated so they look inactive. Tapping one restores its colour and adds a white outline with a class-coloured glow, plus a class name tag at its feet.
  • A hero that has never been played shows a + above its head. Tapping it plays a 1.8-second cheer pose on the spot with a line that fits the hero's personality, then the hero returns to its pose and Lv.1 plus a person icon appear above the head. The person icon opens the equipped-gear popup (8 slots: weapon, head, chest, hands, feet, belt, amulet, ring).
  • Choosing a created hero shows the Play button at the bottom centre. Pressing it switches the hero to a battle-ready pose holding the equipped weapon (warrior sword, ranger bow, mage crystal staff) with a line, then to the entering state. While a rift is in progress only that hero can be chosen and the rest show as locked, as before.

Lines (new copy proposals; they become localization keys in the game):

Male warrior좋아, 한판 붙어 보자고! / Alright, let's brawl!다 덤벼라! 앞장은 내가 선다! / Come at me! I'll lead the charge!
Female warrior배도 채웠겠다, 덤벼! / Belly's full. Bring it on!몸 다 풀렸어. 전부 날려 줄게! / All warmed up. I'll send them flying!
Male ranger흥정 끝! 이제 사냥 시간이야. / Deal's done. Hunting time!한 발이면 충분하지! / One shot's all I need!
Female ranger조용히, 확실하게. 따라와. / Quiet and sure. Follow me.숨 고르고… 놓치지 않아. / Breathe… I won't miss.
Male mage책에 다 나와 있었다고! / It was all in the book!계산 끝. 불꽃 맛 좀 봐라! / Calculations done. Taste the flames!
Female mage반짝반짝, 마법 시작이야! / Sparkle sparkle, magic time!자, 마법 쇼를 시작해 볼까? / Shall we start the magic show?
  • Example account in the mockup: male warrior Lv.24, female ranger Lv.17, female mage Lv.31 (rift in progress); the other three are not created yet.
  • This screen has no motion or language buttons. In the game the motion is always on and the language is changed in Settings (user decision, 2026-10-14); the two buttons on the current selection screen go away when the new screen is built.

How it was made:

  • Codex painted the scene with the heroes in it as one picture. For landscape, the better of two candidates (larger heroes, more depth) was chosen; portrait was recomposed with the landscape scene as reference. Codex edits also produced clean plates without the heroes (clean_*.png).
  • The hero layers are the scene's own pixels, cut out with macOS Vision subject lifting (VNGenerateForegroundInstanceMaskRequest, tools/lift.swift). They sit exactly over the painted heroes, so the selected and inactive looks match the painting. During the cheer, a piece of the clean plate hides the painted hero and a weapon-free full-body cheer pose (Codex) stands in its place. Crop boxes and seed points are in tools/spec_*.json; the processing script is tools/prep_scene.py. The first pass clipped the ranger hoods and the portrait female mage's hat tip, which cut the outline. The script now grows a crop side the cut-out touches and lifts again, keeps only the part connected to the seed point, and gives pixels claimed by two heroes to the nearer one; a passer-by touching the portrait female mage is removed with an exclusion box.
  • The lifting and patching are mockup processing. They differ from the game asset rule (native alpha only), so the game will rebuild this screen with the 3D heroes and animations.

crests.pngThe three class crests (warrior, ranger, mage)

Each picture sits beside its prompt (PROMPT_.md) and manifest. PROMPT_cheer_.md also describes a prop pose requested in the same run; those pictures were dropped with the first attempt. The tool does not report a model name (unknown); not yet approved for release.

Open:

  • The male warrior's tankard stays (user decision, 2026-10-14).
  • The gear popup icons are still the old dark style.
  • The portrait mage framing is zoomed 1.2× and slightly soft.
  • The NPCs in the scene (fruit-seller, magic shop keeper, one passer-by) are not selectable.
  • Checked only as static renders in local Chrome; the live behaviour inside the canvas and real devices were not checked.

Open items

  • Build the other five heroes the same way; decide the image hand-off first (manual upload, the Chrome extension's upload tool, or base64 injection), because the in-app browser cannot upload files.
  • A humanoid hero rig and the player-model swap are separate tasks.
  • The in-flight dark-gothic 3D overhaul and the daily monster routine conflict with the new concept and need a continue/stop/keep decision.
  • The female warrior's midriff outfit needs a 12+ rating check.
  • A mild depth-of-field blur remains on the foreground imps in the battle scene after two regenerations.

pages.summary: 원본의 정책·구현 범위와 검증 내용을 보존합니다.
pages.body:
# Casual artwork follow-up — 2026-10-16

48 new painted assets replace overly simple artwork: 32 boss actions, 10 rune surfaces, five rune controls and one hunt restart. Equivalent approved paintings also replace legacy button and portrait bindings. Six clipping masks remain technical resources. The existing training-yard painting passed visual review and is retained.

97 old PNGs and 97 meta files (55,478,468 bytes) were removed recoverably in Git. The 1,109 protected current-art paths, six current plaza identities and real saves remain protected. Two unused legacy selection components were retired; atlas JSON UV and hit-mask checks remain.

The actual rune renderer passed 49 visual states and 20 light/dark background pixel samples. Authored alpha is unchanged; opaque backing and inactive shading belong to rendering. Final focused tests, boss/backdrop inspection and public-wiki status are reported in the accompanying receipts. Previous whole-game tests and native binaries do not validate these new inputs.

The wiki links all 144 current skills to actual values, effects and sources. Thirty base/ultimate cards contain their modifiers; the base skill supplemental-effect area stays empty. All 1,291 content records now have images: the existing 1,252 plus 34 derived 2D rune-shape previews assembled from current tiles and exact coordinates, and five new 2D chest/shrine paintings. Rune previews use an example attack palette and are not runtime screenshots. Up to nine rewards retain their individual order and counts. These 39 previews need no 3D; their initial collection changed no runtime models, saves or game code. Runtime binding and in-game visual verification of the five new paintings remain separate.

A subsequent user request removes the tiny exterior type emblem in the shared `Piece` renderer. All34 Wiki previews were regenerated with unchanged body scale/centre, cell coordinates and rotation; zero pixels changed outside the retired-emblem footprints. Actual Metal Editor rendering covered150 combinations of five types, six rotations and five states, with six captures reviewed. Selected rims, dim states and central placement anchors remain. The65 related Wiki tests,15 UI contract cases and static refresh check passed. Temporary scenes/cameras were restored and the owned Editor closed gracefully with exit0. No Play, GameStore or real-save access occurred. [Exterior-emblem evidence](CasualArtEvidence20261015/rune-exterior-emblem-20261016.json).

Town commit cfcdf310 adopted four new NPCs and four props. Focused tests passed 23/23; landscape/portrait checks covered eight dialogues, six service-window visits, 24 real inputs and 136 fence segments. All four props also have dedicated 768×768 close-up evidence, distinguished from placement captures. Eight remaining models stay on producer quality HOLD; one garland remains unproduced for lack of free quota. The accepted Mark game proof is reused.

After approved-art hash and existing GUID verification, 22 temporary DB rows are classified as “Development applied; release approval separate.” The remaining 38 temporary rows and five aggregate production TODOs, 43 rows in total, are preserved rather than marked complete in bulk. The 65 related Wiki tests passed after module-path correction. Seven initial module-path errors executed no tests and count as neither test passes nor test failures. The initial39-preview collection ran no Unity session. The later exterior-emblem removal has separate focused renderer evidence. No additional whole-game NUnit suite or native build is run. Publication is established separately by the exact final public commit, Pages and anonymous HTTP results. See [the preview39 evidence](CasualArtEvidence20261015/wiki-preview39-20261016.json) for bindings and state details.

Paths and hashes are recorded in [the evidence JSON](CasualArtEvidence20261015/followup-20261016.json). No whole-game NUnit or new native build is run in this follow-up.

Final local gates:123 related EditMode cases passed and the corrected remaining case passed its focused rerun. UI contract15 and static refresh checks passed. The actual boss-graph representative and35 codex rows/31 distinct images matched their definitions. Fifteen codex captures expose10 unique actions plus shared Roar; this is not complete individual pixel coverage. Existing shared scrim restored caption contrast in both orientations.

[Class crest source freeze / 직업 문장 소스 핀](CasualArtEvidence20261015/class-glyph-source-freeze-20261016.json) preserves the original attestation and pins the unchanged crest routes to committed source f32d380d.

Refactoring after priority integration/cleanup: completed Claude options history and five monster model commits were merged into local main; five completed worktrees and four local branches were removed/archived recoverably. Existing QA, recipe, GUID and portrait consistency were checked; productionApproved=false and no new gameplay acceptance remain. The first unit consolidated Wiki image-source conflict registration;29 existing tests and all1,214 ordered mappings across5,595 actual rows matched. The next unit removes repeated path validation and the already-proven allowlist condition when reading preserved documents;31 focused tests and actual bytes, INPUTS and cache ordering for all three preserved documents matched before/after. Game, save and serialization contracts are unchanged. The13 unique hero-manual-rig changes, unrelated ProjectSettings bytes and quality-held models remain protected. After user approval, completed main90216d7f was uploaded without force and the remote SHA was confirmed. Two automatic workflows stopped before steps because of account billing/spending restrictions; no rerun or billing-setting change occurred. Later storage cleanup remains local. Fifteen duplicate validation files (3,264,802B) were consolidated into byte-identical canonical evidence with a [path/recovery map](MainCleanup20260930Evidence/training/canonical-files.json). Moving982 unused generated copies (477,806,727B) into recoverable retention reduced active Wiki sources from8,841 files/2,589,712,294B to7,859/2,111,905,567B; collected snapshots, data and the public tree remain intact. Snapshot writes now reuse independent APFS clone copies, staged-byte verification and atomic replacement;36 focused cases passed. Logical path reduction is distinguished from physical reclaimed bytes, which are not claimed. The existing Wiki check stopped on the previously merged monster portrait-manifest differing from the older generated input pin; it is not counted as a pass. Removed paths were independently absent from current/history references and collected inputs. No additional whole-Wiki generation, game suite/build or model work was run. [Integration/refactor evidence](CasualArtEvidence20261015/main-cleanup-refactor-20261016.json).

Final synchronization preparation: relation validation now reuses each target database ID set within one call only. All256 actual lookup outcomes and their order match; set construction falls from256 to8. Isolated lookup median changes from1.219 to0.255ms, while peak temporary memory increases from26,448 to47,352B. This is not a whole-Wiki or game speedup. Seven actual-validate normal/error/between-call comparisons and45 related tests passed. The initial grouped run had one error from preexisting duplicate module registration, reproduced with the old code; canonical import fixed it and the same group passed. No whole collection has run at this stage. One final Wiki collection and publication verification will synchronize merged monster assets with current documents and generator inputs. No additional game tests/builds or model generation are included.

Runtime/storage follow-up, round2: the DPS HUD reuses its existing chart samples for peak calculation, and enemy tethers synchronously consume two endpoints from the existing scratch buffer. Calculation/list bounds, presentation and transaction/save/combat validation remain; no persistent cache is added. Actual before/after C# checks passed261 DPS cases and24 tether combinations over two consecutive calls/5,376 assertions. Runtime compilation of851 sources against actual Unity references had0 errors/0 warnings in changed files;15 shared UI contract tests passed. The tether check uses diagnostic renderer adapters and is not actual game display proof. CPU/GC/FPS were not measured, so no runtime improvement numbers are claimed. Two duplicate attendance XML files (4,122,827B) were consolidated into retained canonical reports with a [path/recovery map](AttendanceCollectEvidence20261003/canonical-files.json). Two historical RiftEntry/RiftVictory HTML snapshots (106,271,015B) remain unique and preserved as a separate approval candidate. The previous478MB retention move is not reclaimed storage. No additional Unity, whole NUnit, game build or model generation ran.

Approved additional storage cleanup (2026-10-17): the two historical HTML approval candidates (106,271,015B) were removed from current tracked files after explicit user approval; exact recovery bytes in Git 9b779d62 were verified. The retained982 obsolete generated Wiki copies (477,806,727B) were permanently deleted after rechecking the exact list, paths, sizes, mtimes, inodes, symlinks and current/history references. Identical reconstruction of those old copies is not guaranteed. Combined removed logical bytes are584,077,742B; same-volume df available space immediately changed from236,613,672,960B to237,199,736,832B (+586,063,872B). APFS sharing, directory metadata and concurrent writes prevent exclusive attribution. Current originals, collected snapshots and public output, the13 hero-manual-rig changes, user Settings and held models/RAW remain protected. No Git history rewrite, GC, prune, runtime code change, Unity, game build or whole tests ran. [Approved cleanup and Git recovery evidence](CasualArtEvidence20261015/main-cleanup-refactor-20261016.json).

pages.body:
# Casual artwork local integration — 2026-10-15

[한국어](Casual_Art_Integration_20261015.md)

Local main integrates **603 artwork records** and their display routes. Approval means current import identity; it does not assert complete runtime, release or generation-model provenance approval.

- The original575 (portrait/items341, current skills144, compatibility skills18, menu/UI/world25, status29, frames18) gain28 explicitly approved Options assets. Equipment359 and class crests3 are existing reuse outside this count. There are528 changed PNGs,75 prior-identical PNGs and exactly37 null-prior new assets.
- Original575 records, path aliases7, legacy18, class3 and assembly history remain unchanged. The Options extension separately pins the human approval,56 absent premerge paths,80 owner files,two shared unions and28 same-GUID metadata trailing-whitespace changes. Class3 reuse retains its exact PNG/meta and GameUI source freeze outside603.
- W01 native1254/budget512 and unknown model, and W09 missing original producer receipt/observed revision remain unresolved. Options model identity remains unknown where the tool did not expose it. Current PNG/meta/GUID identity is separate from generation provenance.
- The potion512 full-canvas66% contract and HUD group layout remain. Failed painted tiny-glyph pilots remain evidence; five9px rune-type functional glyphs stay readable while large painted category art remains separate.
- Wiki source is frozen for complete603 identity, current144 ability/resource links, individual legacy18/class3 PNGs and exact416 historical attachments. Historical87 IDs and original downloads remain while current inline previews are suppressed. Those87 original files remain in Resources; physical retirement is not claimed.
- The exact Git deletions of previously recoverably archived GlobalHUD49 PNG+49meta are recorded. Originals remain in TASK recovery and Git history. No permanent deletion or physical-space reclamation is claimed. Three preserved documents retain their original bytes.

[603 import receipt](../../tools/casual_art_adoption_receipt_20261015.json) and [integration evidence](CasualArtEvidence20261015/integration.json) preserve counts,SHA,GUID,source chains and limitations. Original575 assembly NOT_RUN fields are historical; the extension and actual runtime results are recorded separately.

Approved Options PR138 is locally merged; the remote PR is unchanged. The Town environment candidate is local too: five focused fixtures56/56 PASS, actual ten-service smoke,16 landscape captures,two portrait visual captures, graceful closure and disposable fixture restoration passed. Dedicatedprops6/newNPC12 remain unfinished.

The final whole NUnit invocation,one reusable native build/player validation,and latest Wiki build/check are still NOT_RUN. Choke/scout,hourglass final pixel review,some semantic roles,physical input and performance remain unverified. Actual saves and unrelated ProjectSettings changes are protected. Remote push,possibly paid CI and permanent deletion remain HOLD.

## 2026-10-16 pre-casual retirement and Mark representative intake

The user's instruction to retire all pre-casual artwork supersedes the earlier87 preservation/download-compatibility plan. Current603 art and359 canonical equipment remain protected. # Casual attendance altar pilot — 2026-10-14

[한국어](Casual_Attendance_Altar_Pilot_20261014.md) · [Validation receipt](Casual_Attendance_Altar_Pilot_20261014.receipt.json)

From baseline `53d6a3e1`, replace only the runtime artwork `Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources/Art/Attendance/popup-altar.png` with newly drawn StyleD art. Code, rewards/IDs, saves, importers, and UI coordinates remain unchanged. The 700 approved primary exports did not contain this backdrop. Built-in image_gen produced one new illustration and three focused corrections for flat cel surfaces and actual reward/state/date text contrast. Apply selected PNG bytes without postprocessing.

- Selected SHA-256: `1d8ec19907d2e66acefae53a1b051b304f80328bc1fd5eca8874305776e2d18f`
- Original SHA-256: `05d2b3df863412c16ca55b75dc6f9b4b37c4bd01f891ea569e8456aa409a3f44`
- Preserved GUID: `688eef0212b544a0f9f9f673441bc601`; byte-identical meta SHA-256 `fd891bb4ae492ab2b472262ea9a40b8bd57b41f2afc6fb69d94563dc2b093dc3`.
- Opaque RGB 1254×1254 square; altar upper face near 46% from the top. Actual imported texture: 1024×1024, no mipmaps; unchanged 1024 caps and Standalone BC7 / Android ASTC 6×6 / WebGL ETC2 RGBA8 settings.

[Before](../Implementation/CasualAttendanceAltarPilotEvidence/before/weekly-ko.png) · [After](../Implementation/CasualAttendanceAltarPilotEvidence/after/editor-selected-1893x1637-ko.png) · [Portrait claimable](../Implementation/CasualAttendanceAltarPilotEvidence/native-screens/weekly-ready-440x956.png) · [English landscape monthly](../Implementation/CasualAttendanceAltarPilotEvidence/native-screens/monthly-956x440-en-100.png) · [Portrait claimed](../Implementation/CasualAttendanceAltarPilotEvidence/native-screens/weekly-claimed-440x956-ko-100.png)

## Validation and limits

Final AttendanceArtTests: 7 passed, zero failures/skips. Shared UI contract and its 15 regression tests passed. The art suite ran once for each of two asset inputs before/after contrast corrections; final contract verification reused matching source/environment/log proof.

Exactly one macOS development build succeeded in 34.661 seconds with zero build errors and exit 0. The initial smoke saved 25 captures, then exited 1 with `Collect button obscured: Weekly day 4` (empty raycast hits; Geometry line127, Start line234). Keep this failure as a failure. The same binary and isolated saved state then passed the same collect-button assertions and the remaining cases through the existing CollectOnly entry point, exit 0. Fresh-process Resume also exited 0. **A clean complete single initial-to-final run is not claimed.** Root cause of the first failure is unconfirmed; repaint/input timing is an inference and remains a separate harness follow-up risk before expansion.

Continuation verified 78 default-text viewport/language/safe-area page cases, 1,066 collect-button bounds/raycasts, 1,596 eligibility/seal/fold checks, and 104 raycast-verified clicks. Required 440×956, 956×440, 1440×810, 1440×900, 1680×720 and the existing extra 640×360 cases covered KO/EN. Preserve 69 native captures. Across the initial and continuation phases, verify individual/bulk claims, failed save and retry, UI refresh after saving, swipe/hide/reopen and battle pause handling. Resume restored all 28 monthly claims, 990 coins, 110,000 gold, 110 gems, 55 cores, five unopened chests and one opened reward item. The weekly track correctly rolled to day1 of its later period by the final fixture date.

All players used `-noaudio` and `/Users/t8g-2410-pn-005/Documents/Codex/2026-10-14/task-5/evidence/native-save`; no actual user save was used. The development-console message in the save-fault capture records the deliberately blocked temporary save path. Physical mobile devices, the full 5715 suite, web builds and public deployments were outside this pilot. Preserve the final integration owner's existing full-suite/smoke completion requirement.

## Retention and next boundary

Other-owner transition Markdown/English/index files retain their exact hashes and are excluded from this commit. Restore only the three automatic build settings changes from verified pre-run bytes and preserve their generated state as evidence. Recover original art with `git show 53d6a3e1:Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources/Art/Attendance/popup-altar.png` or `/Users/t8g-2410-pn-005/Documents/Codex/2026-10-14/task-5/evidence/original/popup-altar.png`. No permanent deletion of originals, meta, candidates or failure proof.

Next candidate: reuse approved random-core art for **one representative native-alpha Sprite**, `reward-random-core.png`. Validate its alpha edge, small-size readability, green claim glow, GUID and 512 cap before a small same-type batch including the approved legendary-chest sprite. The surrounding UI and rewards still use their existing theme. Shared UiTheme (164 consumers), fixed crops/atlases and 3D rigs have separate impact boundaries. Await parent coordination before expanding.

Prompts, selected source, result JSON, logs, screenshots and artifact lifecycle records live in `/Users/t8g-2410-pn-005/Documents/Codex/2026-10-14/task-5`. Artifact lifecycle records the single player's creation path/hash and recoverable closeout archive path.
