# Casual base battle HUD — source handoff (2026-10-14)

[한국어](Casual_Battle_HUD_20261014.md) · [Reference](../Design/GlobalHUD/Casual/README.md) · [Shared handoff](Casual_UI_Parallel_Handoff_20261014.en.md)

This is a source/static-validation delivery of the base HUD and four independent normal-rift graph windows. No Unity, EditMode execution, player build, actual screen pass, or real save access is claimed. The integration owner will run the single final combined validation after all 15 screens are assembled.

## Base and ownership

Worktree: `task-22/battle-hud`, branch `codex/casual-battle-hud`, local shared Git objects and sparse sources. No concurrent original-checkout edits or Library/player copies.

Dependency order: existing 13 UI `8d356b3c` → documentation `529effd6`/`4148241a` → six hero slots `e3809624`/`93219e3f` → character creation/selection `b87b581b249c5e682cd7832fa9190b24c0dd9c4e` → shared HUD API **b0d4da6be02d9069bff04c4e81c4029caa677c13** → this HUD commit. Do not integrate earlier WIP snapshots. Recovery integration owner: `01a13a01-b651-7457-b0e9-aa4f6325a0e9`.

Dedicated additions: `CasualBattleHudLayout/Style`, `GameUI.CasualBattleHud/CasualDamageGraphs/CasualEdictMenu`, `GameController.BattleHud`, `CasualBattleHudTests`. Base HUD owners: `GlobalHudLayout/View/Snapshot`, `StatusStripView`, layout JSON. Adapter edits: `GameUI.BattleLayout/DamageGraphs/Rift/RiftActivity/TrainingGround/EdictSheet/EdictQuick/Enemies`; Enemies adds one dispatch line. Agreed shared hooks: Display calls `InitializeBattleHudPositions(directory)`; IdleDashboard passes class and gender to Portrait.

Shared SkillIconView/PotionArt/TrainingDpsChart/RiftActivityPanel/budget/localization files remain exactly at b0d4da6b. Protected `GameUI.EdictPosition/Target/Order`, `CasualEdictSkinScope`, `GameUI.PotionQuick` remain byte-identical. HeroSlots, migration, creation/selection, combat, rewards and currency were not reimplemented.

## Behavior and compatibility

The top-right edict opens downward; the minimap sits bottom-right; effects begin above the first potion. Portrait stacks effects, slots, seal/vitals and XP. The 44 reference-unit targets are scaled to fit, not certified as 44 physical pixels on every device. Saved class/gender chooses six approved seals. HP below 30% pulses a coral ring every 1.1 seconds; dead portraits turn gray.

Skill roles use `SetCasualHudFrame`; potions use `PotionArt.Bottle(...,casualHud:true)` with the complete 512px canvas rendered at 66% of the slot. No alpha recrop. Crafted-elixir art and tap/hold/swap/settings paths remain. DPS/activity retain their preference files; new files are `hellscript-monster-damage-position-v1.json` and `hellscript-boss-damage-position-v1.json`. Existing atomic `DpsHudPosition` preserves old files on failure. Folds remain session state, not account schema.

All four windows fold/drag independently. Existing DPS/incoming/activity calculations, 20/40% risk thresholds, 50% bar saturation, boss-alive gate and 60 cast-marker cap remain. The folded activity ratio uses the same percentages. Training/tutorial graph layout and input adapters stay intact. A scoped `BuildCasualCompatibleEdictPanel` adapter supplies a lower-screen layout anchor to existing portrait editors and restores the real top-right anchor in `finally`.

Jua display/numbers and Noto body use a single existing pooled `SkillTreeD4TextShadow` effect. No stacked Outline/Shadow components. Existing one-second DPS and 0.15-second activity refresh cadence remains; marker lookup uses a reused list. No CPU/GPU/GC measurement was performed. Shared b0d4da6b updates result-chart series colors while keeping result geometry separate from HUD-specific strokes/endpoints.

## Art and evidence

Actually inspected: all 14 local reference JPGs and pixel contact sheets of imported art. The designated `dakrdong@gmail.com` Chrome profile was verified, but the private online artifact timed out after its title loaded. **The online artboards were not seen.** No other profile was operated.

Runtime: `Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources/Art/GlobalHUD/Casual/`, 60 PNGs: six approved seals, three approved potion canvases, 51 prepared vector derivatives. Existing prepared files were reused; no follow-up regeneration/imagegen. Sources/recipe are in `Docs/Design/GlobalHUD/Casual/` and `Resources/v2-casual/` beneath GlobalHUD design docs. Do not regenerate to finish this handoff.

[Runtime hashes/GUIDs/borders](CasualBattleHudEvidence/runtime-art.json), [approved source hashes](CasualBattleHudEvidence/approved-art.json), [audit](CasualBattleHudEvidence/art-audit.json). PNG bytes: **2,846,922**. RGBA8 raw upper bound: **20,702,464 bytes**, not measured GPU usage. Shared texture budget: maximum 512, mip/readable off. All 91 original root PNGs and their 91 metadata files are unchanged. Old GUIDs, fallback resource strings and shared assets remain; zero deletions.

## Checks and integration entry points

- Roslyn with actual Unity references: Runtime 861, Editor 53, Tests 271 sources; zero errors. Existing warnings 90/28/43; changed-file warnings zero. Test assembly compilation is not EditMode execution.
- Production layout C# executed with pure value-type/math shims: five requested sizes, boss/menu combinations and 16 fold combinations; **320 cases / 38,480 boundary and overlap checks passed**. No font/input/rendering claim.
- UI contract 15/15, refresh guard 16 bindings, design-source smoke 38 variants, diff whitespace pass. [Compile](CasualBattleHudEvidence/compile-result.json), [geometry](CasualBattleHudEvidence/geometry-result.json), [receipt](CasualBattleHudEvidence/receipt.json).
- EditMode entry points: GlobalHudTests/GlobalHudResourceTests/CasualBattleHudTests/CasualHudSharedTests/CasualChartSkinTests/BuildResourceTests and existing DamageGraph/DpsHud/CombatActivity/HuntEdict/Potion tests.
- Reuse one final integrated player with existing `-hellscriptGlobalHudSmoke`, `-hellscriptHudScaleSmoke`, `-hellscriptBattleLayoutSmoke`, `-hellscriptDamageGraphSmoke`, `-hellscriptRiftDpsSmoke`, `-hellscriptDpsDragSmoke`, `-hellscriptRiftActivitySmoke`, `-hellscriptBattleQuickEditSmoke`; use each smoke's disposable-save/evidence arguments. Never use the user's real save.
- Remaining checks: ko/en, long boss labels/large DPS, six seals, insufficient ◆/locked/empty/dead/low-HP, full effects scrolling, four independent folds/drags/relaunch/failure, edict/potion editing/rotation, three map modes, observation/settings/idle/return and the other 13 screens. Physical input, mobile devices, screen readers and performance remain untested.

## Declared reference adjustments

Portrait slot faces are 44 rather than 42 design units; actual face bottoms including caption reservation are portrait147/compact37/desktop54. Compact boss damage uses x306/y96 in the middle lane because five rows cannot fit under both right-hand windows. Boss status and header shortcuts are separated; full compact action text stays in the observation menu.

Open edict tabs temporarily hide the content dock, narrow the portrait right graph lane and move the landscape/desktop map clear of the menu. Closing restores the dock; reflow does not overwrite saved anchors. New art uses a scoped Casual path; old assets stay until actual rendering/reference verification. CSS/Unity font pixel parity, existing boss/skill illustration consistency and actual readability remain final-review items.

After freeze, changes require coordination of ownership with integration. No push, main merge, web build, Unity/player execution or real save access. Task-owned source and static outputs remain through final review under task-22/artifact-lifecycle.json; no permanent cleanup was performed.

Accounting: total work/wait/retry duration and usage tokens were not measured across interruption/reconnection. The final 15-test static UI contract log reports 43.491 seconds. Unity full tests, player builds and wiki runs: zero.


## 2026-10-15 follow-up — portrait slot groups and Training header

The 2026-10-14 body above is preserved as its historical source handoff. This addendum records the user-requested **selected local HUD changes and narrowly scoped validation**. The working tree also contains a separate uncommitted art/provider integration unit; these observations are not a clean-HEAD-only integrated acceptance claim.

### Change scope

- Portrait slots use a maximum of **50 design units**, **4** within-group spacing and **16** between potion/skill groups. Remaining width is split between both outer margins; small viewports scale slots and spacing together. This does not guarantee 50 physical pixels. The actual 602×930 observation measured **48.64px** slots, **3.89px** inner spacing and **15.56px** between groups.
- The portrait content dock retains its existing **44-unit basis**. Separating that basis in `GameUI.ContentDock` prevents larger slots from enlarging dock buttons. Compact and ordinary landscape slot layout remain outside this portrait-slot change.
- The selected slot patch SHA256 is `656eb19d5d432166d7d0c92225705a8cf541fe68f5880fe6b23f4f3e1a12de60`. It includes `GlobalHudLayout`, only the first two layout/comment hunks in `GameUI.ContentDock`, and one expected-value line in `GlobalHudTests`. The ContentDock `Emblem`→`GlobalHudView.LoadArt` art/provider hunk stays with the separate integration unit. Application checking against 3 HEAD `b5b86c51` text snapshots passed; this is not compilation or runtime evidence.
- A separate one-file `GameUI.BattleLayout` change applies only to the **legacy noncompact landscape Training header**. It bounds the settings button above the fixed Edict and moves the dock top below Edict. Shared `dockIcon` is unchanged, preserving dock icon/rail, field-event and medallion/minimap size inputs. The ordinary CasualCombatHud early return, portrait and compact branches remain. Source SHA256: `623060ef503b4bf14940aeb4a04f5fccd8fa64b2a80b9fd5bbb16bcd1e13664e` → `78dd091d775caeaff1a52858c9b40071c1ab8f8b91677b1c50db55672b639334`; metadata was preserved.

### Actual slot observations

- **10 geometry conditions** covered Korean/English × 5 viewports: 602×930, 390×844, 320×568, 956×440 and 1600×900. EventSystem center hits on visible targets are distinct from physical-input testing.
- Actual callback paths covered **16** taps followed by detail close, **16** timed partial-hold exit/cancels, and **8** nonempty full holds followed by detail close. The remaining **8** empty/ultimate full-hold cases are **NOT_RUN**; no grant or equip action was added for testing.
- Root directly reviewed **9** earlier bottom-row frames and **1** new Korean 602×930 frame after the title flight ended naturally, and accepted the slot row. # Casual combat distance HUD — shared followup integration

2026-10-14 · [한국어](Casual_Combat_Distance_HUD_20261014.md)

Screen-source integration is complete; Unity execution and visual acceptance await the parent’s single queue. Branch codex/casual-distance-hud preserves screen commits fa5110a6/3f4eccc0 and imports approved common 0ccba80eef0da4703cb7ffcd1fb8e22848002b3d through merge4842b667c07a68a30302be7f2ade007ebdb8b477. No common file was independently edited.

The actual Claude reference contains20 enumerated/read boards. Two were enlarged and exercised, covering positioning, target priority, chase, goblin and action order through internal navigation. KNOWN/SCOUT lure states were also checked. This does not certify every state on all20 boards. No standalone PC board was found. No browser action followed the instruction restricting Chrome to the user’s specified profile. The source export is in Library as libfile_96eed501147c8191a90434ce71eb2a96; no runtime after capture exists.

Before/after: dark rectangular panels become existing common cream/navy paint, gold nameplates use Jua13, cards reuse idle/chosen looks, and body/emphasis uses Noto400/700 without shrinking. Radio rows follow the observed12.5/11 sizes and minimum49-unit height instead of36; unnecessary radio PNG calls were removed. Common buttons retain selected/disabled/hover/press/focus behavior, with coral close buttons. Shared ConfigureEdictSkin now supplies number track/fill/knob colours and preview-only world materials. Number ranges/steps, preview and release saving, targeting, timing, camera and geometry remain owned by their existing implementations.

CasualEdictSkinScope is attached at BuildCompactEdictSurface before any number row is created. It sets the shared edict skin for Position/Target/Order and restores the previous scope when the card closes or rebuilds. It does not overwrite a later scope set by another owner. The separate DPS/graph ConfigureCombatSkin is outside this screen’s scope. There are no equipment or chart views requiring provider/skin arguments here.

The shared renderer still has nonserialized clone state, so local paint/button clone bindings remain. The five-symbol fallback is removed now that the approved Noto fonts contain ▲▼≡●○. The emergency bullet returns to its original localized sentence,10-unit start and full width. No translation keys or font sizes change. # Casual hero 3D models (temporary)

Updated: 2026-10-15 · [한국어](Casual_Hero_Models_Temporary.md)

The new casual (StyleD chibi) hero 3D models are shown in the game as temporary stand-ins. User decision (2026-10-15): use the current models as they are for now; they may be replaced later by paid generation.

| Class | Install key | Source | State |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Warrior | `HunyuanReady/Characters/Hero_Warrior` | male warrior HW02 (Hunyuan image-to-3D, rigged with `--hand-capture`) | arms and hands follow the body; a thin blue shard shows above the head in the windup |
| Ranger | `HunyuanReady/Characters/Hero_Ranger` | male archer HW17 (Hunyuan, simplified input) | fairly clean; small shards beside the hands and thighs |
| Mage | `HunyuanReady/Characters/Hero_Mage` | male mage M42 (regenerated 2026-10-15 with short sleeves and bare forearms, T-pose bent to an A-pose, rigged without hand capture) | legs walk, arms stay in the A-pose (no arm swing), nothing tears loose. Replaces HW82, whose hand flew off in the windup |
| Female warrior | `HunyuanReady/Characters/Hero_Warrior_F` | female warrior HW52 (text-to-3D T-pose to A-pose, `--hand-capture`) | arms move; a small hair-tip piece in the windup |
| Female ranger | `HunyuanReady/Characters/Hero_Ranger_F` | female archer HW08 (image-to-3D, `--hand-capture`) | long hair lifts with the raised arm |
| Female mage | `HunyuanReady/Characters/Hero_Mage_F` | female mage F33 (regenerated 2026-10-15, same recipe as M42) | arms fixed, nothing tears loose |

- Code: the existing `HeroBodyArt` keys (`Characters/Hero_*`) are unchanged; `HunyuanReadyArt` already prefers a READY model with the same key over the procedural one. READY models have no weapon sockets, so `WorldView.Actors.cs` attaches props to the hand and back bones when a socket is missing (`Pivot_Weapon` to `Pivot_Hand_L` for the bow and `Pivot_Hand_R` for sword/staff; shield to `Pivot_Hand_L`; quiver parented to `Pivot_Chest` at the READY `backBone` position, keeping the root-aligned rest rotation). The procedural hero files stay; deleting the READY folders restores them.
- Lightening: LOD 6000/3000/1500 triangles and 512 px textures per model, about 5.6–6.0 MB per folder.
- Records: the rigging tool and pre-processing (`tools/hunyuan_monster_ready.py --hand-capture`, `tools/art3d/tpose_to_apose.py`), input art and attempt results are in `Docs/Art/CasualConcept/2026-10-14/Characters/HunyuanInput/README.md` on branch `claude/hero-rig-inputs`.
- The three female heroes (`Hero_*_F`) are installed as READY models at the user's request (2026-10-15: put them in now even at low quality). Integrated main supports six male/female creation and selection slots. Its 3D body lookup still routes by class only, so the installed female model keys are not yet selected by gender.
- Mage attempts (2026-10-15): 6 Hunyuan generations, 5 of them (20 candidates) rigged. With `--hand-capture` the hand tears off the forearm and flies (gate failure or rejected by eye); without hand capture the rig passes with the arms fixed to the torso. A mage with moving arms needs an input with separate hat and sleeves, or paid generation. Sources are in `AssetDeliverables/Hunyuan/2026-10-15/heroes_text/` (outside git).

## Verification

The 86 tests and warrior native capture below are the originating owner's historical `616c88b2` proof. The integrated bow/quiver correction and 13/13 main EditMode results are recorded separately in the [integration note](Casual_Hero_Models_Integration_20261014.en.md). Merging follow-up documentation/captures `8172639e` changes no game source or assets and preserves those integration test inputs.

- Focused EditMode (WorldArt, TownModel, HunyuanMonsterReady): 86 passed, 0 failed, including Hero_Warrior/Ranger/Mage.
- macOS development-build runtime smoke (`-hellscriptMonsterModelsSmoke`): the warrior appears on the rift battle screen ([screenshot](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/warrior-in-rift.jpg)). In-game screens of the ranger and mage were not captured this time. Rig verdict sheets: [warrior](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/warrior-rig-sheet.jpg), [ranger](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/ranger-rig-sheet.jpg), [mage HW82 (replaced)](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/mage-rig-sheet.jpg), [mage M42](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/mage-m42-rig-sheet.jpg), [female warrior](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/warrior-f-rig-sheet.jpg), [female ranger](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/ranger-f-rig-sheet.jpg), [female mage](CasualHeroModelsEvidence20261015/mage-f-rig-sheet.jpg).
- The originating owner reported 37 passing HunyuanMonsterReadyTests after the 2026-10-15 additions. This cleanup could not verify the original XML for that run or its input identity against the current assets. Each of the three existing XML files inspected contains 34 Hunyuan cases, no female cases, and the previous mage; they do not establish 37 passing cases for the later M42/female assets or current main. No in-game smoke was run for the female models or the new mage.
- Real devices, performance and build size were not verified.

The later female/M42 installation was integrated from remote PR133 (`a3f96545`) into local main. At this cleanup baseline, `3c5990e2`, documentation, source and assets were compared read-only; no Unity, build or native run was performed. The earlier 13/13 prop-attachment result retains its original `16c75fa7` inputs and does not validate the later M42/female assets. No generation or rigging is restarted during workspace cleanup.

# Casual hero model integration — 2026-10-14

[한국어](Casual_Hero_Models_Integration_20261014.md)

Integrate the user-confirmed completed `claude/casual-hero-models` commit `616c88b24c0f7cac49cd7e12c7d9408b6f2886ce` into local main. Preserve the three READY class models (HW02 warrior, HW17 ranger, HW82 mage), nine LOD FBXs and 36 512×512 PNGs. No generation, rerigging or payment is performed. The six-slot save and gender-specific 2D art contracts remain intact; both genders share each class's 3D model as before.

READY rigs lack the procedural weapon sockets. Preserve the authored left hand for the bow and shield, and the right hand for the sword and staff. Keep the quiver parented to Chest while placing it at the recipe's backBone rest position behind the body, without inheriting Cape cloth motion. Existing WorldArtTests gains a regression exercising the real WorldView body construction and all five prop attachments.

The 144 asset files have no missing metadata, GUID collision or unresolved prefab reference. All nine FBXs match recipe hashes. The preserved provenance recipe_sha256 identifies the original recipe with the HWxx art key; the installed Hero_* recipe has a distinct hash after renaming.

Final validation and executed/unexecuted scopes are recorded under task-23 validation/cleanup-20261014 and its cleanup handoff receipt. Earlier UI proof and the preserved native app retain their original source identity and do not establish player validation of these new models.

## Integration result

After model merge `831f3424` and history-only merges for already integrated training/shop work, validation used main `16c75fa7938700fbd4ec419e5f7755876220287e`. Runtime, Editor and Tests compile with zero errors and the existing 88/28/35 warnings. UI contract 15 and refresh 16 checks pass. Muted EditMode on final main passes **13/13**: five new prop attachment cases, one existing model/socket case and seven altar-art cases, with no failure or skip (tests 5.625 s; whole process 75.013 s). Back up and restore the 465 automatic whitespace-only metas and IDE setting after the run. No full suite, native player or device run was performed for these new models. The originating owner's separate 86/86 proof retains source identity `616c88b2`.

Following the user's merge-first cleanup request, move 15 sparse working copies and one already integrated older HUD worktree into normal macOS Trash. All Git/stash/dirty/ignored evidence remains recoverable: logical 6,078,038,016 bytes. Preserve the linked HUD's 2,329,721-byte Git admin/index/log metadata before pruning its registration. Remove 12 unused local branches whose tips are main ancestors and the published-main-merged remote branches `claude/casual-bgm` and `claude/monsters-casual-prompts`. No permanent deletion, stash drop, object/reflog purge, main push or CI invocation.

Keep the hero/tutorial folders with active cwd processes, dirty original/living-title, field/monster work with uncertain owner completion, unfinished hero-rig and open PR130 material. Remote `codex/**` deletion remains pending because its telemetry Actions push filter can match under the no-CI constraint. Wiki check fails because the sparse environment lacks the pre-existing generated `Wiki/site/data.json`; no wiki build/publication is added. Trash movement is not reclaimed space. task-23 `validation/cleanup-20261014/final-handoff.json` records exact paths, SHAs, restoration and final disk measurement.

## Follow-up documentation and duplicate workspace cleanup

Merge the completed two documents and four captures from `8172639e` as `7272f126`. Preserve capture bytes and align the notes with the left-hand bow, six gender slots and shared class 3D models in main. Game source, assets and settings remain identical, retaining the 13/13 test inputs without another Unity, build or full-suite invocation.

After confirming PR128/main/wiki completion and idle ownership, move local `casual-field-kit` to normal Trash. Also move the unused local `wt-casual-art`, whose 192 branch-changed paths all match main. Preserve 9,373,985,022 logical bytes and 4,471,862 bytes of Git admin/index/log recovery metadata; prune only their registrations and two local branches. Cumulative cleanup is 18 folders, 14 local branches and two remote branches. PR130 and remote art-concept remain unchanged.

Keep the model/monster owner's workspaces while actual Unity verification and the owner session remain busy. Retired tutorial work is idle but its Claude/terminal cwd remains open, so use has not ended. living-title retains an unmerged TitleArtImporter/prompt and user changes; its owner's durable thread is unavailable, preventing completion/freeze confirmation. Do not resume canceled hero-rig generation. Preserve original dirty material, remote main and no-CI constraints. task-23 `validation/cleanup-20261014/followup/final-handoff.json` records exact recovery paths and remaining blockers.

# Casual monster codex portraits and aspect correction

2026-10-14 · [한국어](README.md)

Scope: redraw all 35 codex monsters in the approved casual StyleD and keep their faces visible. Work started in a managed worktree from main `53d6a3e13304a781f9823134ba0f497bafb78621`, preserving unrelated art and work.

Use the actual warrior sheet and StyleD title as mandatory references, preserving each monster species, silhouette and identifying props from its existing portrait and production spec. Portraits are opaque squares with bold outlines and simple cel shading. The 29 normal monsters use ivory backgrounds; all six bosses use pale lavender. Keep the entire head, chin, horns and ears within the image. Nonhuman creatures retain their distinct head, mouth or crystal core.

The shared list/detail `MonsterCodexWindow.Portrait` fits the entire source into the allotted frame, preserving its aspect ratio and full UVs. Existing PNG metadata/GUIDs, saves, kill counts and combat definitions are preserved.

Generation uses built-in `image_gen`. It returns no actual model identifier, so provenance is `unknown` and `productionApproved: false`; use of `gpt-image-2` is unverified. Prior dark fantasy originals remain recoverable from Git history. Store prompts, IDs, hashes and actual dimensions in the production manifest.

Completed all 35 redraws with 39 built-in generation calls, including four corrections. All runtime PNGs are opaque RGB, 1254x1254, totaling 63,061,786 bytes. pages.body:
# Casual rift field skins — 2026-10-14

[한국어](Casual_Fields_20261014.md)

Updated on: 2026-10-15

The F4 meadow was validated first, followed by F0–F5. Runtime assets, lighting, fog and ambient particles now use bright StyleD palettes. Seeds, room layouts, obstacle collision/height, AI, combat, rewards and save keys are unchanged. Dedicated boss arenas, training, the legacy ring, town and the monster pipeline are outside this change.

## Runtime evidence

These are real game views from the macOS Unity 6000.6.0f1 Editor. A naturally generated seed opens each field. For readability, the hero is staged at a walkable point beside a live pack; actual combat ticks produce the paused enemy warning. This is visual/flow evidence, not natural progression, balance or device-performance evidence. Unexplored camera background remains black.

| Field | Palette | Entry | Live attack warning | Seed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F0 graveyard | Pale stone, moss, flowers | [Entry](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F0-entry.jpg) | [Warning](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F0-telegraph.jpg) | 19 |
| F1 fortress | Cream stone, warm sunlight | [Entry](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F1-entry.jpg) | [Warning](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F1-telegraph.jpg) | 1 |
| F2 desert | Warm sand, sky blue | [Entry](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F2-entry.jpg) | [Warning](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F2-telegraph.jpg) | 3 |
| F3 cavern | Purple stone, bright crystals | [Entry](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F3-entry.jpg) | [Warning](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F3-telegraph.jpg) | 16 |
| F4 meadow | Grass green, cream walls, pollen | [Entry](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F4-entry.jpg) | [Warning](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F4-telegraph.jpg) | 17 |
| F5 plateau | Bright snow, pale blue | [Entry](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F5-entry.jpg) | [Warning](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F5-telegraph.jpg) | 2 |

All captures are 1889×1543; the hero and red warnings remain distinguishable. F5's large blue snow blotches have lower contrast. Missing kit obstacle kinds reuse their template family's repainted models. The shared bounds-fitting path still fits the gameplay footprint and height.

## Owners and storage

![Actual attack telegraphs in the bright F4 grassland](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/F4-telegraph.jpg)

`FieldLook.cs` and `WorldFx.Persistent.cs` own the six daytime looks and pollen/leaves/crystal motes/gentle snow. Town and Legacy presets are unchanged. `WorldView.Rift.cs` and `WorldView.Props.cs` connect shared tiles, brighten rectangular tutorial passages and resolve field art before template-family art. Resources keep existing names/GUIDs; `_A` alpha is matte smoothness 26/255 and `_N` is a flat tangent normal. `ResourceTextureBudget.cs` explicitly caps each field at 512px; palette atlases are 64px and constant normals 4px.

The [installer](../../tools/art3d/install_casual_fields.py) uses the procedural kit already preserved on main. It verifies source hashes, normal/albedo output and existing metadata. No external generation API or new package is used. [Measured source sizes and hashes](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/asset-checks.json): 47,237,697 → 4,362,081 bytes, a **40.9 MiB reduction**, including new F3–F5 assets. This is not APK, web or installed-player size. All 168 existing GUIDs remain intact; reinstalling all six fields produces identical bytes. There are 81 models and 198 textures. Dark originals remain recoverable in Git history.

## Tutorial wording audit

Inspected GuideTutorial, CombatSimulation.Guide, Tutorials, TutorialChapters, FirstPlayGuide, GameUI.Tutorial/Guide owners, TutorialCinematic, WorldView.Prologue and Localization/en.txt. Current guide dialogue, toasts and instructions do not assume dark scenery and remain unchanged. Guide illustration text uses the same localization owner; no separate atmosphere illustration was added.

The surrounded prologue uses “here” instead of darkness. Korean sentences themselves are shipped keys, so Loc.T revises source display and its English translation without changing that key. Four puzzle hooks audited initially were retired with the puzzle tutorial by main PR #132. Integration removes their display mappings and regression cases and does not restore retired code, data or translations. One current prologue display correction remains. Its regression case verifies the existing key, both languages and Korean fallback. Graveyard/monster/item names and display dimming retain their identity/function.

## Validation status

The initial F4 focused EditMode run passed 17/17. Subsequent shared-model refinements compiled and appear in the six runtime captures; final tests cover them. Twelve final entry/combat images and black-background/live-windup assertions passed. Installer self-checks, identical reinstallation, GUID preservation and diff checks passed.

The [full final EditMode suite](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/editmode-final-summary.json) on `bd785e8e` passed 5,778 tests with zero failures and three existing diagnostic exclusions in 6,007.41 seconds, including all 18 art regressions. Field art, generator, loader and engine/package inputs stayed unchanged on latest main, so this proof and the 12 captures are reused.

The [latest-main focused run](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/latest-main-focused-summary.json) covered 698 cases in owners changed by PR #132: save, guide, combat, equipment, wording and UI. It passed 697 and found one retired-warrior-save guide-entry failure: an existing mapHero prevented the initial edict baseline from being accepted. The shared validator now permits only the exact guide baseline for its owned mandatory warrior, retaining other option locks. [Directly affected regressions](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/guide-migration-regression-summary.json) passed 120/120 after the fix, covering all three retired-save classes, fresh/mapped owner locks, guide progression and save boundaries. Other successful cases and the full suite were reused.

Final UI contract/regressions passed [15/15](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/ui-contract-delivery-summary.json); static refresh validation passed for 14 bindings and 184 UI sources. The shared validator fix changes no UI-contract receipt inputs; only changed development-fixture inputs needed final confirmation. [Reuse boundaries](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/validation-reuse.json).

The [macOS development player](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/native-summary.json) passed first-process field entry, a separate process restart and the fresh guide on the same final binary. At 1280×720, the field used the shrine, opted in/saved through the current edict window, automatically defeated four unchanged echoes in 7.60 seconds, excluded echo economy rewards and delivered the chest reward once. Map, HP, RNG, enemies and shrine duration survived restart. [Field report](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/native-field/runtime-field-smoke.txt), [opened chest](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/native-field/07-cursed-chest-opened.png).

The [guide report](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/native-guide/runtime-guide-tutorial-smoke.txt) passed Korean 440×956 fresh-guest warrior entry, Velina dialogue, Whirlwind/position/target/treasure/gathering lessons, real gold/gear, one graduation and town arrival. It uses macOS synthetic EventSystem input and accelerated actual fixed ticks; physical touch, ordinary play speed and human comprehension remain untested. All 73 guide screenshots are retained.

Startup search-index, async-admission, shader-compilation, reused-checkpoint and staging failures remain in the task validation folder; unfinished replacement frames are excluded from final evidence.

Updating the old field harness for D4 required edict mode, the shared editor entry and discovery/regroup priorities. Captured-state diagnostics isolated the failures; the complete shrine/echo/chest flow passed 1/1 before repeating the affected player flow. Enemy HP, the twelve-second limit, rewards and restart assertions were unchanged. Five development builds were required by fixture changes; [diagnostics and reproduction sources](CasualFieldEvidence20261014/field-fixture-diagnostics.zip) are retained. Successful full and related suites were reused.

Physical mobile, web runtime, matched before/after performance and APK size remain unverified. No fields remain to install; merge-candidate validation is complete. [PR #128](https://github.com/dakrdong/HELLSCRIPT/pull/128) records main integration. Final deployment records retain wiki/Pages and artifact disposition proof.

pages.body:
# Casual shared settings window

2026-10-15 · [한국어](Casual_Options_Window_20261015.md)

`codex/casual-options` starts from latest `origin/main` `af716fba66cfeb2cb210c5a549779eb68bc5efe2`. All 24 references and the live Claude canvas were inspected in the verified Codex in-app browser. The dirty primary checkout is untouched. Do not merge this PR before user approval.

The shared Screen, Audio, Language, Character and Account bodies, Game guide and Combat state now use cream chrome, white cards, yellow selected tabs, marker sliders and fresh PNG art. Existing preference, save, retry, identity and character-change owners remain authoritative. Hunt Edict, gear recommendation and shop options, and their gear entry buttons are outside this scope.

| Decision | Result |
|---|---|
| 1 · Composition and text | Keep existing font sizes and bundled Jua/Noto Sans KR. Tabs use one row: icon+label on PC, stacked in portrait, labels only in short landscape. Close and tabs retain at least 44 screen pixels. Card heights and scrolling differ from the reference's smaller text measurements. |
| 2 · Sliders | Retain Slider/SettingsStepSlider, 5% distance steps, wheel, −/+ and audio owners. The mute checkbox and bar fade follow the actual preference. |
| 3 · Plate | Float 8–12px inside the existing safe-area right-half/full-portrait ownership. Preserve keyboard, reading anchor and handle refresh. Separate the portrait header gem/title and update ratio-chip height after rotation. |
| 4 · Left world | Keep the actual town, training or rift scene and camera; no mockup background or added gradient. |
| 5 · Art | The user's follow-up rejected SVG quality and explicitly requested redrawn icons/map thumbnails, overriding the SVG-derivative direction. Generate 25 icons and three thumbnails of the same battlefield. A further user revision removes every hero/monster and distinguishes an upper-right minimap, a central translucent map and no map. Retain SVG only as mockup history. |
| 6 · Scrollbar | No added scrollbar. |

`CasualSettingsStyle` and settings layout parts are shared by the bodies. Missing colours are named `UiTheme.Settings*` tokens referenced through `UiSkin.Casual`; there is no global theme switch. Reuse existing hero seals, −/+ art and panel nine-slices. Build the window when opened and update existing values/choice states through the current refresh owners.

UID, pending-count and combat-state pills place their text above the background. Long UIDs wrap before the copy button. The current hero remains selected during a rift; other heroes show grey locked cards. The tutorial uses four tabs and places Return to title at the top of Account.

Keep [native originals](../Design/Options/Casual/assets/generated/), [generation prompts/provenance](../Design/Options/Casual/assets/image-generation.json) and [derivative dimensions/alpha/hashes](../Design/Options/Casual/assets/sprite-manifest.json). See the [art contact sheet](CasualOptionsEvidence/art-contact.jpg) and [three revised maps](CasualOptionsEvidence/map-options-v2.jpg). The built-in generator exposes neither model selection nor returned model version: **actual model unknown**. No verified `gpt-image-2` claim.

Validate native PNG alpha and fully transparent pixels before resizing icons to 128×128; map thumbnails are 256×164. No background removal, chroma key or SVG conversion. The 28 runtime PNGs total 1,029,406 bytes; raw RGBA equivalent is 2,142,208 bytes. Their estimated total with the configured 4×4 block compression is 535,552 bytes, not measured GPU memory. No performance improvement is claimed.

| Validation | Result and boundary |
|---|---|
| Actual game UI | Editor Game View: 440×956, 956×440, 1280×720, 1600×900, 2100×900 × KO/EN × seven bodies plus rift, save-failure and tutorial states. [112 captures and 24 reference pairs](CasualOptionsEvidence/README.en.md). Phone margins are simulated on Mac; not physical-device proof. |
| Input/state | Actual uGUI raycasts for tabs, mute, language, close and backdrop; 0.45/1 bar alpha; actual file-write failure and the three existing retry handlers; rejected rift character changes; tutorial four-tab layout. Final English choice reports zero missing translations. |
| Related EditMode | Run 106 cases across CasualSettingsTests, SettingsRevisionTests, CasualUiSkinTests, LocalizationTests and StoreViewBindingTests. Repair three localization failures and rerun only those three, all passed. The initial 27-case focused UI run also passed. Reuse unaffected successful coverage. [Receipt](CasualOptionsEvidence/validation-summary.json). |
| Static contracts | Final `check_ui_contract.py --verify`: 15 regressions passed. `check_ui_refresh.py`: 14 bindings/195 UI sources passed. |
| Compilation | Unity 6000.6.0f1 Editor compilation passed. Repair two initial LayoutGroup API arguments. No scene/prefab YAML edits. |
| Full EditMode/native build/smokes | **Not run on this branch.** The UI integration owner runs these once on the final integrated candidate after approved inputs freeze. Coordinate to avoid duplicate heavy jobs on this Mac. |
| Unverified | Physical mobile, WebGL, actual Google authentication/HTTP, CPU/GC and before/after binary performance. The displayed UID is a synthetic visual fixture, not authentication proof. |

The integrator can combine existing `-hellscriptScreenSettingsSmoke` with new `-hellscriptCasualOptionsSmoke` to run 110 native option captures. Require isolated `-hellscriptSavePath <dir>` and `-hellscriptScreenshots <dir>`. Reuse the integrator's same development binary; no additional build is needed.

Task-owned output paths, measured sizes, recipes, dependencies and retention are in `Builds/Validation/CasualOptions/artifact-lifecycle.json`. Retain source art and referenced evidence in the PR. Retain this worktree's import Library, logs and rejected early captures through review; reassess on 2026-10-22 or merge, whichever comes first. No native test binary was created, no permanent deletion was performed, and other tasks' outputs were untouched. Verify the owned Editor path and clean state, close it gracefully, then hand Unity usage back to the integrator.

No wiki generation/check/publication on this work branch. The approved merger handles affected wiki inputs and final integration gates. Processing/wait/retry time was not separately instrumented; the lifecycle manifest records elapsed time and actual check counts.

codex/casual-options starts from latest origin/main af716fba66cfeb2cb210c5a549779eb68bc5efe2. All 24 references and the live Claude canvas were inspected in the verified Codex in-app browser. The dirty primary checkout is untouched. Do not merge this PR before user approval.

The shared Screen, Audio, Language, Character and Account bodies, Game guide and Combat state now use cream chrome, white cards, yellow selected tabs, marker sliders and fresh PNG art. Existing preference, save, retry, identity and character-change owners remain authoritative. Hunt Edict, gear recommendation and shop options, and their gear entry buttons are outside this scope.

DecisionResult
1 · Composition and textKeep existing font sizes and bundled Jua/Noto Sans KR. Tabs use one row: icon+label on PC, stacked in portrait, labels only in short landscape. Close and tabs retain at least 44 screen pixels. Card heights and scrolling differ from the reference's smaller text measurements.
2 · SlidersRetain Slider/SettingsStepSlider, 5% distance steps, wheel, −/+ and audio owners. The mute checkbox and bar fade follow the actual preference.
3 · PlateFloat 8–12px inside the existing safe-area right-half/full-portrait ownership. Preserve keyboard, reading anchor and handle refresh. Separate the portrait header gem/title and update ratio-chip height after rotation.
4 · Left worldKeep the actual town, training or rift scene and camera; no mockup background or added gradient.
5 · ArtThe user's follow-up rejected SVG quality and explicitly requested redrawn icons/map thumbnails, overriding the SVG-derivative direction. Generate 25 icons and three thumbnails of the same battlefield. A further user revision removes every hero/monster and distinguishes an upper-right minimap, a central translucent map and no map. Retain SVG only as mockup history.
6 · ScrollbarNo added scrollbar.

CasualSettingsStyle and settings layout parts are shared by the bodies. Missing colours are named UiTheme.Settings* tokens referenced through UiSkin.Casual; there is no global theme switch. Reuse existing hero seals, −/+ art and panel nine-slices. Build the window when opened and update existing values/choice states through the current refresh owners.

UID, pending-count and combat-state pills place their text above the background. Long UIDs wrap before the copy button. The current hero remains selected during a rift; other heroes show grey locked cards. The tutorial uses four tabs and places Return to title at the top of Account.

Keep native originals, generation prompts/provenance and derivative dimensions/alpha/hashes. See the art contact sheet and three revised maps. The built-in generator exposes neither model selection nor returned model version: actual model unknown. No verified gpt-image-2 claim.

Validate native PNG alpha and fully transparent pixels before resizing icons to 128×128; map thumbnails are 256×164. No background removal, chroma key or SVG conversion. The 28 runtime PNGs total 1,029,406 bytes; raw RGBA equivalent is 2,142,208 bytes. Their estimated total with the configured 4×4 block compression is 535,552 bytes, not measured GPU memory. No performance improvement is claimed.

ValidationResult and boundary
Actual game UIEditor Game View: 440×956, 956×440, 1280×720, 1600×900, 2100×900 × KO/EN × seven bodies plus rift, save-failure and tutorial states. 112 captures and 24 reference pairs. Phone margins are simulated on Mac; not physical-device proof.
Input/stateActual uGUI raycasts for tabs, mute, language, close and backdrop; 0.45/1 bar alpha; actual file-write failure and the three existing retry handlers; rejected rift character changes; tutorial four-tab layout. Final English choice reports zero missing translations.
Related EditModeRun 106 cases across CasualSettingsTests, SettingsRevisionTests, CasualUiSkinTests, LocalizationTests and StoreViewBindingTests. Repair three localization failures and rerun only those three, all passed. The initial 27-case focused UI run also passed. Reuse unaffected successful coverage. Receipt.
Static contractsFinal check_ui_contract.py --verify: 15 regressions passed. check_ui_refresh.py: 14 bindings/195 UI sources passed.
CompilationUnity 6000.6.0f1 Editor compilation passed. Repair two initial LayoutGroup API arguments. No scene/prefab YAML edits.
Full EditMode/native build/smokesNot run on this branch. The UI integration owner runs these once on the final integrated candidate after approved inputs freeze. Coordinate to avoid duplicate heavy jobs on this Mac.
UnverifiedPhysical mobile, WebGL, actual Google authentication/HTTP, CPU/GC and before/after binary performance. The displayed UID is a synthetic visual fixture, not authentication proof.

The integrator can combine existing -hellscriptScreenSettingsSmoke with new -hellscriptCasualOptionsSmoke to run 110 native option captures. Require isolated -hellscriptSavePath <dir> and -hellscriptScreenshots <dir>. Reuse the integrator's same development binary; no additional build is needed.

Task-owned output paths, measured sizes, recipes, dependencies and retention are in Builds/Validation/CasualOptions/artifact-lifecycle.json. Retain source art and referenced evidence in the PR. Retain this worktree's import Library, logs and rejected early captures through review; reassess on 2026-10-22 or merge, whichever comes first. No native test binary was created, no permanent deletion was performed, and other tasks' outputs were untouched. Verify the owned Editor path and clean state, close it gracefully, then hand Unity usage back to the integrator.

No wiki generation/check/publication on this work branch. The approved merger handles affected wiki inputs and final integration gates. Processing/wait/retry time was not separately instrumented; the lifecycle manifest records elapsed time and actual check counts.

pages.body:
# Casual skill window skin pilot

2026-10-14 · [Korean](Casual_Skill_Window_Skin_20261014.md) · [Shared rules](Casual_UI_Skin_Rules_20261014.en.md)

Implemented only the skill window in local branch `codex/casual-skill-skin`, based on `origin/main 53d6a3e1` after the verified `083b03f0` integration. Attendance commit `6378320b` is not included. Attendance, HUD, currency, rewards, equipment effects, CI, other UI and existing skill artwork are unchanged. No push, PR, main integration, web build or public deployment occurred.

## Design and approved decision

Actually inspected the [Claude artifact](https://claude.ai/artifact/JsCKnJUbKkzfBYyJDR3493) in the user's Chrome, including its 24 artboards, class tabs, locked/key passives, portrait scrolling and English landscape refund→enabled invest→reinvestment. No Claude message, upload, payment or sharing change was made.

The required prompt was absent at its original checkout path; it was found and read in `wt-casual-art`, branch `claude/casual-art-concept ab5edd76`. The implementation uses `SkillWindow.casual.locked.dc.html`, retaining the original type sizes rather than the larger live canvas. The dark original is retained under `dark/`.

The actual browser body uses Noto Sans KR 400 (11.5px/16.675px), conflicting with the prompt's 700/900 wording. The user explicitly chose the actual design: default body 400, explicit 700/900 emphasis, original font sizes and layout. This decision is implemented.

The live artifact's solid-color background placed before another gradient layer is invalid CSS. Chrome computes transparent backgrounds, no image and a transparent 3px border. Native rendering uses the cream/navy layers specified by the prompt and local design; this is an explicitly reported difference from the live artifact.

The small top-left UI the user observed was a fixed 956×440 landscape interaction-test preview (roughly 52% of a 1596px-wide game area). Production `HuntEdictWindow` supplies no preview orientation and uses PC Fit. Final captures verify actual responsive fitting.

## Implementation

Applied sky/cream surfaces, navy outlines, downward hard shadows, dotted stitching, round gems, tabs, badges, cards, modifier sockets, passive medals, rank arcs, links, legend, detail panels, buttons and FX colors. Removed blurred detail artwork and retained all skill icon paths/art.

The generated catalog has 430 looks, 7 decorations and 105 palette tokens. Global theme ramps and `UiFonts.Body/Display/WebBody` remain unchanged; fonts are opt-in D4 assets. Titles use one mesh effect with reusable vertex buffers rather than eight Outline components per label.

Native checks exposed clipped `Ground Slam` linked text and `Bonus damage (3 shots)`. Their widths now use the actual Canvas scale. Descriptions use native wrapping. Modifier rows/passive effects reserve original reference flow heights even when the new font needs fewer lines. Actual scale changes cause one repaint. Partial-line measurement strips color tags and balances emphasis tags, fixing spurious English effect wrapping. Disabled controls use inert transparent raycast shields and the footer buttons render last, preventing selection/game click-through. Existing test tolerances and behavior assertions were retained.

## Golden invariants and strict conflict

All 12 viewmodel files, 6 interaction files, rules_golden, rank_values and panel_parts are byte identical to baseline. IDs, text, rules, point values, purchase/refund/selection/unlock and FX event meaning are unchanged. JS and C# each pass 55,803 reference checks.

The literal “only styles.json changes / raw layout diff=0” condition is not met because appearance is serialized inside layout. It was not silently reinterpreted as a pass. See [summary](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/final-golden-diff.json) and [all 3,600 changed paths](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/raw-layout-differences.json).

| File group | Exact difference |
|---|---|
| 9 layouts, 3,510 leaves | 1,436 stroke colors; 1,436 widths (2→3); 620 dashes (4 4→5 5); 18 radii (8→18 / 10→20) |
| 9 layout_scenarios, 90 leaves | plate hashes caused by radius changes |
| 18 picked scenes | only plate.radius; other coordinates/rectangles/text/IDs/state/scroll/bar/arc semantics unchanged |
| CSS geometry, 36 combinations | 49,942 strings; zero geometry and font-size difference groups after restoring inner dimensions |
| styles / fx | intentional new appearance and FX; two selected-key ring look variants added |

Old-color/2px-bar assumptions in extraction were repaired to read source structure/numbers without changing gameplay. JS/C# reference plate-radius appearance values were aligned to 18/20. The original raw-diff conflict is resolved for the raw appearance paths under the approval below.

## Approved criterion and separately reported dimensions

On 2026-10-14 the user approved “retain position, size, font size and behavior; permit only design-driven color, stroke and corner changes,” replying **“ㅇㅇ 그렇게 해줘”**. Body 400 and emphasis 700/900 remain approved. The [acceptance review](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/acceptance-review.json) classifies the existing 3,600 raw paths: 3,510 stroke.color/width/dash and plate.radius leaves, plus 90 radius-derived scenarios[].hashes.plate values. There are zero other raw paths. **These raw appearance differences satisfy the approved criterion.** The literal raw diff=0 result remains false in the historical proof.

Zero position/size difference refers to 18 picked-scene contracts: frame.w/h/scale, header/title/tab/close rect/container/gap/size, plate/panel rect and inner/scrollAxis, primitive rect/hit/face/icon.size, paths/bars/arcs. Font-size comparison has zero differences. Text/rules/behavior are supported by byte-identical 12 viewmodels, 6 interactions, rules/rank_values/panel_parts and the existing 60 real interaction transcripts. This is not pixel equality for every glyph or child RectTransform.

**Measured follow-up:** restored unnecessary CSS inner dimensions; 49,942 strings in 36 combinations now have zero geometry/font-size difference groups. Native text allocation retains the original slots where the approved 400 body and explicitly emphasized 700 text fit. Remaining expansions are quantified below and are not blanket-approved by the raw appearance criterion. The user subsequently authorized the five visual corrections and removal of the bottom legend. Final native validation of the latest corner/legend change also passed.

## Fonts

Official Google Fonts Jua and Noto Sans KR sources are hash-pinned; two SIL OFL licenses are bundled. Derivative family/PostScript names start with Hellscript. Subsets retain 2,350 KS X 1001 syllables, Latin and current design text. Noto covers all current characters. Jua lacks several body symbols, which remain in body/vector rendering.

| File | bytes | cmap characters |
|---|---:|---:|
| Jua-SkillSubset.ttf | 2035040 | 2448 |
| NotoSansKR-Skill400.ttf | 515376 | 2604 |
| NotoSansKR-Skill700.ttf | 515908 | 2604 |
| NotoSansKR-Skill900.ttf | 515760 | 2604 |

Total 3582084 bytes. Noto hhea/typo line metrics are normalized to 880 / -220 / 0 without altering outlines or advances. [Font validation](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/font-validation.json) includes output/source hashes. `build_skill_tree_d4_fonts.py` and pinned codepoints provide the recipe; original downloads are retained in the single task font-sources directory. WebBody is unchanged; no web player was built.

## Validation and evidence

- Initial skin implementation (**7ab84dc6**): **102 distinct related EditMode tests passed**: reused 38 unaffected results from the preceding 99/99 run and reran 64/64 for the final wrap/input changes. Panel 47/47 includes original browser geometry/clipping assertions, 12 linked/stat regressions and 3 rich-emphasis regressions. Footer overlap checks were strengthened.
- Looks check, golden verify (41 files), both 55,803 reference suites, UI contract (15 tests) and UI refresh checks passed.
- Initial implementation’s macOS player passed **60 transcripts / 1,662 clicks / 502 blocked / 2,016 panels / 84 captures**, covering 3 classes × KO/EN × 7 sizes × active/passive. Compared complete state, panel and semantic FX with goldens; checked text height, SafeArea and footer overlap. Six owned purchases were committed to a disposable save, then a separate process confirmed all three allocations and schema 22 survived restart. [Runtime receipt](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/native-receipt.json), [test provenance](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/editmode-provenance.json).
- Retained six preceding native attempts: 1–2 exposed linked/stat clipping; 3–5 reproduced/diagnosed disabled-button click-through; 6 passed behavior/84 captures before visual inspection exposed spurious emphasis wrapping/footer overlap. One player output and one fresh cache were reused.
- Actual before captures were reused from the verified integration. Native source 05973ea3 and baseline 53d6a3e1 have identical Assets, Packages and ProjectSettings trees; no fresh before-player run is claimed.

[Actual before/after](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/before-after.png) · [7 viewport sizes](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/viewport-contact-sheet.png) · [84-capture index](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/screenshots.json)

| Viewport | Observed result | Representative |
|---|---|---|
| 440×956 | Portrait scroll, fixed detail panel, SafeArea | [Warrior KO](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Warrior-ko-440x956.png) |
| 956×440 | Horizontal scroll, right panel; rich English effect fits, no footer overlap | [Ranger EN](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Ranger-en-956x440.png) |
| 1440×810 | PC fits full viewport | [Ranger KO](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Ranger-ko-1440x810.png) |
| 1440×900 | 1440×810 reference frame, 45px top/bottom margins | [Mage KO passive](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Mage-ko-1440x900-passive.png) |
| 1680×720 | 1280×720 frame, 200px left/right margins | [Warrior EN passive](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Warrior-en-1680x720-passive.png) |
| 1600×900 | PC fits full viewport | [Warrior KO](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Warrior-ko-1600x900.png) |
| 900×1600 | Portrait SafeArea contains title/close/fixed panel; scroll retained | [Mage EN passive](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Mage-en-900x1600-passive.png) |

Comparison preserves node geometry, state, KO/EN text and event meaning at locked type sizes. Remaining differences include the larger live-canvas type, its invalid transparent panel background, and uGUI/browser glyph/blur/antialias rendering. The follow-up repaired triangular large-panel corners and rectangular fade overlap; this still does not establish pixel-identical browser rendering. A fresh set of 24 locked casual browser reference renders was not generated; old dark references were not treated as casual references. Actual Claude and before/after native captures were inspected.

## Final visual repairs and 2868×1320 proof

Applied the user’s five corrections: contain the gauge within the rounded padding box and its 0.97 pressed scale; draw all link casings before colored cores; use angular circle fills and circular inset shadows; give large corners contour-aligned vertices and clip tree/fade through one rounded inner viewport mask; hide the unnecessary bottom legend. Model strings, frame/scroll dimensions and node placement remain intact.

[Gauge/link/circle comparison](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/visual-defects-before-after.png) · [Corner/legend comparison](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/corners-legend-before-after.png) · [Final Ranger EN](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Ranger-en-1600x900-visual-fix.png) · [Final Warrior KO 2868×1320](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/after/Warrior-ko-2868x1320.png)

Final affected EditMode **92/92**, final look-data **3/3**, UI-contract **15/15**, UI-refresh (191 sources/16 bindings) and golden verify **41** passed. No duplicate full-project suite was run. The final silent macOS development player checked three heroes × KO/EN × PC1600×900 / portrait900×1600 / landscape2868×1320: **864 panel states, 26 actual captures, 18 gauge/card pressed-scale checks, six pointer drags and six closes**. Captures wait five seconds for the finite glint (1.3s×3 plus at most720ms delay). [Source/binary/execution receipt](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/target-native-receipt.json). Earlier seven-size/60-transcript results remain evidence for the initial implementation, not a claim that all84 images were regenerated for this revision.

2868×1320 is the supplied render-pixel target, not an official device specification. Its 956×440 logical frame uses ConstantPixelSize Canvas scale **1.51074**, or **3.02148px/design point**. DPR **3** and synthetic insets left/right102px, bottom54px, top0px are assumptions. Content occupies **2513.87×1266px**, **87.65%** of screen width and **95.91%** of height. Fixed956×440 preview and real fitting are separately captured; Mac auto-PC uses1152×648. Framebuffer dimensions are asserted. Close/footer targets are44 design points (132.945px, assumed44.315 device points); active cards38 and modifier sockets32 do not all meet44pt. This is Mac simulation, not iOS hardware/DPR/safe-area/touch certification. Selection, horizontal drag and close use EventSystem raycasts/handlers.

Native internal-width audit: **1242/1272** stat slots, **1324/1944** modifier rank slots and **30/36** linked chips retain original widths. Remaining expansions are **0.037–2.818**, **0.061–0.386** and **2.036–4.076** design points respectively. Only English Ground Slam/Raking Wound names expand among linked chips; **0/36 chip row/position changes**. Corrected the early diagnostic’s52pt fixed portion to the original C#54pt. Ordinary body/effects are Noto400; the design explicitly uses Noto700 for chip names/ranks. [Per-state before/after widths and roles](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/geometry-native-audit.json) remain separately reviewable, without blanket approval under the raw appearance criterion. CSS geometry/font-size now has **zero** differences across49,942 strings/36 combinations.

Retained diagnostic failures separately: hidden-panel null handling, sandbox AppKit registration, and a pressed-gauge fixture selecting a rank0 Mage skill. Corrected each cause without weakening game rules or tolerances. One app output/cache was reused; older binaries were not copied.

## Handoff and retention

Local workspace: `task-6/skill-skin`. Code, related tests, bilingual report and shared rules are grouped in a local commit. Original checkout/uncommitted art transition documents are preserved and protected-path diffs are zero. [Lifecycle manifest](CasualSkillSkinEvidence20261014/artifact-lifecycle.json) records paths, measured sizes and retention; no blanket deletion or shared-cache removal occurred.

Unverified: Android/iOS devices, screen readers/touch accessibility, matched three-run before/after CPU/GC performance, WebGL, and the full EditMode suite after main integration. Performance is **unmeasured**. Wiki generation/check/publication remain at the merge stage. Review shared rules and strict conflicts before extending to another UI.

Fixed956×440 preview and real fitting are separately captured; Mac auto-PC uses1152×648. Framebuffer dimensions are asserted. Close/footer targets are44 design points (132.945px, assumed44.315 device points); active cards38 and modifier sockets32 do not all meet44pt. This is Mac simulation, not iOS hardware/DPR/safe-area/touch certification. Selection, horizontal drag and close use EventSystem raycasts/handlers.

Native internal-width audit: 1242/1272 stat slots, 1324/1944 modifier rank slots and 30/36 linked chips retain original widths. Remaining expansions are 0.037–2.818, 0.061–0.386 and 2.036–4.076 design points respectively. Only English Ground Slam/Raking Wound names expand among linked chips; 0/36 chip row/position changes. Corrected the early diagnostic’s52pt fixed portion to the original C#54pt. Ordinary body/effects are Noto400; the design explicitly uses Noto700 for chip names/ranks. Per-state before/after widths and roles remain separately reviewable, without blanket approval under the raw appearance criterion. CSS geometry/font-size now has zero differences across49,942 strings/36 combinations.

Retained diagnostic failures separately: hidden-panel null handling, sandbox AppKit registration, and a pressed-gauge fixture selecting a rank0 Mage skill. Corrected each cause without weakening game rules or tolerances. One app output/cache was reused; older binaries were not copied.

Handoff and retention

Local workspace: task-6/skill-skin. Code, related tests, bilingual report and shared rules are grouped in a local commit. Original checkout/uncommitted art transition documents are preserved and protected-path diffs are zero. Lifecycle manifest records paths, measured sizes and retention; no blanket deletion or shared-cache removal occurred.

Unverified: Android/iOS devices, screen readers/touch accessibility, matched three-run before/after CPU/GC performance, WebGL, and the full EditMode suite after main integration. Performance is unmeasured. Wiki generation/check/publication remain at the merge stage. Review shared rules and strict conflicts before extending to another UI.
