# Completed development integrated into main — 2026-09-27

Updated: 2026-09-27 · [한국어](Main_Integration_20260927.md)

Integrated first-play improvements, operational rewards and APK size optimization with the sound bank already in main. The newly active ElevenLabs production work is outside this completed-development batch.

## Included changes

| Work | Source commits | Scope |
| --- | --- | --- |
| First-play recovery and improvements | `522ea02a`, `a62a12cb` | D01–D09 implementation and focused validation. Natural Rift 20 progression for all three classes remains in progress. |
| Operational rewards | `a1bc4825` | 148 boxes, 22 operational packages and 30 reserved items. No automatic distribution or server campaign is activated. |
| APK size optimization | `0e8f095b` | Texture imports, unused build resources/packages and a release APK build path. |
| Existing sound bank | `d238fa0e`, main `dc5770b6` | Retains the already merged playback routing for 283 cues. |

The code integration is `138ba4b1`, followed by native receipt/restart coverage in `928dbf28` and count-neutral receipt wording in `d48a08e0`.

## Integration fixes

Preserve the potion category, equipment-slot choice and first-play receipts together. A visible receipt blocks another opening, and required choices remain validated before the transaction. Both sets of English localization additions are retained.

Operational `potion` grants now store their actual potion ID in the receipt and resolve its display name through the existing potion catalog. Existing tests cover all 44 potion definitions, actual stock, receipt identity and persistence. Native UI verified ten HP potions and five Crowned Diamond Elixirs, including reopening their persisted receipts in another process.

## Full regression suite

The full Edit Mode run finished with **4,091 total, 4,044 passed, 47 failed and zero skipped**. All 47 failures exactly match the independently reproduced earlier baseline; zero new failures were introduced by this integration. This is not an all-green result. See the [summary](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/validation.json) and [original XML](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/full-editmode.xml).

The full suite ran at `138ba4b1`. Subsequent changes only extend the native harness and adjust one English receipt sentence. Both final builds and the repeated 20-layout reward/restart acceptance use `d48a08e0`; the [source scope](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/source.json) records this distinction.

## Native and build evidence

- [Native evidence](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/native.json): 20 first-play layout combinations plus a separate-process restart; 20 operational reward combinations plus receipt reopening. Resolutions: 440×956, 956×440, 1600×900, 1600×1000 and 2100×900. Languages: KO/EN. Text scales: 100/150%.
- [Sound run](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/sound.txt): 85 distinct playback events and listener output across title, character selection, tutorial, three classes, services and settings; zero missing clips and zero logged errors. Directly invoked covered service buttons are explicitly identified in the original log.
- [Android release](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/android.json): IL2CPP, ARM64 and LZ4HC; build succeeded with zero errors, 70,585,750 bytes. This integrated APK is distinct from the optimization-only branch's 60,072,342-byte result.

Synthetic macOS input and Android packaging do not establish physical-device touch, thermal/battery performance or human listening approval. Disposable UI fixtures remain separate from the natural-progression account.

## Preservation and resumed progression

Pre-merge branch/worktree inventory and patches are preserved under `Artifacts/Integration20260927/`. The primary workspace received 1,072 previous playtest files with matching hashes. Intermediate validation work is retained as patches, stashes and recoverable archives; active work in other checkouts is preserved.

Natural progression resumes on the same shared guest account at normal 1× speed. Immediately before integration: Warrior level 8/highest clear 5; Ranger level 11/highest clear 5; Mage level 1/highest clear 0, with 14 completed run records. Attempted stages are not counted as clears. No level, currency or time is injected. All-class Rift 20 validation is not yet complete.

[First-play checks](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/firstplay-checks.txt) · [First-play restart](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/firstplay-restart.txt) · [Reward checks](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/operations-checks.txt) · [Reward restart](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/operations-restart.txt)

![Landscape English enlarged result](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/result-956x440-en-150.png)

![Reopened elixir receipt after restart](MainIntegration20260927Evidence/elixir-receipt-restarted.png)

# Completed development integration

The completed development branches were integrated in an isolated checkout on 2026-09-22. The original working directory and its uncommitted changes are preserved. Shared UI migration starts from this baseline.

## Scope

The baseline retains main `96e8094` (title, character selection, town, HUD, runes, Hunt Edict and set planning), shop/storage `665448b`, inventory/ranges `68e7373`, blacksmith HTML `0389d6d`, blacksmith runtime `1b56ef0`, and completed legendary expansion `5b083ab`. Ongoing game skill design, wiki registration and generated outputs from `codex/class-skill-design` are excluded. The Unity CLI development skill is preserved separately from game skill design.

The integrated catalog contains 30 equipment bases, 58 attributes, 54 affixes, 123 legendary items and 24 set items. Equipment positions, range display, enhancement stones, slot progression and transaction persistence coexist.

## Compatibility fixes

# Connecting Warrior Ground Slam hunt edicts

Date: September 13, 2026 · [한국어](Edict_Slam_Expansion.md)

Status: **All four W04 core options are connected. All 1,903 tests and three final macOS processes passed.**

## Scope

Continue from Warrior attack revision `f6f80ab` and independently connect all four W04 Ground Slam core options. Follow the ordinary-enemy, existing-control and boss policies in the [skill catalog](../Design/HELLSCRIPT_Hunt_Edict_Skill_Option_Catalog.md), and the [screen layout specification](../Design/HELLSCRIPT_Screen_Layout_Detail.md).

Claude's attributes, affixes and balance records remain on main. The [integration record](Attribute_Integration_Expansion.en.md) preserves the merge and subsequent review. At the user's request, the fully merged development branch was deleted locally and remotely. Further work proceeds on `main`.

## Combat decisions

| Setting | Connected behavior |
|---|---|
| Automatic use | OFF prevents ordinary and designated survival use. Missing, disabled or duplicated legacy rows cannot suppress or duplicate the independent core policy. Original rows remain unchanged. |
| Ordinary-enemy purpose | GROUP requires two ordinary/elite enemies within the real 3 m area. INTERRUPT requires an observed dangerous cast in progress. RETREAT requires a global emergency/dodge request and an opportunity for new control. |
| Existing control | DAMAGE imposes no control restriction. NEW_CONTROL requires an enemy with neither stun nor freeze. EXPIRING requires the longer remaining stun/freeze duration to be at most 0.35 s. This option does not restrict bosses. |
| Boss use | DAMAGE allows use during stagger or immunity. STAGGER requires neither state to be active. COMPLETE requires the existing 15-point credit to fill the current meter to 100. Ordinary-enemy opportunities are evaluated independently. |

These policies decide whether to cast. An actual cast still affects the full existing 3 m area; a boss excluded from the decision can still take real area damage. Visibility, walls, perception and pursuit exclusions are respected. A distant priority target does not hide a valid nearby group.

An observed cast is not immediately reported as successfully interrupted. A short enemy cast can release its hazard during Ground Slam's preparation; a later stun does not erase that hazard. A sufficiently long cast is interrupted by the actual hit and stun. Enemies leaving the area during preparation produce an actual miss.

## Survival order, action lifetime and saves

Designated global defense use respects the same ordinary-enemy and boss settings. A survival candidate must provide new control or complete boss stagger on impact. A previously selected emergency Leap Slam or walk is never delayed to prepare Ground Slam.

Ordinary group damage or boss damage alone cannot cancel an active attack. Actual ordinary-enemy interrupt/retreat opportunities obey the global cancellation permission, and travel/recovery locks remain in force. A lone boss cannot borrow the ordinary-enemy interrupt setting to cancel an unrelated attack.

Preserve base cost **0**, preparation **0.35 s**, cooldown **10 s**, damage coefficient **1.2** and ordinary-enemy stun **1.5 s**. Zero resource remains usable, and the existing LC02 discount is not consumed. Bosses receive the existing stagger credit, three-second stagger and immunity instead of direct stun. A committed preparation survives later setting edits and process restarts, completing only once without replaying damage, control or discounts.

## Validation and remaining work

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Full Unity Editor suite | **1,903 passed**, zero failures/skips. September 12, 2026, 21:09:41–21:15:02 UTC |
| Ground Slam coverage | **56 passed**, covering real radius, overlapping control, boss stagger, emergency priority, cancellation, misses and persistence. |
| Final native player | **Three processes passed**: save ordinary preparation, restore and stun two targets, save boss preparation, restore and complete actual stagger. |
| Visual review | **13 screenshots**, spanning KO/EN, 1280×720, 720×1280, 640×360 and 140% text. Reviewed the explanatory note, scroll body, fixed footer and action text; not every language/resolution combination was tested. |

The first test build referenced the wrong preparation-time field and failed compilation; the test was corrected. The next focused run revealed a test assumption that a short enemy cast produced a projectile. It actually releases a persistent hazard and replaces its action record, so the test now checks the actual RELEASE event and hazard. All 266 focused checks then passed. Two additional boss-only cancellation cases were included in the final 1,903-test result above. Earlier failures and intermediate player results are retained.

Keep the [validation summary](../../Artifacts/Validation/EdictSlam/validation-summary.json), [visual review](../../Artifacts/Validation/EdictSlam/visual-review.json), [source/player manifest](../../Artifacts/Validation/EdictSlam/validated-source.json) and [final macOS app](../../Builds/macOS-EdictSlam/HELLSCRIPT.app) together. Tests used isolated project copies and dedicated save directories.

This phase establishes functional integration, persistence and UI regression coverage, not new long-term balance results. W05, W06, Warrior BASIC, other class policies, generated-rift survival/interruption/progression/farming outcomes and mobile-device validation remain. No scene, prefab or package was replaced, and all 17 unrelated pre-existing working files are preserved.

# Content unlock implementation and validation

> Historical implementation record. The current gates and migration policy are documented in [Rift-based content unlocks](../Design/HELLSCRIPT_Rift_Content_Unlocks.en.md).

2026-09-12. HELLSCRIPT v0.1 test draft; these are not externally verified game values.

The actual project code, existing GDD and original workbook were updated. The current GDD was extended, not replaced with its attachment snapshot. The workbook preserves all 25 original sheets, 23 tables, 3,397 existing populated cells, formulas, styles and controls, and adds two sheets for unlock rules and U01–U30 validation. Runtime and workbook rules originate in `Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources/ContentUnlocks.json`.

Account services use the maximum actual rewarded clear across heroes (A). Training opens after the first ended attempt, including failure. Enhancement/offline open at A≥1, rare crafting at 3, gems at 5 or first legitimate acquisition, rerolls at 8, unidentified purchases at 10, sweep at 12, and core crafting at 15 or ten cores from one slot. Access is permanent and separate from guide completion. Sweep execution requires the selected hero's own H≥1 and uses H for rewards. New passive slots open at hero levels 3/6/10; legacy three-slot access and legal loadouts remain. Active skill levels and the four-skill limit are unchanged.

Run stage R controls encounters: basic first-theme melee enemies and BOSS01 at 1–5; existing mixed roles at 6; second theme and BOSS02 join at 11; up to two compatible elite traits at 20; BOSS03 joins at 21. Existing layout validation, encounter budgets, prior candidates and compatible trait rules remain. A single eligible boss can repeat; previous-boss exclusion remains when multiple candidates exist. Existing suspended runs are never regenerated.

Saved version-zero unlock state migrates once, retaining services universally available in the previous version, purchased capacity and three passive slots. Newly activated offline rewards never include pre-unlock time. Same-slot cores are not consumed to unlock a menu, and consuming them during crafting never revokes access. Legendary dismantling remains available before crafting unlocks. UI and execution paths both check permissions. Portal equipment/enhancement restrictions remain. Guides are optional, replayable and stored separately; first legendary/set guidance is retained independently of equipment permission.

The existing rarity source files and probability worksheet are preserved. Reroll cost remains `500*L+50*L*(L-1)` for `L=max(1,itemLevel)`, regardless of attempt count. At L=8, attempts 1/10/100 each cost 6,800 gold. Existing shop probabilities, prices and material costs remain. Existing in-progress dungeon, edict, gate, objective and concurrent localization changes were retained. Project settings match the initial working-copy snapshots. No packages, scenes or prefabs were changed, and no remote publishing or push was performed.

Final Unity Edit Mode suite: **1362 passed, zero failed**, including 37 unlock tests. A separate focused run passed 165 tests. Final macOS development build succeeded with zero errors. Automated native UI checks passed in Korean/English, portrait/landscape, covering locked services, failure-based training access, hero switching, personal sweep restrictions, guide skip/replay and gem dependency messaging. Seven screenshots were saved and reviewed. The final UI layout adjustment was subsequently compiled and exercised in the final build. Workbook formula and preservation checks passed using Artifact; native Microsoft Excel recalculation was not run.

Three fresh level-one heroes ran the actual stage-one simulation at seed 112358. Warrior failed at 80.45 seconds (45 kills, level 3), Ranger at 300 seconds (80 kills, level 5), and Mage at 42.15 seconds (24 kills, level 3). Navigation reported no errors. These results do not establish early-game balance or unavoidable-pattern fairness. Manual playtesting and Android/iOS device testing remain outstanding.

First enhancement requires 200 gold and 20 materials; stage-one boss plus first-clear rewards supply 1,950 gold and 15 materials, leaving five materials to acquire through existing chests/dismantling. Stage-three rare crafting needs 1,500 gold and 50 materials. Rerolls require suitable affixes and gold; stage-fifteen core access does not guarantee ten same-slot cores. No free currencies, gems, recipes or stat buffs were invented.

**Remaining dependencies:** real gem items, acquisition/consumption, sockets and synthesis recipes/results are absent from the existing project. Access state, a future acquisition hook and an explicit unavailable menu are implemented; gem execution is not. Authenticated account/cloud infrastructure is also absent. `MergeVerified` is a union boundary for already-verified entitlements, not a live server or cross-device solution. Actual multi-device/offline conflict testing remains unperformed.

See [the Korean report](Content_Unlock_Expansion.md) for the full condition table, U01–U30 outcomes and absolute changed-file links. Evidence is under `Artifacts/Validation/ContentUnlock/`; the runnable development build is `Builds/ContentUnlock/HELLSCRIPT.app`.

## Commit and wiki verification

The commit includes only the content-unlock changes and wiki updates, separated from concurrent dungeon, edict and localization work. A project exported from the Git index passed all 1,258 Edit Mode tests (0 failures), independently of the 1,362-test Work snapshot above. The wiki reads nine unlock definitions directly from the shared JSON, displays hero-level passive slots, and links the specification and bilingual implementation record. Six wiki tests and the staged-source wiki validation passed (91 documents, 18 databases). Ignored local evidence and built players remain local dependencies of the existing wiki workflow.

The staged-source macOS development build succeeded with zero errors. Its Korean/English portrait/landscape unlock smoke passed with `HELLSCRIPT_UNLOCK_RUNTIME_OK`; seven screenshots were saved, and the new-account Korean screen and unlocked English list were visually inspected.

A project exported from the Git index passed all 1,258 Edit Mode tests (0 failures), independently of the 1,362-test Work snapshot above. The wiki reads nine unlock definitions directly from the shared JSON, displays hero-level passive slots, and links the specification and bilingual implementation record. Six wiki tests and the staged-source wiki validation passed (91 documents, 18 databases). Ignored local evidence and built players remain local dependencies of the existing wiki workflow.

The staged-source macOS development build succeeded with zero errors. Its Korean/English portrait/landscape unlock smoke passed with HELLSCRIPT_UNLOCK_RUNTIME_OK; seven screenshots were saved, and the new-account Korean screen and unlocked English list were visually inspected.

pages.body:
# D4 Skill Tree: Warrior combat research (read-only)

**Paths.** W=/Users/t8g-2410-pn-005/Documents/MyProject/HELLSCRIPT/wt-d4-skill-plan; R=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Runtime/Core; T=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Tests/Editor; J=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources/Data; D=W/Docs; X=W/tools. Aliases in R/: Sk=CombatSimulation.ClassSkills.cs, Fx=...ClassSkillEffects.cs, Au=...ClassSkillAuto.cs, Ps=...ClassSkillPassives.cs, Po=...ClassSkillPolicies.cs, Id=...SkillIdentity.cs (no plain SkillIdentity.cs exists), Sim=CombatSimulation.cs, Act=...Actions.cs, Dmg=...Damage.cs, Eff=...Effects.cs, Cs=...ClassSets.cs, Rules=...Rules.cs, Cat=ClassSkills.cs, Tree=ClassSkillTree.cs, SE=SkillEffects.cs, GC=GameCatalog.cs. Other bare names starting Edict, Forecast, Field, Monsters, MonsterTraits, Attributes, Legendaries, ClassSkillValidation are CombatSimulation.<name> in R/. Any other bare name is in R/ (test names in T/). Data: CS=J/ClassSkills.json, RP/CAT=D/Design/ClassSkills/runtime_parameters.json / catalog.json, SD4=D/Design/D4SkillTree/skill_tree_d4.json, Plan=D/Implementation/D4_Skill_Tree_Plan_20261012.md. Classes: A=parameter only, B=new behaviour on an existing path, C=new mechanic or state.

## A. Framework

**Two engines (key finding).** W01-W06 and WP01-WP06 are `legacy:true` (actives CS:78-340).
- They run on the hero-action state machine: `TryCastClassSkillCore` calls `StartHeroAction` (Sk:155-158, Act:49-82), `ResolveSkill` applies the effect (Sim:291-353), and W01 is a channel (`TickChannel`, Sim:446-461).
- Their numbers come from GC:467-472, SE and literals (W01 `.5f`/`.25f` Sim:458, W02 `1.8f` Sim:304, W04 stun `1.5f` Sim:323), not CS keys. Editing CS.json for them changes nothing in combat except W02's damagePerMeter (Ps:106); RP has rows only for W02, W05, W06 (RP:597,615,618).
- W07+ are native: `ClassSkillCast` plus the `ResolveClassSkill` switch (Fx:93-163), values via `N(id,key)` (Sk:28).
- Of the ten new Warrior actives, W01-W06 are legacy; W08, W09, W17, W18 are native.

**Definition.** `ClassSkillDefinition` (Cat:9-23). X/class_skill_runtime.py:8-14 merges CAT `parameters` (cooldownSeconds, resourceCost) with RP numbers (range, radius, coefficient, duration, period, targets, prepare, width, secondary, skill keys) into CS. `ClassSkills.Data` hard-requires 111 skills and unlock<=40 (Cat:52-56).

**Loadout/ranks.** `ClassSkillLoadout` (Cat:73-173) holds `actives[4]`, `ultimate`, and `ranks` = `SkillInvestment{id,rank}` (Cat:72,79). `Rank(id)` defaults to 1 (Cat:84). Tree versions 3/4 (v4 allows rank 0 = unlearned) use `Remaining=level-Spent` (Tree:25-28). Combat reads `Loadout` = `State.build.classSkills`, or a deep copy under the recommended edict (Sk:23, HuntEdictDefaults.cs:11-18). `ProjectLegacy` writes the 12-slot `build.skillRanks` that legacy code reads (Cat:168, Sim:277).

**Auto-cast.** Every 0.2 s (Sim:241-247) `DecideEdictActions` (EdictOrder.cs:191), or directly (Sim:246), calls `TryAutomaticClassSkill(category)` (EdictOrder.cs:224). That walks `Loadout.order` (Sk:179-201).
- Native ids: `InspectClassSkill` (Sk:116-140: equipped/unlocked/busy/cooldown/resource/range, id lists Sk:134-136, AUTO_OFF). Then `ClassAutoCondition` (Po:60-110) falls to the hard-coded `ClassAutoDefaultCondition` switch (Au:97-147) unless a non-NATIVE option applies.
- Legacy ids: the condition is always true (Au:104). Real gating is in the edict planners (`InspectRuleCore`, Rules:159-262: `PlanEdictWhirlwind/Leap/IronWall/Shout/Slam`, and `PlanEdictAim` for W03), then `TryClassLegacyAutomatic` to `StartHeroAction` (Au:10-26).
- Buff vs attack category: `EdictRuleOrder.BuffSkill` (HuntEdictV2.Order.cs:49).

**Cast execution, cooldown, resource.**
- Native: `ClassSkillCast` is built at Sk:160, then `CaptureClassCast` (Ps:20-46). Cost and cooldown are set at Sk:161-164 (`CS.cooldowns`; the two ultimates share one timer, floor 45 s). Release comes after `prepare` (Sk:167-174, 214), then `AfterClassCast` (Ps:47-56). Lingering effects and dots live in `TickClassEffect` (Fx:182-238) and `Dot/TickClassDots` (Fx:37-78).
- Legacy: cooldown is `State.cooldowns[i]` (Act:73, ticked Sim:234) and cost is `Cost()` (Sim:283-290). A `ClassSkillCast` is still registered (`OriginalClassCast`, Sk:220-224, Act:66) with `rankScale` hard-coded to 1 (Sk:223).
- Resource gain is `Resource()` (Sk:76-80); regen is Po:198-212.
- Effects whose source skill is unequipped are purged every tick (Sk:239), so modifier effects must carry the base skill id as `source`. Persistent effects are whitelisted (ClassSkillPersistence.cs:47-48).

**Passives and rank scaling.**
- `Passive(id)` and `PV=value*RankScale` (Sk:30-31); passive effects are inline hooks in Ps.
- Legacy first-row passives read `SE.PassiveBase` (SE:14) in Dmg:30-31, CombatSimulation.Passives.cs:28-35, Economy.cs:129-131,191.
- Native `RankScale`=1+0.1(r-1), with ultimates fixed at 1 (Cat:65), applied by hand per effect (`a.rankScale` Fx:12-13,40,100-126).
- Legacy rank scaling comes from `SE.Power/ShieldFraction/ShoutResource` (SE:27-34) and `runeSkillPower` in `CaptureDamage` (Sim:494), used by `Hit` (Dmg:66-67). So `SkillHit(secondary)` on a legacy cast ignores base rank unless Sk:223 changes.
- Run validation caps rankScale at 1.401 (ClassSkillPersistence.cs:37).

**Direct hits.** There are four definitions:
- `DirectHit(kind)`=Direct|Basic (Attributes.cs:77: elite runes, set hooks, the `AfterClassHit` direct block Ps:133-153).
- "Normal direct"=`Normal(id)&&Kind.Direct` (Ps:103,122: additive bonuses such as WP15/WP17, proc passives).
- Legendaries fire for any non-passive class-skill id whatever the kind, bleed ticks included (Legendaries.cs:46,83-88).
- Secondary hits use `Kind.Set` and an `EXTRA:` id, which is non-native, so they count for none of the above (Fx:12, Ps:121).

**Use options (55 groups, 166 choices; the brief's 164 is wrong, X/class_skill_options.py:10).**
- An option is `{id,choice}` in `Loadout.options` (ClassSkillOptions.cs:21,34-61). Every consumer is a decision site: `UseChoice` in `PolicyTargetEligible`, `ClassAutoCondition`, positioning intents (Po:10-219), journal (Sk:152), read model (ClassSkillReadModel.cs:34).
- `LEGACY` choices only patch HuntEdictV2 option values (ClassSkillOptions.cs:62-73) that planners read (HuntEdictV2.Options.cs:40-75).
- `ResolveClassSkill` and `ResolveSkill` never read them. Choices change WHEN, WHERE and AT WHOM, never WHAT.
- The `{id,choice}` shape could hold a modifier id but should not:
  - `HuntEdictDefaults.Skills` clears `options` (HuntEdictDefaults.cs:14).
  - `Validate` caps entries at 55 and strips defaults (ClassSkillOptions.cs:46,55).
  - There is no rank field.
  - Quick-preset code treats every group of a skill as a use policy (HuntEdictQuickPresets.cs:129,190, HuntEdictSkillPresets.cs:78).
- Plan 7 already stores `{id,rank,modifier,modifierRank}` on `SkillInvestment`.

**Best extension point.** Add `modifier`+`modifierRank` to `SkillInvestment` (Cat:72) and resolve once per cast into `ClassSkillCast` (ClassSkillState.cs:28-38, serialized in `CS.casts`) inside `CaptureClassCast` (Ps:20). Both engines call it (Sk:161, 223).
- The cast object already carries per-cast tweaks for legacy skills: `ClassArea(root)` (Sim:313,320, Cs:42) and `ClassTiming(root)` (Act:66, Cs:43).
- Effects read `Cast(root)` (Sk:54). Decision-side code (planners, cost, forecast, aim) has no cast yet and uses a loadout accessor beside `RankScale` (Sk:29).
- Native parameter-only modifiers can overlay `N()` (Sk:28).
- Fall back to the loadout when `Cast(root)` is null. Legacy casts are purged after 30 s without effects (Sk:218), and a W01 channel is not `CS.action`.

Call sites:
- Capture: Sk:159-161, 223, Ps:20-46.
- Native effects: Fx:93-163,182-238, 37-78, Ps:99-193, Id:77-90.
- Legacy effects: Sim:291-353,446-461, 283, Act:57,73,97-101, SE:29-30.
- Decisions: Sk:116-140, Au:55-147, Po:50-59, Rules:159-262, EdictWarrior.cs:24-98, EdictAim.cs:35-80, EdictSlam.cs:18-56, EdictWarriorSupport.cs:11-91, Forecast.cs:87-98, EdictWhirlwindMovement.cs:10-45.
- Read models: ClassSkillReadModel.cs:17-28, SkillProgressionInfo.cs:16-41.
- Codec: ClassSkillCodec.cs:42-49. New fields break its canonical-JSON comparison for old HED4 codes.

## B. Per skill (CS = current values, SD4 = spec)

### W09 Raking Wound (T1 generator, native, SD4:259-345)
- Where: `ResolveClassSkill` case Fx:105; ledger `Dot/CashDot/TickClassDots` Fx:37-78; auto Au:109, aim Au:85.
- CS:1316: cooldown 4, cost 15, range/radius 3, coefficient .5, width 90, duration 4, period 1, targets 5, prepare .35, secondary 1.2.
- Now: up to 5 enemies (lowest ids, Sim:487-488) in a 90 degree cone take D50% plus a D120% bleed bank ticking each second (Fx:52,72). A recast keeps the larger remainder (Fx:48-51). The spec swaps cost 15 for "+8 to 12 resource on hit", and Au:109 (unbled elite or 3+ near) suits a spender, not a generator.
- W09-1 B: cast counter via `Counter()` (Sk:35-39); every 3rd cast runs `CashDot`+`Heal` (reuse W10, Fx:106-108). W10 hooks Au:110, Po:39,89 become dead.
- W09-2 B: hit `Enemy(a.target)`. Stacks are extra ledger entries via `Dot(additiveBank,cap)` (Fx:43-47); stack count = entry count.
- W09-3 A: `width` 90 to 360 (arc>=360 skips the angle test, Sim:488) and `duration`. Po:53, Au:85 read the same keys. A shorter duration raises DPS (`bank/duration`, Fx:52).

### W08 Impaling Hook (T1, native, SD4:354)
- Where: Fx:101-104; MISS check Sk:170; target-required lists Sk:134, Au:51,107-108.
- CS:1246: cooldown 7, range 6, coefficient .65, targets 1, prepare .3, resourceGain 10, pullMeters 2.
- Now: one target takes D65% and is pulled up to 2 m (bosses get a 0.5 s stun instead, Fx:17-36). Resource is +10 times rankScale (14 at rank 5; the spec's 10 to 18 needs explicit from/to). Au:108 (target beyond 3 m) fits a pull, not a generator.
- W08-1 B: reuse W11's mover (prepare+.25 s, `Lerp` in `TickClassSkills`, Sk:159,213; walking is blocked while `CS.action` runs, Sim:364) toward a stop-short point. Add W08 to the landing list (Sk:136). Extra resource on arrival.
- W08-2 B: `Line(origin,aim,6,width,3..7)` (Sk:95-100; add a width key), `SkillHit` each, `Pull` only the last.
- W08-3 B (absorbs W07): `ApplyStatus(Mark,"W07",6)` (Fx:98-100; Eff:106-107 clears other marks). Guard is literal `.1f` in `ClassGuard` (Ps:179, cap .5 Ps:190). Kill resource needs a new bit in `ClassHitFlags` (Ps:94-98) read in `AfterClassHit`. Traps: hard-coded "W07" in `HasAmplifyingMark` (Sk:90; otherwise the brand amplifies damage like a Ranger mark), Ps:179, Au:51; DES_LW41 (Fx:103).

### W01 Whirlwind (T2 core, legacy, SD4:449)
- Where: `StartHeroAction` Act:61,80; `TickChannel` Sim:446-461; `MoveEdictWhirlwind` EdictWhirlwindMovement.cs:10-45; `PlanEdictWhirlwindCandidate` EdictWarrior.cs:25-50.
- GC:467/CS:78: cost 6, coefficient .5, range/radius 2.5, cooldown 0; literals `.25f`, `.5f`, `RuneSkillRadius(0,2.5f)` (Sim:451,453,458).
- Now: every 0.25 s it pays 6 and hits all enemies within 2.5 m for D50%. It ends after 0.5 s with no enemy, no resource, or an edict rule (Sim:451-457, EdictWarrior.cs:125-140). The hero may walk meanwhile (Sim:364). Rank D50 to 70 already matches +10%/rank (Sim:494, Dmg:66-67); cost 6 to 4 has no rank term (Sim:283-290).
- W01-1 B: x2-3 must be applied after the `SpeedWithBonus` cap of 1.5x (Economy.cs:45, Field.cs:14-19), in EdictWhirlwindMovement.cs:40 and Sim:437. It may outrun targets and trip the 0.5 s empty cutoff. `HeroPace` slows still multiply (MonsterTraits.cs:13-20).
- W01-2 A: scale inside `RuneSkillRadius` (RuneCombatBonuses.cs:45). Every site funnels through it (Sim:451,458, EdictWarrior.cs:29, EdictWarriorSupport.cs:67, Forecast.cs:95-96), but the walker still hugs at 2.3-2.5 m (EdictWhirlwindMovement.cs:29, Sim:393).
- W01-3 A: interval literal at Act:80, Sim:458. Each tick also pays cost, pulls (Sim:460) and rolls crit, so cost per second doubles at x0.5 unless scaled.

### W03 Crushing Blow (T2, legacy, SD4:544)
- Where: `ResolveSkill` Crush case Sim:312-318; `PlanEdictAim` EdictAim.cs:35-80; `ForecastAttack` Forecast.cs:97-98; timing CombatActions.cs:95.
- GC:469: cost 25, coefficient 2.2, range/radius 3, prepare .65/attack speed.
- Now: 100 degree cone, radius `RuneSkillRadius(2,3)*ClassArea` (Sim:313); every enemy takes D220% (LW03 single bonus and SWB4 extra hit, Sim:315-317). The spec text calls the base a "single strike": mismatch.
- W03-1 B (cone to circle): arc 100 to 360 and radius 2 to 3 at Sim:313, Forecast.cs:98 (50 degree test), EdictAim.cs:20, Cs:136. `Cast.area` can carry the radius (Cs:42).
- W03-2 B: coefficient x2 when `health<=maxHealth*threshold` (same test as WP06, Dmg:31). Refund amount is unspecified.
- W03-3 B: `ScheduleExtra` "burst" x2 at +1 s (Cs:111-114, Fx:233). It is `Kind.Set`, so no WP15/WP17/legendary credit.

### W05 Iron Wall (T3, legacy, SD4:639)
- Where: `ResolveSkill` Shield case Sim:324 (4 s literal) into `AddShield` Eff:22; `PlanEdictIronWall` EdictWarriorSupport.cs:11-37; guard Act:117.
- GC:471: cooldown 14, 30% max HP (SE:31), prepare .2. Now: one shield (replaces its own, capped by max HP, Eff:24-33) times `shieldMultiplier` (WP05).
- W05-1 B (W12): the counter is `AfterClassHurt` (Ps:164-165; 2 counters, 1 s apart). Gate on `OwnIronWall` (EdictWarriorSupport.cs:9). W12's +15% block (Ps:192) is not in the spec.
- W05-2 B (W16): `ClearHeroControl` + `Buff("W16:immune")` (Fx:120-126, MonsterTraits.cs:25; `HeroControlImmune` keys on that id, Monsters.cs:88). W16 special cases (Sk:190, EdictOrder.cs:132, Au:116) must retarget.
- W05-3 B: `ReactShield` already runs per absorbing shield (Id:77-90, Eff:75). Reflect absorbed x fraction to `Nearby(..,3)` as secondary damage (not the thorns stat, Attributes.cs:115).
- Risk: the `IronWallAmount` precheck uses literal .3 (EdictWarriorSupport.cs:10).

### W06 Battle Shout (T3, legacy, SD4:734)
- Where: `ResolveSkill` Shout case Sim:325 (`shoutTime=6`), bonus in `CaptureDamage` (Sim:494), `PlanEdictShout` EdictWarriorSupport.cs:71-91. GC:472: cooldown 16; 40 resource and +20% (SE:32-33) equal the spec at rank 5.
- W06-1 A: add `shoutTime>0` to `ClassMoveBonus` (Ps:168-174); total is capped at +50% (Economy.cs:45). CC reduction exists only in behaviourKo.
- W06-2 B: `ClassAttackSpeedBonus` (Ps:193) feeds a hard 1.5 cap (Act:57). Skip the refill in Sim:325 and in `PlanEdictShout` (EdictWarriorSupport.cs:85).
- W06-3 B (W15): loan `BorrowResource/RepayResource` (Id:22-38; repaid by regen Po:203, close hits Id:63 and blocks Ps:162) differs from the spec's "regen pauses 6 s". The loan validator is keyed to "W15" (ClassSkillPersistence.cs:47-50).

### W02 Leap Slam (T4, legacy, SD4:829)
- Where: `TickHeroAction` lerp Act:97-101 (timing .15+.45, CombatActions.cs:94); `ResolveSkill` Leap case Sim:298-311 (radius 2.5, literal 1.8f :304); `ClassLanding` Ps:57-69; `PlanEdictLeapCandidate` EdictWarrior.cs:64-98 (2-8 m).
- GC:468, RP:597: cooldown 8, coefficient 1.8, range 8, radius 2.5, damagePerMeter .15 (Ps:106).
- Now: a lerp jump (no body collision), then D180% in 2.5 m. Cooldown 8 to 6.4 equals the escape curve (SkillProgression.cs:57), but Leap is not `Escape` (SE:28-29).
- W02-1 C: shove along the path via `Line`+`BreakFront` (Id:11-21; W11 Fx:109-112) with new push/width keys.
  - Decide whether landing damage stays.
  - The presentation arc `HeroAirHeight` (Act:28) must be off.
  - `EdictLeapLandingValid` has a 2 m minimum (EdictWarrior.cs:51).
  - The "space" policy (Po:177) changes meaning.
- W02-2 B: schedule a "burst" +2 s plus stun at `ClassLanding` (`ApplyStatus`, Eff:95-115; "burst" needs a stun branch).
- W02-3 C: there is no charge concept. `State.cooldowns[]` is read by planners (EdictWarrior.cs:79), LW04 (Dmg:156-157), ReduceCooldown (Legendaries.cs:111,128) and the read model (ClassSkillReadModel.cs:24-25).

### W04 Ground Slam (T4, legacy, SD4:924)
- Where: `ResolveSkill` Slam case Sim:319-323 (circle radius 3*`ClassArea`, stun literal 1.5 s); `PlanEdictSlam` EdictSlam.cs:18-56 (uses W03's rune index 2 at :35; literal 15 boss credit :50). GC:470: cooldown 10, coefficient 1.2, prepare .35.
- Now: D120% and a 1.5 s stun in 3 m; bosses gain control meter (Eff:98-103). The spec's stun 1.5 to 1.9 is new.
- W04-1 B: `Pull` (Fx:17-36) before `AreaHit`. A 5 m radius needs pull-to-hero (W13 pulled 1.5 m).
- W04-2 B (circle to line): `Line()` (Sk:95-100) + Slow (W14, Fx:118) in the Slam case. Update Forecast.cs:87-98, EdictSlam.cs:35, EdictWarriorSupport.cs:67; DES_LW44 (Ps:44, Sk:250).
- W04-3 B: stomp at release, two scheduled bursts at +0.6/+1.2 s, stun on the last; anchor to `a.origin`. Follow-ups are `Kind.Set`, so no WP17.

### W17 War of the Ancestors (T5, native, SD4:1019)
- Where: `ResolveClassSkill` Fx:127-129; `TickClassEffect` ancestor case Fx:213-217. CS:1868: cooldown 60, range 6, coefficient .65, duration 8, period 1, summons 2, ticks 8, guard .15.
- Now: 2 ancestors hit the hero's nearest enemy each second as secondary damage. `RankScale` is 1 for ultimates (Cat:65), so the spec needs +20%/rank and cooldown 60/55/50. W17 and W18 share one timer, floored at 45 s (Sk:163) and validated 45-60 (ClassSkillPersistence.cs:26).
- W17-1 A: `summons`, `duration`, `ticks`.
- W17-2 C: there is no last-skill record. Add a field to `ClassSkillRuntimeState` (ClassSkillState.cs:39-53) and a replay. Copies must skip `CaptureClassCast` (WP15 history, Ps:25-26) and use `EXTRA:` ids.

### W18 Titan's Judgment (T5, native, SD4:1097)
- Where: Fx:130-132; W03/W04 +25% for 6 s (Ps:108). CS:1942: cooldown 60, radius 4, coefficient 6, duration 6, targets 8, prepare .9, stun 2.
- W18-1 A: `prepare` is read before the cast exists (Sk:159), so the accessor goes there. The hero is busy 1.8 s (Act:26).
- W18-2 C: a form buff replacing the strike: area +50% (via `Cast.area`, Cs:44-45, which W01/W02 ignore) and knockback immunity (`PushHero`, Monsters.cs:96). A persistent effect needs a ClassSkillPersistence.cs:47-48 whitelist entry.

### Absorbed legacy skills (all native; reuse as noted)
- W07 (to W08-3): Fx:98-100, CS:1174: cd 10, range 8, 6 s, gain 10, guard .1. Brands one enemy (clears older brands), +10 resource, branded attacker deals 10% less (Ps:179). Reuse status+guard; rename "W07" literals.
- W10 (to W09-1): Fx:106-108, CS:1378: cd 8, radius 4, coef .8, heal .01, cap 5. D80% in 4 m, cashes only the W09 ledger, heals 1% per enemy (max 5). Reuse `CashDot`+`Heal`.
- W11 (to W02-1): Fx:109-112, Sk:213, Id:11-21, CS:1449: cd 9, coef .9, push 1.8, guard .15, gain 15. Dashes 4 m, shoves enemies sideways, grants guard and resource (not in spec).
- W12 (to W05-1): Fx:113-115, Ps:164-165,192, CS:1523: cd 12, cost 10, block .15, 2 counters, coef .8. 4 s stance, +15% block, counters.
- W13 (to W04-1): Fx:116-117, CS:1594: cd 10, cost 15, radius 4, coef .7, pull 1.5. Hits then pulls 1.5 m (spec: pull first).
- W14 (to W04-2): Fx:118, CS:1660: cd 6, cost 20, range 7, width 1, coef 1.5, slow .3 for 3 s. Line hit plus slow.
- W15 (to W06-3): Fx:119, Id:9-38, CS:1726: cd 18, gain 60, repay 4. Instant 60 resource, debt repaid by regen/hits.
- W16 (to W05-2): Fx:120-126, CS:1797: cd 16, barrier .12, immune 2, duration 5. Barrier, clears control, 2 s immunity.
- Cleanup:
  - One option group per non-passive skill is enforced (ClassSkillPolicyTests.cs:58-59).
  - DES_LW41-45 hooks (Fx:103,105,107,115,117,122-125, Ps:44,61) apply only with the modifier (Plan 12).
  - The `BuffSkill` list (HuntEdictV2.Order.cs:49) needs updating.
  - All 10 Warrior validation builds use removed ids.

## C. Passives

| Passive | Applied at | Rank 1 to 5 today vs SD4 |
|---|---|---|
| WP01 | Dmg:30-31 (3+ enemies within 3 m, frozen at cast, Sim:496); `SE.PassiveBase[0]`=25 | 25 to 35 = spec (x(1+.1(r-1)), SE:23, SkillProgression.cs:56; SD4:1197) |
| WP06 | Dmg:31, per target at or below 30% HP; base 35 | 35 to 49 = spec |
| WP05 | Economy.cs:191 adds to `shieldMultiplier`; base 40 | 40 to 56 = spec |
| WP04 | CombatSimulation.Passives.cs:28-35, once per 20 ticks; base 2 | 2 to 2.8 = spec |
| WP13 | Ps:167, `health<.7*hp` (strict) | .4 to .56 = spec |
| WP15 | Ps:25-26 (4 s window, `Offensive` skills only) | .2 to .28 = spec |
| WP17 | Ps:22,27,103-105; ratio captured before cost (Sk:160, Act:66-67); W03/W04 direct hits | .15 to .21 = spec |
| WP09 | Ps:163 (`Proc`, 1 s per root) | 18 x1.4 = 25.2, SD4 says 26 (SD4:1277): needs from/to |

The four legacy passives need no change. WP20 (40 to 80) and WP21 (6 to 10) are not x1.4, so rank tables must be data (Plan 5.3). Key passives are absent from data: `ClassSkills.Data` counts 111 (Cat:52), `Canonical` needs one rank per definition (Cat:122), and unlock Lv45 exceeds the 40 caps (Cat:55,62,137, Tree:42). Ablation tooling assumes one `value` key (ClassSkillPassiveMeasurement.cs:45-46).

**WP20 Blood Frenzy.**
- Bleed crit: `TickClassDots` calls `ApplyOutgoing(..,critMultiplier 1,critical false)` (Fx:73). Under `Passive("WP20")&&d.id=="W09"`, roll `RandomStream.Unit(ref State.rng)<Mathf.Min(.75f,d.snapshot.crit)` and use `snapshot.critDamage`, as `Hit` does (Dmg:69-73); `CashDot` (Fx:62) likewise.   • W02-1 C: shove along the path via Line+BreakFront (Id:11-21; W11 Fx:109-112) with new push/width keys.
  • Decide whether landing damage stays.
  • The presentation arc HeroAirHeight (Act:28) must be off.
  • EdictLeapLandingValid has a 2 m minimum (EdictWarrior.cs:51).
  • The "space" policy (Po:177) changes meaning.
  • W02-2 B: schedule a "burst" +2 s plus stun at ClassLanding (ApplyStatus, Eff:95-115; "burst" needs a stun branch).
  • W02-3 C: there is no charge concept. State.cooldowns[] is read by planners (EdictWarrior.cs:79), LW04 (Dmg:156-157), ReduceCooldown (Legendaries.cs:111,128) and the read model (ClassSkillReadModel.cs:24-25).

W04 Ground Slam (T4, legacy, SD4:924)

  • Where: ResolveSkill Slam case Sim:319-323 (circle radius 3*ClassArea, stun literal 1.5 s); PlanEdictSlam EdictSlam.cs:18-56 (uses W03's rune index 2 at :35; literal 15 boss credit :50). GC:470: cooldown 10, coefficient 1.2, prepare .35.
  • Now: D120% and a 1.5 s stun in 3 m; bosses gain control meter (Eff:98-103). The spec's stun 1.5 to 1.9 is new.
  • W04-1 B: Pull (Fx:17-36) before AreaHit. A 5 m radius needs pull-to-hero (W13 pulled 1.5 m).
  • W04-2 B (circle to line): Line() (Sk:95-100) + Slow (W14, Fx:118) in the Slam case. Update Forecast.cs:87-98, EdictSlam.cs:35, EdictWarriorSupport.cs:67; DES_LW44 (Ps:44, Sk:250).
  • W04-3 B: stomp at release, two scheduled bursts at +0.6/+1.2 s, stun on the last; anchor to a.origin. Follow-ups are Kind.Set, so no WP17.

W17 War of the Ancestors (T5, native, SD4:1019)

  • Where: ResolveClassSkill Fx:127-129; TickClassEffect ancestor case Fx:213-217. CS:1868: cooldown 60, range 6, coefficient .65, duration 8, period 1, summons 2, ticks 8, guard .15.
  • Now: 2 ancestors hit the hero's nearest enemy each second as secondary damage. RankScale is 1 for ultimates (Cat:65), so the spec needs +20%/rank and cooldown 60/55/50. W17 and W18 share one timer, floored at 45 s (Sk:163) and validated 45-60 (ClassSkillPersistence.cs:26).
  • W17-1 A: summons, duration, ticks.
  • W17-2 C: there is no last-skill record. Add a field to ClassSkillRuntimeState (ClassSkillState.cs:39-53) and a replay. Copies must skip CaptureClassCast (WP15 history, Ps:25-26) and use EXTRA: ids.

W18 Titan's Judgment (T5, native, SD4:1097)

  • Where: Fx:130-132; W03/W04 +25% for 6 s (Ps:108). CS:1942: cooldown 60, radius 4, coefficient 6, duration 6, targets 8, prepare .9, stun 2.
  • W18-1 A: prepare is read before the cast exists (Sk:159), so the accessor goes there. The hero is busy 1.8 s (Act:26).
  • W18-2 C: a form buff replacing the strike: area +50% (via Cast.area, Cs:44-45, which W01/W02 ignore) and knockback immunity (PushHero, Monsters.cs:96). A persistent effect needs a ClassSkillPersistence.cs:47-48 whitelist entry.

Absorbed legacy skills (all native; reuse as noted)

  • W07 (to W08-3): Fx:98-100, CS:1174: cd 10, range 8, 6 s, gain 10, guard .1. Brands one enemy (clears older brands), +10 resource, branded attacker deals 10% less (Ps:179). Reuse status+guard; rename "W07" literals.
  • W10 (to W09-1): Fx:106-108, CS:1378: cd 8, radius 4, coef .8, heal .01, cap 5. D80% in 4 m, cashes only the W09 ledger, heals 1% per enemy (max 5). Reuse CashDot+Heal.
  • W11 (to W02-1): Fx:109-112, Sk:213, Id:11-21, CS:1449: cd 9, coef .9, push 1.8, guard .15, gain 15. Dashes 4 m, shoves enemies sideways, grants guard and resource (not in spec).
  • W12 (to W05-1): Fx:113-115, Ps:164-165,192, CS:1523: cd 12, cost 10, block .15, 2 counters, coef .8. 4 s stance, +15% block, counters.
  • W13 (to W04-1): Fx:116-117, CS:1594: cd 10, cost 15, radius 4, coef .7, pull 1.5. Hits then pulls 1.5 m (spec: pull first).
  • W14 (to W04-2): Fx:118, CS:1660: cd 6, cost 20, range 7, width 1, coef 1.5, slow .3 for 3 s. Line hit plus slow.
  • W15 (to W06-3): Fx:119, Id:9-38, CS:1726: cd 18, gain 60, repay 4. Instant 60 resource, debt repaid by regen/hits.
  • W16 (to W05-2): Fx:120-126, CS:1797: cd 16, barrier .12, immune 2, duration 5. Barrier, clears control, 2 s immunity.
  • Cleanup:
  • One option group per non-passive skill is enforced (ClassSkillPolicyTests.cs:58-59).
  • DES_LW41-45 hooks (Fx:103,105,107,115,117,122-125, Ps:44,61) apply only with the modifier (Plan 12).
  • The BuffSkill list (HuntEdictV2.Order.cs:49) needs updating.
  • All 10 Warrior validation builds use removed ids.

C. Passives

PassiveApplied atRank 1 to 5 today vs SD4
WP01Dmg:30-31 (3+ enemies within 3 m, frozen at cast, Sim:496); SE.PassiveBase[0]=2525 to 35 = spec (x(1+.1(r-1)), SE:23, SkillProgression.cs:56; SD4:1197)
WP06Dmg:31, per target at or below 30% HP; base 3535 to 49 = spec
WP05Economy.cs:191 adds to shieldMultiplier; base 4040 to 56 = spec
WP04CombatSimulation.Passives.cs:28-35, once per 20 ticks; base 22 to 2.8 = spec
WP13Ps:167, health<.7*hp (strict).4 to .56 = spec
WP15Ps:25-26 (4 s window, Offensive skills only).2 to .28 = spec
WP17Ps:22,27,103-105; ratio captured before cost (Sk:160, Act:66-67); W03/W04 direct hits.15 to .21 = spec
WP09Ps:163 (Proc, 1 s per root)18 x1.4 = 25.2, SD4 says 26 (SD4:1277): needs from/to

The four legacy passives need no change. WP20 (40 to 80) and WP21 (6 to 10) are not x1.4, so rank tables must be data (Plan 5.3). Key passives are absent from data: ClassSkills.Data counts 111 (Cat:52), Canonical needs one rank per definition (Cat:122), and unlock Lv45 exceeds the 40 caps (Cat:55,62,137, Tree:42). Ablation tooling assumes one value key (ClassSkillPassiveMeasurement.cs:45-46).

WP20 Blood Frenzy.

  • Bleed crit: TickClassDots calls ApplyOutgoing(..,critMultiplier 1,critical false) (Fx:73). Under Passive("WP20")&&d.id=="W09", roll RandomStream.Unit(ref State.rng)<Mathf.Min(.75f,d.snapshot.crit) and use snapshot.critDamage, as Hit does (Dmg:69-73); CashDot (Fx:62) likewise. The roll shifts the shared rng that restore receipts compare (ClassSkillNativeSmoke.cs:29).
  • Explosion: add bit 16 HasDot("W09",enemy) to ClassHitFlags (Ps:94-98; evaluated before damage, Dmg:41). Deal already sets enemy.dead (Sim:508), which AP10 relies on (Ps:135). So in AfterClassHit (Ps:119-158):

if(Passive("WP20")&&(flags&16)!=0&&enemy.dead&&Once("WP20",root,enemy.id))Splash(a,enemy.position,r,N("WP20","value"),0,secondary:true,source:"WP20")

  • Pass the raw value: SkillHit already multiplies passive sources by RankScale (Fx:12), which is wrong for rank tables. EXTRA: ids are non-native: no recursion, not direct hits.

WP21 Unending Resolve.

  • No category notion exists. There is only buff/attack (HuntEdictV2.Order.cs:49-50), Normal/Offensive/Native (Sk:87-89) and result metrics (CombatStatistics.cs:10).
  • The design has roleKo: W09/W08 generator (SD4:262,357), W01/W03 core (452,547), W04 control (927), W02 mobility (832), W05/W06 defense (642,737). The generator plan omits it, so add a role field.
  • Trigger beside WP15 in CaptureClassCast (Ps:25-26):

var c=Counter("WP21"); bool alt=c.until>State.time&&c.previous!=role; c.count=alt?Mathf.Min(3,c.count+1):(c.until>State.time?c.count:0); c.previous=role; c.until=State.time+4; a.additive+=c.count*PV("WP21");

  • It reaches only direct hits of the casting skill (Ps:103-105).

D. Test patterns

  • Fixture. ClassSkillRuntimeTests.Fixture(skill,passive,equipment) (T/ClassSkillRuntimeTests.cs:23-41):
  • Builds GameStore.NewAccount, level 40, loadout [skill], new CombatSimulation(account,catalog,1,0,seed:42).
  • One 100000-HP stationary enemy 2 m up, Stats overwritten (damage 100, hp 1000, crit 0), resource 50/100, decisionTime=100000 (no AI).
  • Helpers: Advance (:42; Tick(Step=.05), Sim:10), Target, CastSkill (:44-48), AddSkill (:49-53), reflection Call (:17-22), Begin/Land/Status/Use/HurtAmount (ClassSkillPassiveTests.cs:12-35), ExtraEnemy (ClassSkillGearTests.cs:12-15), Policy/GlobalTarget (ClassSkillPolicyTests.cs:13-23).
  • Legacy-path variant: SkillRankEffectTests.cs:17-36 (seed 5150, hunt rules, FirstHit).
  • Reading results. State.damageEvents (CombatEffects.cs:36-44), State.classSkills.{dots,effects,casts,cooldowns} (ClassSkillState.cs:39-53), shields, effectEvents, enemy.statuses, ClassSkillChanged (Sk:10).
  • Patterns to copy: with/without pairs (PassiveScenario ClassSkillPassiveTests.cs:36-96, GearScenario ClassSkillGearTests.cs:16-50), rank ratios (SkillRankEffectTests.cs:38-50), restore equality (ClassSkillNativeReceipt, ClassSkillNativeSmoke.cs:17-31; ClassSkillExperimentTests.cs:35-39).
  • Contributions tests (ClassSkillRuntimeTests.Contributions.cs:25-77) assert heal/protect/resource ledgers per source string (Eff:10-12), so modifier effects need a stable source id.
  • RunClassSkillValidation (ClassSkillValidation.cs:59-91) reports damage, casts and movement meters for 60 s of automatic play. Use it for the auto-movement checks of W01-1, W02-1, W08-1.
// helpers are real; r.modifier/modifierRank are the new v5 fields
int HitsOnSide(int modifier){
  var s=Fixture("W09");var r=s.State.build.classSkills.ranks.Single(x=>x.id=="W09");
  r.modifier=modifier;r.modifierRank=modifier<0?0:1;
  var side=ExtraEnemy(s,s.State.position+Vector2.right*2);Call(s,"Sense");
  Assert.IsTrue(CastSkill(s,"W09"));Advance(s,.6f);
  return s.State.damageEvents.Count(d=>d.definitionId=="W09"&&d.kind==DamageKind.Direct&&d.targetId==side.id);
}
[Test] public void SpinningRendReachesBesideTheCone(){Assert.AreEqual(0,HitsOnSide(-1));Assert.AreEqual(1,HitsOnSide(2));}
  • Determinism. Hit always draws State.rng (Dmg:70). New rolls shift later ones, so keep crit 0 and compare equal seeds.
  • Ablation tool. ClassSkillPassiveMeasurement is Explicit:
  • Kits (:62-76) and Assist (:80-87) name removed ids.
  • CreateAccount removes a passive by blanking a passive slot (:101), which v3+ forbids (Cat:120), so zero its rank instead. The "+W03" yardstick edits rank (:103) and still works.
  • ClassSkillValidationBuild (ClassSkillValidation.cs:8-9) has no modifier field, and all 10 Warrior builds use removed ids.
  • Dependent tests: ClassSkillCompatibilityTests.cs:14-31,39-61, ClassSkillExperimentTests.cs:35,55, ClassSkillNativeSmoke.cs:47-50, ClassSkillPassiveTests.cs:11 (WP07-WP19).
  • Balance1000.
  • X/balance_1000.py:222-231 hashes ClassSkills.cs, ClassSkillTree.cs, GameStore.SkillTree.cs, CombatSimulation.cs, CombatSimulation.Damage.cs, CombatEffects.cs, Economy.cs, HeroStats.Blacksmith.cs and both skill JSONs. Any edit stales --check.
  • It hard-codes +10%/rank (:148) and level 40 (parameters.json).
  • X/test_balance_1000.py:19 reads production_skill_tree_audit.json (skillTreeVersion 3, levelCap 40).
  • X/class_skills.py:11-22,97-113 fingerprints SkillEffects.cs, SkillProgression.cs and the 18 SkillDefinition constructor arguments, so legacy rank tables need a fingerprint update.

E. Open questions (unresolved from code)

  1. W09: do cost 15 and cooldown 4 stay, or is it free? Is "+8 to 12 on hit" per target or per cast? For W09-2 "+20% per stack", is it a multiplier per application or on the total? W09-3: bleed is 2-3 s (effectKo) versus 4 to 2 s (behaviourKo); is the D120% total kept? W09-1: does the 3rd cast add W10's D80% hit?
  2. W08-1/3: arrival point; extra resource on top of 10 to 18; does a kill by any source grant +20?
  3. W01-3: should tick cost scale? W01-1: baseline for x2-3 given the 1.5x speed cap.
  4. W03: single strike (SD4:581) or the implemented 100 degree multi-hit cone? Execute refund amount; aftershock position; WP17 on aftershocks.
  5. W02-1: keep the D180 landing, the 8 s cooldown, W11's guard/resource? W02-3: recharge 8 to 6 s versus cooldown 6.4 s.
  6. W04: does the stun survive wave/pull? Stomp anchor; WP17 on stomps.
  7. W05-1: keep +15% block and the 2-counter limit? W05-3 target cap.
  8. W06-1: CC reduction in or out? W06-2 under the 1.5 attack-speed cap, and its damage bonus. W06-3: loan versus 6 s pause, and extra 40-60 above max resource 100.
  9. W17-1: base (2 ancestors, 8 s) versus 3 ancestors 6-8 s. W17-2: copyable skills, and whether copies count for WP15/WP21/legendaries.
  10. W18-1: base 4 m versus 6-8 m. W18-2: scope of "+50% range" and "stagger immunity".
  11. WP21: do W02, W05, W06 and ultimates reset, pause or ignore the chain? Stack window (WP15 uses 4 s); does a repeat of the same type reset?
  12. WP20: crit per tick or per bleed; separate rng stream; does the W09-1 cash-out crit; explosion radius and target cap; chain explosions; do set bleeds count?
  13. WP09: 26 versus 25.2. WP13: "70% or below" versus the strict test.
  14. Where do the legacy rank tables live (W01 cost 6 to 4, W03 25 to 21, W02 cooldown, W04 stun), given the fingerprint checks?

# D4 skill tree design and verification material

Updated: 2026-10-12 · [한국어](README.md)

This folder holds the design, the planning data, the golden files, the reference implementation and the research notes of the Diablo IV style skill tree. The implementation plan starts at `Docs/Implementation/D4_Skill_Tree_Plan_20261012.en.md`.

| Location | Contents | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| `SkillWindow.dc.html` | the design source (a design canvas component). Takes hero, language, layout and view as props | design owner |
| `skill_tree_d4.json` | the **planning data source**: rules, per-class tiers, actives, modifiers, passives, texts, `legacyRemap` | design owner (once implementation starts, the game-side JSON is the reference) |
| `extract.js`, `behaviour.json` | the exporter that builds the spec JSON from the design, and its input | design owner |
| `golden/` | **golden files** produced by really running the design, the **JavaScript reference implementation**, the **C# port**, and tools. Guide: `golden/README.en.md` | design owner |
| `reference/` | 24 reference renders (2x, Korean and English) | design owner |
| `research/` | read-only code research notes made before implementation. `research/README.en.md` | Claude |
| `icons_manifest.json` | the 92 new icons: source name, sha256, target location | Claude |
| `tools/legacy_id_inventory.py` | list of places that name ids that disappear, with `--check` | Claude |

The design canvas (private): https://claude.ai/artifact/4KCzKcxqrBBWrNiJZ5Esg8 — if it can not be opened, the copies in this folder are enough.

## Checking everything at once

```bash
node Docs/Design/D4SkillTree/golden/verify_golden.js                 # do the golden files match the design (about 2 minutes)
node Docs/Design/D4SkillTree/golden/reference/test_reference.js      # JavaScript reference: 55,803 checks match
(cd Docs/Design/D4SkillTree/golden/csharp && dotnet run)             # C# port: the same 55,803 checks match
python3 Docs/Design/D4SkillTree/golden/tools/compare_screens.py --selftest   # checks the pass limits of the visual comparison tool
python3 Docs/Design/D4SkillTree/tools/legacy_id_inventory.py          # list of old id references (--check passes only when implementation is done)
```

When the design changes, the design owner runs `node extract.js SkillWindow.dc.html skill_tree_d4.json behaviour.json` and `node golden/build_golden.js`, confirms that all the checks above pass, and commits them together. **Implementation work does not edit `golden/`, `skill_tree_d4.json` or `SkillWindow.dc.html` in this folder.**

pages.body:
# D4 skill tree implementation record

Date: 2026-10-12 · [한국어](D4_Skill_Tree_Implementation_20261012.md)

The reference is the final `claude/d4-skill-tree-plan` commit `3be804b955e97b3c4500eb7d20acfbc2a3c32733`. Both plan languages mark it final and the planning worktree was clean. The original uncommitted gear-recommendation changes are preserved. An isolated checkout includes latest `main` `a5596519`. One agent implements the steps in order.

## Step 1 — data and rules

- `build_skill_tree_d4.py` builds and checks the JsonUtility-readable `SkillTreeD4.json` from the approved source. It contains 10 base skills, 28 modifiers and 10 passives per class: 144 nodes and 111 legacy-id mappings. Design allocations, selections and preliminary behaviour text are excluded from game data.
- The verified C# model/rules were copied and connected to the game-data adapter and rank-value accessors. Count units take floor; other values follow the approved linear golden values.
- `SkillTreeD4.Enabled` defaults to false and requires a development argument. This step leaves the existing catalog, UI, combat and save schema on their current path.
- Generator check and 2 Python tests passed. The 9 focused Unity 6000.6.0f1 EditMode cases passed, matching **32,208 rule checks and 802 rank values**. [Test XML](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/phase-1-editmode.xml), [input hashes](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/phase-1-inputs.json), [result](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/phase-1-validation.json).
- The initial import's automatic RuntimeShader material and URP global-settings changes were restored byte-for-byte. Unity generated the new files' metadata.

## Step 2 — Saves, migration and levels

Added gated v5 allocation entries (20 per class, including modifier ranks), level cap 60, pre-normalization migration and persistent per-hero refund notices. Original wire bytes are archived before migration. Presets and live-run execution state are migrated while progress, health and resources survive. Old HED3/4/5 imports carry policy only; v5 emits HED6. A flag-off build refuses schema 22 without falling back to an older backup.

Validation: the first related run passed 34/37. Three old-wire test helpers/expectations were corrected; the repaired cases and added allocation round-trip test passed 15/15. Five literal pre-v5 save fixtures, HED3/4/5 literal code bytes, idempotence, archives, run progress, backup refusal and XP from 40 to 60 were covered. All 288 golden allocations survive save, JSON load and share-code round trips. Balance1000 source fingerprints were refreshed: 1,000 rows, zero errors. [Results](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/phase-2-validation.json), [final EditMode](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/phase-2-editmode.xml).

Unverified: new UI and combat, full EditMode, macOS smoke and physical mobile. Stale puzzle kit copies were invalidated; step 6 connects regeneration using D4 rules.

## Step 3 — Icons

Imported all 92 approved PNGs byte for byte. `adopt_generated_game_art.inspect` verified their hashes and native alpha. A06 and M07 retained their complete metadata bytes and GUIDs. The resolver covers all 144 design nodes, including modifiers and key passives. W09-1 was imported and rendered through SkillIconView before the batch import. Related EditMode: 18/18 passed. [Render](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/representative-W09-1.png), [tests](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/phase-3-editmode.xml), [results](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/phase-3-validation.json).

Texture budgets: Android ASTC 6x6 approximately 10.38MiB (10.9MB); desktop BC7 and web ETC2 each 23MiB (24.1MB). Final decision D11 already contains the corrected estimates. Compressed player download size and physical mobile remain unmeasured. The art manifest retains the original 111-row history and the 92-row renewal provenance separately.

## UI-1 — Screen calculation core

Copied Layout, ViewModel, Session and Fx byte for byte from the verified C# port. Tests use the game-data model and inject only the design-board allocations/selections as explicit fixtures. Related EditMode: 11/11 passed. Layout 2,975; scenarios 15,034; wording 600; interaction 4,986: 23,595 screen checks match. Together with the previously verified 32,208 rule checks, this covers all 55,803 golden checks. The six coordinate-fit vectors and half-point font rounding also passed. [Tests](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/ui-1-editmode.xml), [results and copy hashes](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/ui-1-validation.json).

The real uGUI window, meshes, visual effects and pointer input remain to be implemented and verified, beginning with UI-2.

## UI-2 — Drawing tools

Extended the shared UiMesh with gradient borders, hexagons, arcs, rounded dashed outlines, glow and inner shade. Connector strokes retain the design's glow-before-line paint order in one mesh. Added 3/5-segment rank arcs, mesh-clipped icons, gradient text and a stencil/clip-aware tone and blur shader. UiTheme owns the palette; original artwork is unchanged.

The allocation tests caught and removed hidden params arrays in multi-argument Mathf.Min. New graphics: 10/10 passed; final refined-shape cases: 4/4 passed; the earlier shared-Graphic/forge regression range passed eight cases. After preparation, mesh population of shapes, dashed borders, rank arcs, six line states, icon crops and partial line effects allocates zero managed GC. Shared UI contract plus 15 regression tests passed. The [Unity Camera sample plate](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/ui-2-sample-plate.png) verifies shapes, shader effects and corrected stroke caps. [Evidence and scope](D4SkillTreeEvidence20261012/ui-2-validation.json).

## UI-3 — Window shell and static tree

Added the adapter canvas, portrait/landscape scrolling, PC fit, retained node views and explicit in-memory host. A generator compiles 428 immutable looks and 221 normalized colour tokens without changing design CSS/goldens. The tree draws measured hit/card boxes, metal rings, tags, rank bars, ordered lines/arrows, corner ornaments and the right-edge fade. Allowed approximation A7 uses one glow compositing gain, 0.55. Word wrapping and capture font refresh handle OS font substitution.
