First-open refund notices acknowledge each hero separately; unrelated saves retain the same display key, and a level change is detected without waiting for a save. Added context locks, localization and effect-material restoration/disposal.

Validation: the first related run passed 66/70. Four failures (Editor destruction, delegate shape and localization input) were repaired; those four and one effect GC regression passed 5/5. Three-class disk reload and actual window reopening plus flag-off legacy entry passed 4/4. Live-owner refusal and live investment passed 2/2, ending 20:27:53 UTC. Shared UI: 15/15; refresh guards: 16/16. Final 24/24 full-screen comparisons passed. Table, scope and tests.

Native-player EventSystem/drag and native saved-relaunch smoke, full EditMode and physical devices remain unverified. Next is combat framework 5.0, then all three class packages and the dependent systems. Final main integration and merged-SHA CI verification remain pending. The user's 22:25 UTC instruction cancels WebGL builds and subsequent bulk branch/worktree cleanup.

5.0 — Common combat framework

Added modifier/base-rank cast snapshots, copied modifier ownership on lingering effects, data-driven rank values and passive reads, the regular-base effective rank cap six, and all six ultimate rank/cooldown curves. Modifier secondary values can bypass base-rank scaling. Persistence validates new shapes against their origin. The first grade-A modifier W09-3 has paired cone/spin and duration tests at ranks 1/5, a frozen wind-up snapshot and deterministic actual simulation resume.

Related first run: 455/459, including every initial new core case. Four historical HED4 test builders incorrectly included newly added fields; corrected old-wire fixtures and rank regressions passed 15/15. Persistence passed 3/3; actual resume and six ultimate cases passed 7/7 (20:54:57 UTC). The preserved catalog/validation reports remain 111/123/60; generator checks passed. Balance1000: 1,000 rows, zero errors, with D4 source fingerprints added. Evidence.

Defaults C1/C3/C5/C6/C8 follow the final plan: modifier values use their own ranks, omitted parameters retain current values, extras absent from the design are removed in the class packages, effect/value text takes precedence, and placed-object caps remove the oldest. Remaining 83 modifiers, all class-specific passive/ultimate behaviour, full integration and native/physical acceptance are pending. The Warrior research has now been read in full for 5a.

Baseline proof: 91/91 pre-framework report cases passed at 21:02:19 UTC. All 90 build and 18 policy observations are byte-identical to the framework run. W-8 explicitly forbids the loan mechanism; the corrected persistence cases passed 2/2 at 21:04:09 UTC.

5a — Warrior mechanism decisions (implementation in progress)

W02-1 retains the approved base landing hit and rank-dependent cooldown. It moves at ground height for the existing travel time, shoves each enemy once along the segment, and adds no absorbed W11 guard or resource bonus. The charge distance reads the modifier rank. W02-3 uses a saved two-charge record, sequential recharge at the captured modifier value (8 to 6 seconds), and mirrors availability into the existing cooldown so manual and automatic paths agree. It replaces the base cooldown and its reductions. Switching away removes the charge record.

W17-2 records the latest released regular active, including its base/modifier snapshot. The user's final answer includes support skill effects. Ancestors reproduce attacks as secondary damage and support effects at 50 to 70 percent without starting another cast or updating attack/role history. Shield, shout, movement, haste, immunity, counter, reflection and regeneration pause retain copied ownership; repeated shields replace rather than stack, and matching shout strengths use the stronger value. W18-2 replaces the impact with a timed form (6 to 8 seconds), adds 50 percent to newly captured attack radii/reach, and suppresses push while active. Its copied ownership and expiry survive resume.

WP20 reads only the W09 bleed ledger, rolls once per bleed tick/cash-out using the existing saved RNG and crit cap, and emits one secondary death blast (2.5m, five targets); that blast cannot trigger another blast. WP21 uses the data role before the middle dot for regular skills, a four-second saved history and up to three alternate-role stacks. Repeating a role refreshes the window without adding a stack; ultimates do not change regular-skill history.

The user finalized W03-2 at 10 percent. A cast that kills one or more enemies refunds 10 percent of its actual paid cost once; no-kill casts refund nothing. The saved proc receipt prevents repeated refunds. All class acceptance and final integration remain pending.

Core CI correction b27fe5d7 refreshed 13 source-line anchors in the legacy dependency audit. PR113 generated and ownership checks passed in run 38311715674; this is separate from Unity test evidence.

Warrior checkpoint validation: the related class run passed 70/76; the repaired boundary/fixture cases passed 8/8. All 28 modifiers at both rank endpoints survived deterministic actual simulation resume (56 comparisons) and chosen-modifier cleanup. All 28 started through automatic combat. The final added crowd-capacity/range cases passed 2/2 at 22:00:04 UTC. Balance1000 regenerated 1,000 rows with zero errors. Evidence. The user-confirmed refund passed both rank endpoints, and support copies passed all 16 support-modifier/ultimate-rank combinations. The final form-reach/planner sweep belongs to integration; this checkpoint is not full release acceptance.

5b — Ranger mechanism decisions (before implementation)

Units: A01-3 scales the parent shot by 50 to 70 percent; A02-2 scales the parent arrow by 40 to 80 percent; A14-1 scales the first split damage by 30 to 50 percent. A07-3, A04-3 and Precision add the stated amount to the critical multiplier. Explicit D-percent rows (rapid volley, barrage, return arrows, poison, snipe and bursts) use weapon damage and their modifier rank, without the parent rank multiplier.

Ricochet keeps one hit per enemy across all legs and a saved bounce allowance, reflects at a locally probed wall normal, and forecasts only the first segment. Returning forks save their leg and origin; the return uses D30 to D50, and neither leg recursively creates another regular cast. A03-3 uses the trap-cluster placement policy, one owned turret and the parent duration; its ranked shot count is spaced evenly over that duration. Oldest objects are removed when caps are exceeded.

Shadow Step uses a legal point behind the observed target and a stationary preparation lasting the original movement time. It skips retreat walk-back and grants one forced harder direct hit. Gaze Shot marks first, then holds the hero for the existing A08 aim time; actual incoming damage or a requested move cancels the shot. Chain Mark carries its remaining duration and jump allowance in the saved mark. Cold imbuement tracks three hits per enemy, then applies the existing absorbed freeze duration and resets.

Shadow Clone follows the hero and copies direct damage without starting a cast or consuming imbuement, capped at one. Afterimage Burst fires on expiry, use and cap eviction. Precision counts every direct critical including forced criticals, and consumes its charge once on the next A01/A02 cast. Viper is an independent multiplier and includes poison ticks and secondary damage.

The Ranger checkpoint passes all paired mechanism checks after correcting test fixtures, all 28 automatic starts and actual deterministic resumes for all 56 modifier/rank combinations. Saved Focus discounts both native and legacy paid casts once, and the eight ordinary passive rows are exercised under their runtime conditions. Real-map ricochet preserves its bounce allowance, reflects at corners and stores the result. Corrupted bounce/cold-stack state is refused without changing the input. User-confirmed Warrior refund and support-copy checks are included in this follow-up. These are scoped simulation checks; final dependent-system and native-player acceptance remain pending.

5c — Mage mechanism decisions

Keep C3 defaults where a numeric parameter is omitted: the existing lance burn/slow, returning frost flight/return/pickup, ward and reactive elemental shield parameters remain. Explicit modifier D-percent rows use weapon damage; Double Nova uses the stated fraction of the ranked base wave. Lightning Blink applies its specified stun without adding unspecified damage. Existing chain decay remains; the overload modifier changes its absolute hop limit. Magnetic Chain pulls after determining the complete route so forecasts and actual hits share target order.

M01-3 leaves owned trail segments and does not explode. M02-1 follows the hero; Deep Freeze uses a saved three-second dwell counter. Triple Orb creates up to three owned instances and removes the oldest at the cap; each has its own expiry blast, and the oldest eligible orb receives chain charge. Overcharge suppresses periodic damage. Single Element Focus freezes the last released regular element at cast time, defaulting to fire when none was used. Tracking Collapse re-aims each stage at the densest visible group in its ranked range.

Elemental Surge follows a core cast with the first equipped core skill of another element in saved action order, with no extra payment or cooldown and no capture/history/legendary cast hooks. Its damage is secondary and recursion is blocked. Sage retains the explicit D24 cost reduction and three-element cycle burst. Avatar adds its ranked fire damage, cold protection or lightning cooldown reduction according to the last released regular element. Shatter accumulates actual HP loss while frozen/staggered, clears on death or passive removal and bursts once when the control ends. Align the Elements stores per-enemy element flags within the existing cycle window and clears before its secondary burst.

Mage scoped validation: first pair run 10/14, with the existing M07 cost and returning flight time corrected in the fixtures; remaining/repaired pairs 15/15. Ordinary passives, automatic starts, free Sage resume and corrupted-ledger rejection passed 7/7. All 28 modifiers started automatically; all 56 modifier/rank combinations resumed deterministically. Charged-orb selection/expiry and the affected 112 Warrior/Ranger resume combinations passed 4/4 at 23:03:41 UTC. Frozen snapshots now store the removed base-rank power so a later investment cannot alter weapon-based modifier damage. Evidence. All three class packages are complete as scoped simulation checkpoints; dependent systems and native acceptance remain outstanding.

6 — Dependents and final default switch (continued 2026-10-13)

The inherited dirty input was preserved. The previous owner stays read-only, the gear owner finished, and no Unity/Blender job was active. Authorized gh reads confirmed both checks on PR116 289e00e8 and PR109 9ad9d5f3.

Current definitions, independent modifier ranks, effective base rank six, HUD/quick editing/training/rift selection, Giant reach, Fireball forecast shapes and persistent world views are connected. Guide uses W09 and tutorial-v6-d4; its finite melee boss prevents the single-target starter becoming trapped by repeated summons. Existing timing and graduation assertions remain unchanged.

Authored prologue/puzzle kits allow only their listed rank-one skills, reject modifiers/ultimates/outside investments, refund their temporary allocation and revoke authority on graduation. HED6 export, forged import and ordinary preset storage reject kits. Replay migration preserves hero identity, level and equipment while rebuilding v5 allowances. Shared gear/rune bonus calculation includes nonlegacy inheritance, caps regular bases at six and leaves modifiers/passives/ultimates unchanged. Absorbed legendary scope requires its selected modifier and is frozen in the damage snapshot.

D4 is enabled by default for production. Literal old saves/codes and developer fixtures retain their compatibility path; the developer-only -hellscriptLegacySkills argument reproduces existing compatibility inputs while D4 suites activate and test the new path independently. CI now checks approved D4 generation and its regressions. Native acceptance reuses the existing golden readers, moved into developer code with their meta GUIDs preserved, for rendered raycasts, 60 transcripts, all 30 active/84 modifier panels at five sizes/two languages, owned commits and process restart.

Focused proof: kit baseline 42/43, repaired regression 20/24, four failed cases repaired 4/4; gear/rune/snapshot 6/6; generator 2/2; UI contract 15/15 and refresh static check passed. Failure evidence is preserved. The unchanged raw removed-ID inventory reports 7,455 references (146 files), including compatibility catalogs, literal old-wire fixtures, migration maps and developer paths; its expectations/scope have not been weakened to fabricate zero. Integration, full EditMode, native result and merged-main SHA checks remain pending. Web build and public publication remain cancelled. A later direct user request authorizes consolidation of all HELLSCRIPT branches/worktrees and cleanup after the merge.

Current-source common-cause repairs — 2026-10-13

Retained the post-retirement full result: 5,794 total, 5,367 passed, 424 failed and three authoring/measurement skips, with its original XML and hashes. Repairs cover the empty D4 allocation and policy projection for fresh accounts, original historical policies and schema1 item migration order, JsonUtility's empty cast placeholder, existing item-buff expiry and incoming-damage forecasts, and numeric wire identities for actual casts. Feature fixtures buy legal current-tree prerequisites and use real completed tutorial saves. Historical migration fixtures explicitly identify their historical schema.

Authored kits from level nine grant only listed rank-one skills while preserving ownership, investment and graduation gates. Mage chest/forge/hazard lessons at levels ten/fourteen/fifteen were tuned through actual comparison combat; victory, death and HP-band assertions remain unchanged. Previews use current skills/modifiers/elements and enemy arrival times to verify observable automatic-policy differences. Coverage of the current 30 playable skill sounds and translation completeness remains active.

The authorized 79-case prototype PuzzleLevelTests retirement preserves its original source, meta and hashes, replacing it with current PuzzleContent, PuzzleOpening, PuzzleOperation, PuzzleGraduation and D4TutorialKit suites. One leap assertion requiring a retired passive now verifies actual current leap/IronWall behavior, with its original preserved. Two unreferenced old WAVs and their meta are retained. No new Ignore or relaxed failure criteria was added.

Final related acceptance: 109 passed, zero failed, with retained XML. Both generator checks, 3+3 unit checks and the unchanged zero-reference retirement audit passed. The shared UI check reuses its passing receipt after verifying all 519 input hashes. The complete suite will run once after committing frozen runtime inputs, with expected case identity and new-skip guards. Fresh 24-screen/native save/restart acceptance, main merge, exact-main CI and cleanup remain pending. Failures, repairs and original preservation.

Input-context regressions discovered by the full suite — 2026-10-13

The frozen 0d3b4d9e suite returned 5,715 total, 5,612 passed, 100 failed and three existing authoring/measurement skips. Expected case identity, added/missing cases and new skips all matched. All 100 were previously passing tests affected by the fresh-account allocation change. Numeric skills, HED2 and historical fight baselines now explicitly use their historical inputs and restore their scoped flag. Current guide/rune/pickup fixtures use actual owned allocations. The guide recognizes actual successful current casts with valid roots even when the skill has no historical rule row.

Original full and subsequent XML are retained. All 405/405 cases across 15 affected classes passed, including every original 100-case regression. There are no additional skips, deleted tests or retired assets. Baselines, victory/death, save/rollback and actual-combat assertions remain unchanged. Run the complete final suite and fresh screens/native acceptance before main merge and cleanup. 100 regressions and 405-case proof.

Final integration verification and original preservation — 2026-10-13

Completed the authorized retirement of old playable paths and validation assets. The production catalog exposes 144 D4 nodes; numeric wire definitions retain strict old-save reading and migration. All 87 retired originals were hash-verified in the archive and Git history. The unchanged removed-ID audit reports zero references across groups 1–5, including new files. Both the 38 pre-retirement and 424 post-retirement failures retain their original XML and repair proof. The authorized 79-case prototype retirement preserves source/meta/hashes and uses current tutorial ownership and actual combat coverage. The prior leap assertion and two unreferenced WAVs/meta are also retained. The subsequent 100 input-context regressions retain their original XML, passing 405/405 focused proof and final full-suite closure. Current failure criteria remain unchanged.

The final complete EditMode run using Assets=24eecdee77e513352ade124a9b6a8d46257d7e28, Packages=2fce9aa61b6abdfa990b03a86a8430478fdf8505, ProjectSettings=3443bda04f08715924f7704de54d3f7c7d126df3 returned 5715 total, 5712 passed, zero failed, 3 authoring/measurement skips, confirmed by exit0 and every individual result in the complete XML. Its original root aggregate Skipped:Ignored remains unmodified; acceptance verifies the exact prior three skipped names/labels/reasons, all 5,712 passing leaves, zero missing/added/failed/inconclusive cases and unchanged source/XML hashes. The prior process ended without a final XML and its interrupted log is retained. Final related acceptance passed 405 cases with zero failures. The passing 15/15 shared UI receipt was reused after verifying all 519 input hashes. Beyond the authorized retirement and method renames, there are zero missing/added cases and zero new skips.

Fresh captures after the font repairs and legacy retirement passed 24/24 original L5 comparisons, with unchanged limits: colour ≤6, edges ≥.70, worst tiles ≤32, every element ≤20. The rebuilt macOS development player reported zero build errors and passed D4's 60 transcripts, 1,662 actual raycast clicks, 502 blocked actions, 1,140 panels, 30 captures, six schema22 allocation commits and a fresh-process restart. Fresh-account guides passed Korean 440×956 and English 956×440 through combat, rewards and persisted graduation. Equipment recommendations passed five sizes, both languages, 95 captures, equip/settings/expiry/town round trips and a fresh-process reload. Native gear setup uses normal tier purchases, actual current-guide graduation and normal settings for visible popup inputs. The verified ended-run save is retained; a separate active Rift prepared through normal loot/acknowledgement APIs passes the unchanged restart assertions. Game source, assertions and tier/unlock gates are unchanged. All native runs used muted audio and isolated disposable saves.

Merged the four completed art commits through 5d97cd4b and all 22 original local branch tips, plus commit 7196b0a9 preserving 65 subsequently discovered existing art originals, while retaining their histories. Protected 27 original MP3 files, two previously preserved tutorial originals and two newly found fourth-segment originals. New parallel art production was not applied to the game and no additional tutorial implementation was added. Documentation/art integration does not alter the validated runtime trees. After acceptance, merge PR117 into main, verify CI for the exact main SHA and clean only approved targets after retaining originals and required proof.

These are macOS results, without physical-mobile, ordinary-speed usability or frame-performance claims. Web builds, public wiki publication and site deployment remain cancelled. Closure for all 424 failures, Final inputs, XML and binary hashes, complete XML, 24-screen comparison, current native proof.

pages.body:
# D4 skill tree: Mage combat research (read-only)

**Paths.** W=/Users/t8g-2410-pn-005/Documents/MyProject/HELLSCRIPT/wt-d4-skill-plan; R=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Runtime/Core; T=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Tests/Editor; J=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources/Data; D=W/Docs. Aliases Sk,Fx,Au,Ps,Po,Id,Sim,Act,Dmg,Eff,Cs,Cat,SE,GC,CS,RP,CAT,SD4,Plan as in the Warrior report; Proj,Fc,Aim,Pers,Stt,RT,PT,GT,SRT as in the Ranger report. New: Ar=CombatSimulation.Areas.cs, Atr=...Attributes.cs, Eco=Economy.cs, CE=CombatEffects.cs, EdF/EdB/EdC/EdN/EdT/EdS=...Edict{Fireball,Blizzard,Chain,Nova,Teleport,Shield}.cs, EdMB=...EdictMageBasic.cs, EdR=...EdictResponse.cs, Ord=HuntEdictV2.Order.cs, Identity=T/ClassSkillRuntimeTests.Identity.cs. Bare `Passives.cs`, `Outcomes.cs` are CombatSimulation.* in R/. SD4 cites are the `"id"` line. A/B/C as before; **A\*** = the number comes from the modifier rank (not base `rankScale`), so it needs the shared modifier accessor.

## A. Mage-specific framework facts

**Engines.**
- Legacy hero-action: M01-M06 and MP01-MP06 (`legacy:true`, CS:598-826,1072-1157; numbers GC:479-484 plus literals). Native: M07-M18 (CS:2850-3643), MP07-MP19.
- Spec actives: legacy M01,M02,M03,M04,M06; native M07,M08,M11,M17,M18. Absorbed: M05 legacy; M09,M10,M12,M14,M16 native. Dropped with no modifier: M13,M15.
- Legacy numbers outside CS: M01 coef `2.1f`, speed 14, radius `RuneSkillRadius(12,2.5f)` (Proj:35-36; R/RuneCombatBonuses.cs:45); Blizzard `.65f`, r 3, 6 s (Sim:334); Chain `1.1f*.8^i`, 4 hops (Sim:345, Fc:10); Nova freeze `1.5f` (Sim:323); shield 35% (SE:31); prepare by index (CombatActions.cs:96-102).
- Rank: legacy +10% damage via `runeSkillPower`, keyed by `LegacyIndex(definition)` (Sim:494; Dmg:66-67): a hit labelled "M0x" gets base rank, "EXTRA:M0x" does not. Native `SkillHit`, `Dot`, `Placement.value` multiply `a.rankScale` (Fx:12-13,40,84): modifier numbers need a distinct `source` or a bypass. M04 cooldown -5%/rank (SE:28-30; 9->7.2 = spec) also adds +5% range/rank. **No rank term exists for cost** (Sim:283-290; spec M01/M03 25->21), Blizzard duration (6->8) or Nova freeze (1.5->1.9).
- Mage-only wiring on the five legacy skills: compiled rules `edict:M01..M06` (Ord:51,75-100), planners EdF/EdB/EdC/EdN/EdT (Aim:50-52, Rules:228-240), option tables (HuntEdictV2.Options.cs:100-124), forecasts Fc:69-98. Forecast==release is test-enforced (Identity:107-117), so every shape change must change its planner too.
- Inside `ResolveSkill` the legacy cast exists (`Cast(action.id)`) but `cast.snapshot` is still null (set by `OriginalClassRelease`, Sk:225-228, after Act:122). `Placement`/`Arrow` copy it (Fx:84,89); `SkillHit` falls back to live `CaptureDamage()` (Fx:11).

**Mana.**
- `State.resource` (saved, GC:410); `Stats.maxResource`=100+gear (Eco:224); `Stats.regen`={8,10,12}[class]+gear, x(1+MP05) built once (Eco:182, not saved), ticked by `RegenerateClassResource` (Po:198-212, Sim:235).
- Gains: `Resource()` (Sk:76-80, the only helper that emits RESOURCE events), basic attack +5 (Act:154), mana steal/lucky hit (Atr:100,109), potions (R/CombatSimulation.Potions.cs:77), LM03 (Eff:42).
- Costs: legacy `Cost()` (Sim:283-290, reductions capped 50%), native `ClassCost` (Ps:77-81); planners and HUD call these (Sim:274, EdN:56, EdS:48, EdT:31).
- `resourceRatio` is read before payment (Sk:160; legacy Sk:223 runs at Act:66, before Act:67) and becomes `reserve` (>=60%) / `highResource` (>=80%) (Ps:22) for MP17 (Ps:112). The basic attack is the mana filler (`MageActiveShort`, EdMB:12-28).

**Element state (three separate mechanisms).**
1. `CS.lastElement` (Stt:42; saved; 0 = none; validated 0..3, Pers:25; never reset). Only writer: `PrepareReactiveShield` (Id:74, from `AfterClassCast` Ps:49) when a cast with element 1..3 is RELEASED. Cast element = static `ClassSkills.ElementOf` (Cat:69-70: Fire 1, Cold 2, Lightning 3; M04, M05, BASIC and the "TriElement" ultimates give 0). Only combat reader: the M05 reaction (Id:75). Deleting M05 deletes the only writer, yet M17-1 and M18-2 read it: keep Id:74.
2. `ItemEffects.lastElement/lastElementTime/elementHitTicks[6]/elementBuff` (GC:303-305, saved): written per damage event by `RecordElementHit` (Passives.cs:36-45, from `ApplyOutgoing` Dmg:50) for native definitions only (BASIC counts as lightning, `EXTRA:` does not) and only while MP06 is learned (`Stats.passives[5]`). A second element within 80 ticks sets `elementBuff`=4 s, read by `CaptureDamage` (Sim:494; buffs later snapshots, not the triggering hit), M17's auto-cast (Au:142-143) and option ELEMENT_BUFF (Po:102). Cleared when MP06 is dropped (Passives.cs:50-55).
3. Per-cast counters: `Cycle` (Ps:14-19; `Counter` effects with a `history` list, saved) for MP16 (Ps:40) and M18 (Ps:41); MP11 count (Ps:38-39); cast flags `lightningCharge`, `elementCharge` (Stt:33).
- Nothing is stored per enemy: no element mask, no damage-while-frozen (`StatusEffect` CE:11-18 has no accumulator; `TickStatuses` Eff:148-166 has no expiry hook; bosses never get a Freeze status, Eff:98-103).
- Static-element trap: M07's element will come from the modifier, but cast creation (Sk:160,223), Au:139,142,144, Po:101,104, Ps:87 and test helpers (PT:15,21) all call static `ElementOf`, and Fx:147 hard-codes element 1. Make it loadout-aware and use `a.element`.

## B. Per skill (CS = current numbers, SD4 = spec)

### M07 Elemental Lance (T1, native, SD4:2948; today Ember Lance, unlock Lv22)
- Now: CS:2850 cd 3, cost 18, range 10, coef 1.4, width .6, targets 3, prepare .5, burn bank .6 over 3 s (RP:321). Fx:147 = `Line` + `SkillHit` + `Dot("M07")`. Auto Au:131 (>=2 aligned, or a non-burning elite; literals 10/.6/3), Po:55,63. Burn flag Ps:97 (`HasDot("M07")||InFirewall`) feeds MP07 (Ps:129). DES_LM41 Fx:147.
- Base: spec D120->168 (CS 1.4); +6->10 mana on hit is new (B: `Resource(..,"M07",a.root)` as W08 Fx:101; per hit or per cast?); no cost/cooldown in spec; no-modifier default is fire without burn (Plan:536). As the generator its auto rule must become "cast while mana is not full".
- M07-1 Ember **A\***: current body; `Dot` multiplies `a.rankScale` (Fx:40): pass the modifier value (D60->100).
- M07-2 Glacier **B**: M09 body (Fx:149-150: slow .35/3 s, freeze an already-slowed enemy), element 2, freeze 0.6->1.0 s (M09: .8).
- M07-3 Grounding **B**: M12 body (Fx:153) + conduit. The relay keys on literal "M12": Id:136,142-144, Ps:148-152, Au:59-65,136, Po:65. The spear is planted at `a.aim` (Fx:83), not at the 12 m end; 4->6 s (M12: 6); relay reach 4 m literal (Id:136).
- Per-modifier range/width/targets/prepare (10/9/12, .6/.7/.8, 3/3/5, .5/.45/.45) are read at Sk:130,159 (prepare, before the cast exists), Au:37,41,50,57, Po:55, Fx:147: overlay `N()` (Sk:28). Element literals -> `a.element`.

### M01 Fireball (T2 core, legacy idx 12, SD4:3043)
- Now: GC:479 cost 25, coef 2.1, range 10, r 2.5 (CS:598). The projectile (Proj:35-36) explodes on the first enemy, range end or wall (Proj:79,95); `FireballImpact` (Proj:102-112) hits everyone in the circle as "M01" (+MP01 +30% at >=3, dropped; LM02 echo Proj:110; SM4 frost mark). D210->294 = the rank +10% already; cost 25->21 needs a rank term in `Cost()`.
- Planners: `PlanEdictFireball` EdF:70-102 (GROUP = >=3 in the circle), `ForecastEdictFireball` EdF:29-69 (speed 14, first collision), Fc:89-98, `ObservedProjectileAim` (speed 14, skill 12 only, Fc:103-123).
- M01-1 Meteor **B**: impact after 1 s at the aim, no flight. Reuse a projectile with `delay` (Proj:56-58) and `remaining=0` (impact Proj:95), or `ScheduleExtra` (Cs:111-114, but `Set` damage). Radius x1.5 at Proj:36, EdF:66, Fc:95; forecasts need the delay and no first-collision. Spec conflict: x1.4->1.8 vs behaviour "area x1.5, damage x1.6".
- M01-2 Splitting **B**: 3 small shots from the impact. `Shot()` takes an action and sets origin (Proj:11-16); `extra` shots are hard-labelled "SAB4"/`Set` (Proj:86): label "EXTRA:M01" (also avoids base-rank scaling, Dmg:66). D40->60 from the modifier.
- M01-3 Piercing **C**: pierce is B (`explosionRadius=0`, large `maxHits`, Proj:80-90), but the 2->4 s burn trail has no host: kind 12 ground is one-shot (Sim:595) and `InFirewall` is one rectangle bound to `Fx("M08")` (Fx:164). Needs a trail-segment effect; planners need a line forecast (`ForecastLine`, Fc:28) instead of the circle.

### M02 Blizzard (T2 core, legacy idx 13, SD4:3138)

pages.body:
# D4 skill tree: dependents outside the combat engine (read-only audit)

Prefixes (absolute): W=/Users/t8g-2410-pn-005/Documents/MyProject/HELLSCRIPT/wt-d4-skill-plan; RC=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Runtime/Core; RP=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Runtime/Presentation; RR=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources; T=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Tests/Editor; E=W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Editor. Counts are my own greps unless marked (tool).

## 0. Reading the inventory
- Tool: 12,680 refs/475 files; groups 1-5 = 4,609 refs/133 files (`--check` exits 1). About 197 refs in 13 files are SVG path data (`M12 2 ...`, zero quoted ids): Prototypes RuneBoard html 148, Jeweler 12, RiftEntry/ui.js 5, AspectStone ui+svg 6, TrainingGround 8, Blacksmith 11, DailyQuests 3, tools/blacksmith/export-resources.cjs 4. Real prototype hits: SkillTree/*, HuntEdict/*, RiftVictory/{ui.js,build.cjs,source-manifest.json}, RiftEntry/engine.test.cjs, AspectStone/catalog.json.
- It counts removed ids only. Blind spots, covered below: kept ids whose rules change (W01 becomes T2; A06/M07 change meaning), the version gate `ClassSkillTree.Uses` (55 sites/29 files), `ClassSkillTree.Unlocked` (17 non-smoke lines/11 files), level 30/40 literals, UI element names tutorials aim at.

## A. Old skill window(s)
**Builders.** No standalone skill window exists; the tree is the "skills" tab of the unified edict window.
- RP/HuntEdictWindow.cs:40-51 `Open`: `Session.UseSkillTree(hero)` :48; `ContentWindowHost.Attach(view,view.HandleBack)` :49; `StoreViewBinding.Attach(view,store,view.Repaint,()=>!HasDialog&&!HuntEdictOrderCard.Dragging,view.DisclosureDisplayKey)` :50 (key holds `StoreViewBinding.Key(hero.build.classSkills)`, HuntEdictWindow.Progression.cs:99-103). `DrawSkills()` :112; `HandleBack` :59-60; `SelectTab` :142; `SelectSkillPage` :152; draft model with Save/Revert footer :124-135, `Change` :173-179.
- RP/HuntEdictWindow.Skills.cs (455 lines): `SelectSkill` :23; `DrawSkills` :35; `DrawTreePanel` :66 (list mode :71-76; tree mode :77-104 with Art/SkillTree/tree-backdrop + skill-point-gem); `DrawTreeCanvas` :106 and `DrawTreeNode` :208 (`SkillTreeLayout`, SkillTreeGraphic.cs:13-20); `ChangeRank/Equip/Unequip` :251-262; slot bubble :263-346; `OpenSkillPolicy` :348; `DrawSkillBar` :361 (4 actives + ultimate, `NodeFrame` :233-244); `DrawSkillDetails` :399 (inspector; buttons `edict-skill-rank-down|up|equip` :441-443; unlock rows :430-434).
- Policy page HuntEdictWindow.SkillPresets.cs:54 (back button "스킬 트리로" :59; order :163-167; options :169-184); CombatPreview.cs (text "레벨 40 · 스킬 1등급" :90).
- `ShowLegacyEdictEditor` RP/GameUI.EdictEditor.cs:27: private `Base("edict")` page; `SkillName` = `game.catalog.skills.Single` :21 throws for ids outside the 18 legacy slots. Reached only from its own legacy share page (GameUI.EdictShare.cs:28) and 13 smokes: Runtime{Blizzard,Chain,Fireball,MageBasic,Nova,Ranger,Shield,Slam,Teleport,WarriorAttack,WarriorSupport}Smoke.cs:33, RuntimeTargetSmoke.cs:74, RuntimeLanguageSmoke.cs:183. Not tree UI; keep while those smokes live.
- Other pickers: rift entry RP/RiftEntryWindow.cs:336-356 + Popups.cs:75-125 (learned candidates; `Store.ReplaceRiftSkill` RC/GameStore.RiftEntry.cs:39-51); training lobby TrainingGroundWindow.Skills.cs:12-62.

**Entry points.**
- Whole edict window: hub RP/GameUI.cs:242-244 and :446; dock GameUI.ContentDock.cs:31; observation menu GameUI.GlobalHud.cs:130; GameUI.{RiftVictory.cs:11, TrainingEquipment.cs:31, Comparison.cs:210-216 (loads a recorded loadout as draft), PuzzleHub.cs:41, Puzzle.cs:44, PuzzleOpening.cs:44, Tutorials.cs:105-110 (guides F06/H07/H08 target "skills"), FirstPlay.cs:19-23 (`SelectTab`+`SelectSkillPage(true)`+`SelectSkill(id)`), TrainingGround.cs:38-42 (`OpenSkillPolicy`)}.
- Direct tree page (`ShowEdictSkillTree` GameUI.HuntEdict.cs:69): RiftEntryWindow.cs:355; SkillPresets.cs:59; HuntEdictWindow.cs:60. Not in plan 9.1: HuntEdictWindow.Presets.cs:96-99 (a stored preset whose allocation fails validation jumps to the skills tab). Recommended mode keeps the manage page editable (HuntEdictWindow.cs:85,147,176). No NPC/plaza route exists.
- Smoke flags: one class gates eight (RP/RuntimeSkillTreeSmoke.cs:44: SkillTree, SkillReset, SkillMenu, SkillPreset, SkillCombatPreview, SkillIdentity, RegressionRepair, EdictSections); also `-hellscriptClassSkillSmoke` (RC/ClassSkillNativeSmoke.cs:38), BattleQuickEdit (RuntimeBattleQuickEditSmoke.cs:213), QuickPreset, GuideTutorial, Tutorial.

**Reads/writes.** Reads `store.Data`, `hero.build.classSkills`, rune levels `new HeroStats(hero,false,store.Data.runes).runeSkillLevels` (Skills.cs:19), `ClassSkillTree/ClassSkills/ClassSkillOptions`, `HuntEdictProgression`, `PuzzleTutorial`, `SkillProgressionInfo.Compare` (Skills.cs:436-438). Writes only via the commit lambda RP/GameUI.HuntEdict.cs:25-52 (4 contexts: comparison `ValidateB`+`ApplyHuntEdict`; training/puzzle `ApplyTrainingHuntEdict` or sandbox `game.PuzzleStore.CommitHuntEdict`; guide; normal/live `GameStore.CommitHuntEdict` RC/GameStore.HuntEdict.cs:9-62 with `PrepareHuntEdictChange`/`PrepareSuspendedHuntEdictChange`), plus `SetRecommendedEdict` (GameStore.Edict.cs:9) and immediate policy saves (`SaveSkillPolicy` RC/HuntEdictLoadout.cs:126-137). Every store edit API needs the selected hero (GameStore.HuntEdict.cs:13, GameStore.Edict.cs:13,30,61, GameStore.RiftEntry.cs:43): plan D2's per-hero tabs need a new per-hero commit.

**Delete / keep / flag.**
- Delete at phase 7: Skills.cs:66-104 tree branch and :106-230, `BandNames` :24, unlock rows :430-434, `SkillTreeLayout`, RR/Data/ClassSkillTree.json, Art/SkillTree/tree-backdrop + skill-point-gem (+E/ResourceTextureBudget.cs:33,76), en.txt:5286-5336, Prototypes/SkillTree, tools/build_skill_tree.cjs, RuntimeSkillTreeSmoke* (954 lines), SkillTreeIntegrationTests layout test (:207-214), caller-less `GameStore.CommitClassSkills` (RC/ClassSkillCodec.cs:69-81).
- Keep: `SkillTreeGraphic` (glyphs HuntEdictWindow.Glyphs.cs:10, diagrams SkillPresetExampleView.cs:106), skill bar, slot bubble, policy page, order editor, Art/SkillTree/node-frame-*.
- Keep or port: the tutorial list-mode UI (`DrawAvailableSkills` HuntEdictWindow.Progression.cs:35-45; inspector +/equip; guards Skills.cs:23,251-252). Plan 12 says only "tree and inspector"; four tutorial files aim at these names (C).
- Flag at: `ShowEdictSkillTree`, `DrawSkills`, RiftEntryWindow.cs:355, FirstPlay.cs:22, SkillPresets.cs:59 (label must stop saying "skill tree"), Presets.cs:99, Tutorials.cs:110, TrainingGround.cs:41.
- Hazard, not in plan: the edict window's `HuntEdictEditSession` is built once (HuntEdictWindow.cs:48) and refreshed only by its own commit (GameStore.HuntEdict.cs:59); `StoreViewBinding` just calls `Repaint` (:50,138-141), which redraws the stale draft. A D4 window above it that commits would be reverted by the parent's next Save, and the parent's equip bar shows old ranks. The parent must `AcceptSaved`/rebuild after each child commit.

## B. Battle quick edit, HUD, recommended skills (PR #83: HuntEdictQuickMenu, GameUI.{EdictQuick,SkillQuick}, GlobalHudView, HoldPress, RuntimeBattleQuickEditSmoke; the potion quick files hold no skill logic)
**Today.** HUD slots: 3 potions, 4 actives, 1 ultimate (RP/GlobalHudView.cs:58-60,128-131). Tap -> `SkillSlotTapped` (RP/GameUI.SkillQuick.cs:21-39): candidates = learned, unequipped skills of the slot kind (`HuntEdictQuickMenu.SkillCandidates` RC/HuntEdictQuickMenu.cs:57-58; slot 4 = ultimates), then, while a point is free, level/lineage-unlocked rank-0 skills (`LearnableSkills` :60-61, drawn dim, SkillQuick.cs:36). Tap a candidate -> `EquipQuickSkill` :84-96 (`ClassSkillTree.Equip` + `CommitHuntEdict(session,catalog,game.Combat,true)`). Hold (0.3 s + 0.7 s gauge) -> `ShowSkillPopup` :97-126 (`ClassSkillDisplay.Description`; "레벨 올리기" = `RankQuickSkill` :127-137, base +1 only; "장착"; use presets). Only in ordinary rift fights (`QuickBattleEditable`, GameUI.EdictQuick.cs:24-32) or the guide stage; `SkillQuickAvailable` (SkillQuick.cs:19) uses `ClassSkillTree.Uses` (= v3/v4), so a v5 loadout silently disables it. Display: `GlobalHudSnapshot.Read` fills skills only for v3/v4 (RP/GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:86-103); `HudSlotState` (:9-14) has no rank/modifier; icon `SkillIconAssets.TryResolve` (GlobalHudView.cs:140, SkillIconView.cs:57-71); cooldown = radial `Cover` + `TimeLabel` (GlobalHudView.cs:143-146).
The HUD does not choose "recommended skills". The recommended things are: `useRecommendedEdict` (RC/HuntEdictDefaults.cs:11-34: keeps allocation/slots, clears `options`/`presetSelections`, automatic = all); `FirstPlayRecommendation` skill steps (RC/FirstPlayRecommendation.cs:28-40); legacy "현재 레벨 추천" `BehaviorPresets.ForLevel` (GameUI.Growth.cs:49-72; level clamp 1-30, BehaviorPresets.cs:13; not tree-aware); 122 use presets (RR/HuntEdictQuickPresets.json) and the "identity" order (RC/HuntEdictQuickPresets.cs:112).
**Changes.**
- Modifier chosen: add `rank/modifier/modifierRank` to `ClassSkillStatus` (RC/ClassSkillReadModel.cs:7-14) and `HudSlotState`. `TryResolve` returns false for `W01-3` (no `ClassSkills.Find`; a 5-char id misses the legacy branches :63-70): add a `<base>-<n>` branch (art `Art/ClassSkillIcons/<Class>/<id>`) if a badge is wanted. Put modifier name + shape sentence + n/5 into `ClassSkillDisplay.Description/Activation` (RC/ClassSkillDisplay.cs:9-31), used by the HUD (GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:94,99), popup (SkillQuick.cs:102), rift-entry popup (RiftEntryWindow.Popups.cs:105-107). Popup: "+1 on the chosen modifier / pick one" and the plan's blocked reasons; swap/refund only in town (D3). First fix `ClassSkillTree.Display`: its regex matches `A06` inside `A06-2` (ClassSkillTree.cs:119-120). Other icon/name sites: TrainingGroundWindow.Skills.cs:53-58, RiftSkillShareView.cs:35, TrainingChartView.cs:62,113-114, StatusStripView.cs:109, GameUI.GlobalHud.cs:51-55, toast SkillQuick.cs:94; `TrainingGround.DescribeChanges` (RC/TrainingGround.cs:214-229) should diff modifier/rank. HUD badge vs name is undecided in the plan.
- Unlearned: restate the v4 rule "unlearned cannot be equipped" (RC/ClassSkills.cs:123) for v5; rank 0 clears the slot (ClassSkillTree.cs:114-115) and must be refused while the modifier holds rank; candidates already skip rank 0 (HuntEdictQuickMenu.cs:58). `Unlocked(load,level,id)` is level+lineage; the (hero,level,id) overload (ClassSkillTree.cs:60; Tutorials.Progress.cs:17) cannot express tier gates. HUD `locked` (GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:94) loses meaning.
- Ultimate rank 3: `RankScale` is 1 for ultimates (RC/ClassSkills.cs:65; used ClassSkillDisplay.cs:19, ClassSkillReadModel.cs:22,26). Cooldown 60/55/50 reaches the HUD via `CS.ultimateTotal` (ClassSkillReadModel.cs:25; `Max(45,cd)` at CombatSimulation.ClassSkills.cs:163); persistence accepts totals 45-60 (ClassSkillPersistence.cs:26) and rankScale 1..1.401 (:37), so +20%/rank (1.4 at rank 3) fits by 0.001. Replace "Lv.40" gates by "T5 open or learned": GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:99, HuntEdictWindow.Progression.cs:33, RiftEntryWindow.cs:338,345,349,356, TrainingGroundWindow.Skills.cs:42, Tutorials.cs:56,214, en.txt:5758,5837.

## C. Tutorials and guide
Live flows: guide stage (flow 6; new accounts, warrior only: RC/GameStore.Guide.cs:11, RP/GameController.Tutorials.cs:16); puzzle (flow 5; accounts mid-puzzle plus every replay/hub: GameController.Tutorials.cs:17-20,50); pit/starter (old checkpoints only, RC/Tutorials.cs:153-169).
- Guide stage: `GuideTutorial.Skill="W01"` (RC/GuideTutorial.cs:13), `BarePowers`=`ResetAllocation` (:52-57), `LessonDone` :77, `StartGuideTutorial` GameStore.Guide.cs:18, copy/anchors "회오리", "스킬 포인트가 1점" (RP/GameUI.GuideTutorial.cs:36,70,94-102; `edict-quick-skill-*` names), fingerprint "tutorial-v6" (GuideTutorial.cs:12-13; mismatching checkpoints are dropped, Tutorials.cs:163). W01 is T2 (gate 2; skill_tree_d4.json rules.tierGates [0,2,6,11,40]), so the level-1 point cannot buy it. Rebase on W09 (plan D7): change `Skill`, copy, Version/Fingerprint; teach W01 only at 2+1 points (hero level 3); update RuntimeGuideTutorialSmoke, GuideTutorialTests (3).
- Prologue/starter/pit: `PrologueSkill/StarterComparison` hard-code W01/A01/M01 + presets stand/edge, elite/steady, steady/pack (RC/Tutorials.cs:98-101). Consumers: `ProloguePowers` (GameStore.Tutorials.cs:33-48: `ChangeRank` on a T2 skill at level 1 throws), `CanAdvancePrologueLesson` :93-100, CombatPreviewSession.cs:41-49, CombatSimulation.SkillPreview.cs:16-26, HuntEdictProgression.cs:101-102,165-168 (level-1 "first skill only", `owner.level>=2`), HuntEdictWindow.Progression.cs:37-38,90-98. Needs a T1 starter per class: W09/W08, A07/A14, M07 (mage has one T1 active).
- Overlays aim at old-window element names: RP/GameUI.TutorialStaging.cs:259-323, PuzzleOpening.cs:50-61, TutorialPit.cs:113-122, TutorialComparison.cs:10-29 (`edict-skill-<id>`, `edict-skill-rank-up|equip`, `edict-active-slot-0`, `edict-slot-policy`, `edict-policy-back`, `edict-preset-tab-*`, `edict-preset-activate`). Keep the lesson-mode UI or retarget four files.
- Puzzle (16 levels): RR/PuzzleTutorial.json kits, e.g. level 7: W01 W02 WP01 W03 / A01 A02 AP01 A03 A04 / M01 M02 MP01 M03 M04 at hero level <=7. W02 is T4, A03/A04/M04 T3, WP01 unlocks Lv4 (hero is 3 at puzzle 4), MP01 is removed (13 refs). Granted by `ClassSkillTree.ChangeRank` (RC/PuzzleTutorial.cs:100 `Instructor`, :150-163 `StartPowers`), validated :208-211 (`rank>1` forbidden): needs a kit/exempt API. Also GameUI.Puzzle.cs:18-30,57,72-76, CombatSimulation.Tutorial.cs:133,148,170. Saved loadouts: `puzzle.levels[].kitHero` (replay source PuzzleTutorial.cs:225-228), T/Fixtures/PuzzleAfterL8-{Mage,Ranger,Warrior}.json (553 refs; PuzzleContentTests.cs:94, PuzzleTutorialCoreTests.cs:26).
- F06/H07/H08/H17: RC/Tutorials.cs:33 (F06 copy "2레벨부터 받는 스킬 포인트"), :55-56 (H08 "레벨 40"), :214-217; Tutorials.Progress.cs:10-18 (F06 = open active never slotted, level>=2), :51-59 (H07 on `Spent` growth, H08 on ultimate); TutorialChapters.cs C05 {F06,H07}; FirstPlayRecommendation.cs:28-40; docs Tutorial_Progression.md:15,67-80. New rule: the first T2 skill needs 2 points in T1/passives = hero level 3 for every class, so the "level-2 point" premise (Tutorials.Progress.cs:10-12) is false and `NewSkills` needs the allocation, not level. `ClassPracticeLesson.cs:9,28` (A02/M02, both T2) must test "learned".
- New-player start: `StartNewHeroesWithoutSkills`+`ActivateSkillTrees` (RC/GameStore.SkillTree.cs:13-47; callers GameController.cs:65,238, GameController.Accounts.cs:23, GameUI.RiftKeeper.cs:15; skips heroes with a suspended run :30,34) emit v3/v4.

## D. Auto-battle / Hunt Edict
- Two layers. Legacy V2 document: 4 slots, `skillOrder`, option sets for 01-06 only (`HuntEdict.SkillIds` RC/HuntEdict.cs:56; HuntEdictV2.Options.cs:40-129; rule conditions, EdictValidation.cs:53); tree loadouts project into it only for `LegacyIndex>=0` ids (RC/ClassSkills.cs:150-161). Of 30 retained actives 17 are legacy-index; 13 are not (W08 W09 W17 W18 A07 A14 A17 A18 M07 M08 M11 M17 M18): they use `ClassSkillOptions` (55 groups/166 choices; 25/74 sit on removed actives) and cannot be picked by `survival.defenseSkill|escapeSkill|fallbackSkill`, `explore.cursedDefense` (EdictOptions.cs:63,70; HUD choices from `edict.slots`, HuntEdictHudRows.cs:23), which still list M05.
- Removed-id hits: HuntEdictV2.Options.cs:117-120 (M05), HuntEdictV2.Order.cs:49 (`BuffSkill`), :51,63,89 (compiled `edict:M05`, slot 16), HuntEdictV2.Availability.cs:50 (needs WP03), :73, :75; `UnlockLevel` use :27,35; HuntEdictV2.cs:91,94.

Plan 7 filters `order/automatic/options` only; also filter `presetSelections`, `legacyEdict` (slots, skillOrder, survival refs), `actives`, `ultimate`, `ranks`.
- `ClassSkillValidationBuild`: 30 builds in ClassSkills.json (29 touch removed ids); `CreateClassSkillValidation` (RC/CombatSimulation.ClassSkillValidation.cs:29-58) writes level 40 + free-form actives/passives/ultimate under `classSkillValidation`; `CreateSkillPreview` does likewise (CombatSimulation.SkillPreview.cs:31-38). Tier/point rules need an explicit fixture bypass. Users: T/ClassSkillCompatibilityTests.cs:18-26, ClassSkillPassiveMeasurement.cs:188.

## E. Tooling, docs, localization, art
- CI .github/workflows/class-skills.yml:22-29: `class_skill_runtime.py check` (111/123/60/55, :24-25,42); `class_skills.py check` (16/19/2 per class :42; 111/141 :38; ultimate unlock 40 rank 1 :48; 30 builds :69; sha256 of GameCatalog.cs, SkillEffects.cs, SkillProgression.cs, Itemization.cs, LegendaryPowers.json, ClassSetReference/catalog.json :97-113); `class_skill_options.py check` (55/166 :10,49); `class_skill_reports.py check` (90 builds + 18 `M13=`/`W02=` runs :25-34); `node Prototypes/SkillTree/build.cjs` + `git diff --exit-code` (embeds sha256 of ClassSkills.json and Docs/Design/ClassSkills/catalog.json, build.cjs:5-13); `node tools/build_skill_tree.cjs --check`; `node Prototypes/SkillTree/engine.test.cjs`. All fail on the first data edit. shared-ui.yml:19 runs `check_ui_contract.py --verify` (ADAPTERS :16-23; rules :63-77: unregistered `*Window`, Canvas owners, hex literals).

  • F06/H07/H08/H17: RC/Tutorials.cs:33 (F06 copy "2레벨부터 받는 스킬 포인트"), :55-56 (H08 "레벨 40"), :214-217; Tutorials.Progress.cs:10-18 (F06 = open active never slotted, level>=2), :51-59 (H07 on Spent growth, H08 on ultimate); TutorialChapters.cs C05 {F06,H07}; FirstPlayRecommendation.cs:28-40; docs Tutorial_Progression.md:15,67-80. New rule: the first T2 skill needs 2 points in T1/passives = hero level 3 for every class, so the "level-2 point" premise (Tutorials.Progress.cs:10-12) is false and NewSkills needs the allocation, not level. ClassPracticeLesson.cs:9,28 (A02/M02, both T2) must test "learned".
  • New-player start: StartNewHeroesWithoutSkills+ActivateSkillTrees (RC/GameStore.SkillTree.cs:13-47; callers GameController.cs:65,238, GameController.Accounts.cs:23, GameUI.RiftKeeper.cs:15; skips heroes with a suspended run :30,34) emit v3/v4.

D. Auto-battle / Hunt Edict

  • Two layers. Legacy V2 document: 4 slots, skillOrder, option sets for 01-06 only (HuntEdict.SkillIds RC/HuntEdict.cs:56; HuntEdictV2.Options.cs:40-129; rule conditions, EdictValidation.cs:53); tree loadouts project into it only for LegacyIndex>=0 ids (RC/ClassSkills.cs:150-161). Of 30 retained actives 17 are legacy-index; 13 are not (W08 W09 W17 W18 A07 A14 A17 A18 M07 M08 M11 M17 M18): they use ClassSkillOptions (55 groups/166 choices; 25/74 sit on removed actives) and cannot be picked by survival.defenseSkill|escapeSkill|fallbackSkill, explore.cursedDefense (EdictOptions.cs:63,70; HUD choices from edict.slots, HuntEdictHudRows.cs:23), which still list M05.
  • Removed-id hits: HuntEdictV2.Options.cs:117-120 (M05), HuntEdictV2.Order.cs:49 (BuffSkill), :51,63,89 (compiled edict:M05, slot 16), HuntEdictV2.Availability.cs:50 (needs WP03), :73, :75; UnlockLevel use :27,35; HuntEdictV2.cs:91,94.
  • Presets/scenarios change atomically: RR/HuntEdictQuickPresets.json 211 presets (122 skill, 50 on removed ids; 76 global; 9 basic; 4 order); RR/SkillPresetScenarios.json 122 scenarios (50 removed); SkillPresetScenario.All throws unless every non-passive catalog skill has exactly one scenario per preset (RC/SkillPresetScenario.cs:52-53). SkillPresetExampleView.cs:62-98 has M05/M13 scenes.
  • Saved policy ids: presetSelections for skill/<removed> make ClassSkillLoadout.Canonical throw (RC/HuntEdictSkillPresets.cs:19,22-35), unknown options throw (ClassSkillOptions.cs:46-52). Plan 7 filters order/automatic/options only; also filter presetSelections, legacyEdict (slots, skillOrder, survival refs), actives, ultimate, ranks.
  • ClassSkillValidationBuild: 30 builds in ClassSkills.json (29 touch removed ids); CreateClassSkillValidation (RC/CombatSimulation.ClassSkillValidation.cs:29-58) writes level 40 + free-form actives/passives/ultimate under classSkillValidation; CreateSkillPreview does likewise (CombatSimulation.SkillPreview.cs:31-38). Tier/point rules need an explicit fixture bypass. Users: T/ClassSkillCompatibilityTests.cs:18-26, ClassSkillPassiveMeasurement.cs:188.
  • Recommended-edict defaults: HuntEdictDefaults.Skills keeps allocation (a modifier rides along); SetRecommendedEdict is selected-hero only (GameStore.Edict.cs:9-22).

E. Tooling, docs, localization, art

  • CI .github/workflows/class-skills.yml:22-29: class_skill_runtime.py check (111/123/60/55, :24-25,42); class_skills.py check (16/19/2 per class :42; 111/141 :38; ultimate unlock 40 rank 1 :48; 30 builds :69; sha256 of GameCatalog.cs, SkillEffects.cs, SkillProgression.cs, Itemization.cs, LegendaryPowers.json, ClassSetReference/catalog.json :97-113); class_skill_options.py check (55/166 :10,49); class_skill_reports.py check (90 builds + 18 M13=/W02= runs :25-34); node Prototypes/SkillTree/build.cjs + git diff --exit-code (embeds sha256 of ClassSkills.json and Docs/Design/ClassSkills/catalog.json, build.cjs:5-13); node tools/build_skill_tree.cjs --check; node Prototypes/SkillTree/engine.test.cjs. All fail on the first data edit. shared-ui.yml:19 runs check_ui_contract.py --verify (ADAPTERS :16-23; rules :63-77: unregistered *Window, Canvas owners, hex literals).
  • Pipeline: Docs/Design/ClassSkills/{catalog,runtime_parameters,use_options}.json -> RR/Data/ClassSkills.json; Prototypes/SkillTree -> RR/Data/ClassSkillTree.json. Generated docs: Docs/Design/HELLSCRIPT_{Warrior,Ranger,Mage}_Skills(.en).md, HELLSCRIPT_Skill_Equipment(.en).md, Class_Skill_Use_Policies(.en).md. Inventory group 6: 342 files/8,071 refs.
  • balance_1000.py:222-231 (sha256 of ClassSkills.cs, GameStore.SkillTree.cs, ClassSkillTree.cs, GameStore.cs, Economy.cs, HeroStats.Blacksmith.cs, ClassSkills.json, ClassSkillTree.json); Balance1000/production_skill_tree_audit.json (skillTreeVersion:3, levelCap:40) read by test_balance_1000.py:19-25. wiki.py:143-163, :302 (skills:18,passives:18), :690-714 (tree_levels[id] KeyError; titles "108/164/55" :712-714,796-799); test_wiki.py:37-46,134-135 (:84's 108 = legendaries, unaffected). generate_sfx.py:83-86 + T/SoundBankTests.cs:150 + ClassSkillRuntimeTests.Audio.cs:12 (a skill.<id> sound per non-passive skill); audit_equipment_art.py:51; class_set_reference.py:38,55 and legendary_catalog.py:30 (ids limited to 01-06).
  • Localization: en.txt:5286-5336 (old tree), 20 lines naming removed skills (503-505, 1218-1220, 1679-1680, 1802-1803, 2126, 2133, 6460; :124 WP03), level-40 lines 5758, 5837, 6356. Names/descriptions live in ClassSkills.json (name/nameEn), GameCatalog.cs:466-484 and GameCatalog.Passives via Loc.T (GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:72), not in en.txt.
  • Art: 37 icons per class in RR/Art/ClassSkillIcons (A06/M07 are overwritten: check .meta guid); fallbacks RR/Art/GlobalHUD/passive-* and Art/SkillAtlas.png (SkillIconView.cs:63-70; T/HuntEdictFoundationTests.cs:215-231 loops the 12 legacy ids per class); Docs/Art/ClassSkillIcons/manifest.json (111; assemble_manifest.py:15 pass==111); E/ResourceTextureBudget.cs:24 already covers Art/ClassSkillIcons/; BuildResourceTests.cs:11, RuntimeBuildResourceSmoke.cs:21.
  • asmdef: one runtime asmdef (Core+Presentation+Runes) and Hellscript.Tests.asmdef absorb new files; only .meta files are needed.

F. Smokes and EditMode tests

Smokes: 158 files (157 RP/RuntimeSmoke.cs + RC/ClassSkillNativeSmoke.cs): 30 touch the old window API, 7 only removed ids, 8 only tree API, 113 untouched.

  • Replace: RuntimeSkillTreeSmoke{,.CombatPreview,.Identity,.Presets,.Sections}.cs (954 lines, 8 flags) -> -hellscriptSkillTreeD4Smoke. First move ExistingTrees/OpenEdict (RuntimeSkillTreeSmoke.cs:23-37; builds version=3 loadouts) to a shared fixture: 8 call sites in 7 files (RuntimeRiftEntrySmoke .cs/.Portal/.Pickers/.Preparation/.Repeat, EdictQuickPresetSmoke:105, TrainingGroundSmoke:121).
  • Port: EdictQuickPreset (18 hits), Tutorial{,.Puzzle,.Pit}, GuideTutorial, RecommendedEquipment.Controls, RiftEntry*, BattleQuickEdit{,.Order} (setup learns every "unlocked" skill, :227-234), EdictContract, Edict, Language, UiStyle, TrainingGround{,.SafeDodge}, TrainingEquipment, Target; id-bound: ClassSkillNativeSmoke (25 refs), Shield (M05/MP04), Ranger, WarriorAttack, ArtGallery, RiftVictory{,.Actions}, Effect, Passive, Charge (text).
  • Stay while ShowLegacyEdictEditor stays: Blizzard, Chain, Fireball, MageBasic, Nova, Slam, Teleport, WarriorSupport.

EditMode: 249 files, 4,518 cases (~2,731 methods); 29 files/462 refs name removed ids (101 methods in 27 files); ~64 files/~248 methods use tree/tutorial/preset APIs.

  • Delete or rewrite (pin old rules): SkillTreeIntegrationTests (17 methods/42 cases; layout :207-214, counts :59,68), ClassSkillRuntimeTests.cs:56-59 (37/16/19), ClassSkillBoundaryTests.cs:48,69 (37 ranks, cap 30), ClassSkillPassiveTests.cs:124, ClassSkillPolicyTests.cs:58 (55 options), HuntEdictFoundationTests.cs:198-231.
  • Port (methods): GuideTutorial 3, TutorialProgression 18, FirstPlaySkill 6, FirstPlayExperience 7, TutorialChapter 6, TutorialHeroSlots 9, Puzzle{Content 5, Opening 9, TutorialCore 10, Graduation 15, Level 1}, HuntEdict{Progression 20, QuickMenu 9, QuickPreset 5, SkillPreset 9, Overview 10, SuspendedSave 6, Defaults 5}, SkillPresetCombatPreview 10, TrainingGround 20, TrainingGroundUi 12, RecommendedEquipment (codec :210,239-242), ClassSkillCompatibility 7.
  • Engine-bound, id-bound (out of scope): ClassSkillPolicy 12 methods, ClassSkillRuntimeTests.Identity 12, .Contributions 9, EdictShield 9, Effect 8, EdictResponse 7, others 1-4 each.
  • Stay: the rest (~2,480 methods), incl. ContentTestAccounts (62 files; legacy 18-slot path).

G. Fifteen places most likely to be forgotten (risk order)

  1. CI class-skills.yml (7 steps, E) goes red on the first catalog edit; Prototypes/SkillTree/build.cjs hashes ClassSkills.json.
  2. Save read throws for any v3/v4 loadout invalid in the new catalog: RC/GameStore.cs:159-163 (hero.build), :166 and :413-414 (suspended run), :170-187 (presets[]). Migrate before Normalize and cover every holder: edictPresets[].loadout, edictLegacyBuild, trainingGround.records[].{previous,best}.loadout (RC/TrainingGround.cs:33), trainingComparison.baselineHeroJson, puzzle.levels[].kitHero, tutorialRun/tutorialSlots; filter presetSelections/options/legacyEdict too (D). Plan 7 names hero and order/automatic/options only.
  3. Suspended run/portal: ActivateSkillTrees skips such heroes (GameStore.SkillTree.cs:30,34) while ClassSkillPersistence.ValidateRun throws on cooldown/cast/effect ids of removed skills (:33,37,42,48: W15 loan, M13 channel, W02/M13 intent): the portal run becomes unreadable.
  4. ClassSkillTree.Uses (v3|v4, ClassSkillTree.cs:25) gates 55 sites: HUD (GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:86), quick edit (SkillQuick.cs:19), UsesTree, HeroStats (Economy.cs:129), TrainingGround.cs:37,214, ClassSkills.cs:60: all go silent for v5.
  5. Two writers of classSkills (stale parent session, A hazard) and no per-hero commit (A); the commit lambda has 4 contexts (GameUI.HuntEdict.cs:25-52).
  6. Tutorial overlays bound to old element names + the lesson-mode UI (C).
  7. Hand-built fixtures assume free-form loadouts: RuntimeSkillTreeSmoke.cs:29-37, CombatSimulation.SkillPreview.cs:31-38, ClassSkillValidation.cs:33-39, PuzzleTutorial.cs:95-108,147-176, GuideTutorial.cs:52-57, GameStore.Tutorials.cs:33-48, PuzzleAfterL8 fixtures: give the v5 validator one explicit kit/fixture path.
  8. Share codes: ClassSkillCodec.Decode demands byte-exact canonical JSON (RC/ClassSkillCodec.cs:19-52; wrapped by HuntEdictPresetCodec.cs:29-36,53-54), so new modifier fields break every existing HED4/HED5 code unless an old-wire branch exists (tests ClassSkillBoundaryTests.cs:46-49, RecommendedEquipmentTests.cs:210,239-242, ClassSkillPassiveTests.cs:124-132).
  9. Pinned counts: ClassSkills.cs:52-56 (111/123/60, unlock<=40), SkillPresetScenario.cs:52-53, ClassSkillOptions.cs:46 (<=55), plus E/F. Old and new catalogs cannot coexist behind the flag until versioned (6 key passives already push 111 up).
  10. 30/40 literals missing from plan 4: ClassSkills.cs:137,147; GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:99; HuntEdictWindow.Progression.cs:33; RiftEntryWindow.cs:345,349,356; GameUI.Growth.cs:20,36 (cap 30); BehaviorPresets.cs:13; CombatSimulation.SkillPreview.cs:31, ClassSkillValidation.cs:33; HuntEdictWindow.CombatPreview.cs:90; ClassSkillTree.cs:42 (cache key class*41+level); CombatSimulation.cs:14-15 + Economy.cs:128 (non-owned training uses LevelCap as hero level); Tutorials.cs:56,214.
  11. ClassSkillTree.UnlockLevel (:30) feeds engine LEVEL_LOCK (CombatSimulation.ClassSkills.cs:24) and HuntEdictV2Availability (:27); tiers have no unlock level.
  12. ID plumbing: SkillIconAssets.TryResolve, ClassSkillTree.Display regex, ClassSkills.Find null for W01-3; ClassSkills.Find(skill).legacy NREs for scopes naming removed ids (HuntEdictQuickPresets.cs:122,185, HuntEdictSkillPresets.cs:75).
  13. Legacy screens under-report because build.activeSkills holds only legacy ids: GameUI.SettingsInformation.cs:31-34, Presets.cs:88, Growth.cs:19-49, History.cs:16-17; legendary "requiredSkill Lv.N" text (InventoryLayout.cs:188-193); RuneMasteryCatalog.cs:59-61 and runeSkillLevels[18] (gear/rune +rank reaches only the 17 retained legacy-index actives; plan D5).
  14. Presentation keyed by old ids: GlobalHudSnapshot.cs:135-147, GameAudio.Combat.cs:21-27 + RR/Audio/Sfx/bank.json (30 refs), WorldView.SkillFx.cs:49-86 (M07 beam is fire-only though 원소창 picks its element), SkillPresetExampleView.cs:62-98.
  15. Process: CLAUDE.md needs bilingual docs and en.txt keys; 92 icons need .meta guid checks; manifest/balance/wiki fingerprints (E).

Open questions (not decidable from code)

  1. Suspended runs, portals, kitHero, training records at migration: convert, refund, or keep the old engine?
  2. Flag scope: plan 14 keeps the release path unchanged until phase 7, yet phase 2 changes schema 22, cap 60, point=level. Which are gated; can a flag-off build read schema 22 (RC/GameStore.cs:62)?
  3. Old share codes and stored edict presets: reject, or remap and refund?
  4. HUD: modifier badge/name or description only? Modifier +1 from the quick popup during a run (D3 says invest only)?
  5. Result/telemetry credit for absorbed skills (W10->W09-1): base rows or modifier rows (resultMetric, CombatTelemetry.Support, RiftSkillShareView, Prototypes/RiftVictory)?
  6. Guide stage starts at hero level 1: where is Whirlwind taught after "2 points" (plan 15, branch codex/guide-tutorial-segment2)? Which first skill for ranger/mage (only the warrior has a stage)?
  7. Does the 18-slot layer keep M05 (index 16) and the four skill-reference options; may the 13 non-legacy actives be escape/defense skills?
  8. Non-owned training (FullSkillTraining, CombatSimulation.cs:14-15) at cap 60: which allocation?
  9. Legacy "자동 행동 설계"/"성장과 스킬" are inert for tree heroes (GameStore.BuildChanges.cs:26-32 re-projects classSkills): delete or leave?
  10. Retire Prototypes/SkillTree and its CI steps, or regenerate them?

pages.body:
# D4 skill tree: save, migration and level-cap impact map (read-only)

**Paths.** W = `/Users/t8g-2410-pn-005/Documents/MyProject/HELLSCRIPT/wt-d4-skill-plan` (branch `claude/d4-skill-tree-plan`; runtime code is identical to main a3fe67c5). Aliases:
- `C` = `W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Runtime/Core`
- `P` = `W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Runtime/Presentation`
- `T` = `W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Tests/Editor`
- `R` = `W/Assets/HELLSCRIPT/Resources`
- `D` = `W/Docs/Design/D4SkillTree`

I did not run Unity. Everything below comes from reading code, `git log -S` and the spec JSON. `D/golden/csharp/` is untracked in W.

## 0. Findings that change the plan

1. **Put the migration in `GameStore.Read()`, before `Normalize(a)` (`C/GameStore.cs:68-70`).** Do not put it in post-load `ActivateSkillTrees` (`C/GameStore.SkillTree.cs:26-47`).
   - A post-load change goes through `Write()`. `HuntEdictProgression.ValidateTransaction(edictBoundary,…)` (`GameStore.cs:399-401`, `C/HuntEdictProgression.cs:193-216`) treats it as a player edit.
   - If that throws ArgumentException, `Write` reverts the heroes to the boundary and returns false (`GameStore.cs:445-450`). Startup then throws (`P/GameController.cs:65-67`) and the app does not start.
   - `edictBoundary` is captured after Read (`GameStore.cs:53`), so a Read-time migration is invisible to it.
2. **Only `NotSupportedException` aborts safely inside Read (`GameStore.cs:103`).** Any other exception returns null (`:104`), and the constructor falls back to `.bak` (`:40-43`). A failed migration would silently load the older generation. Wrap failures as `:162-163` does.
3. **`Write()` stamps `schema=MaximumSchemaVersion` on every save (`:402`).** The 21→22 bump is the only old-binary guard (`:62`). A raw `level>40` (`:64`) returns null, so an old binary would fall back to `.bak`.
4. **Adding any serialized field to `ClassSkillLoadout` or `SkillInvestment` makes every old HED4/HED5 code undecodable.** `ClassSkillCodec.Decode` compares canonical JSON (`C/ClassSkillCodec.cs:27-49`).
5. **Keep `ClassSkillLoadout.Canonical` version-preserving; convert at account level.** Hundreds of tests use version-2 "validation" heroes (`classSkillValidation=true`, level 40). Examples: `T/ClassSkillRuntimeTests.cs:23-30`, 12 refs in 9 files.
6. **`Rank(id)` returns 1 for ids missing from `ranks` (`C/ClassSkills.cs:84`).** That is wrong for v5, where unlearned means 0.
7. **After refund-all, a level-40 hero cannot buy an ultimate.**
   - Points equal level (40), and the T5 gate needs 40 spent outside T5 (`D/golden/reference/rules.js` `before/apply`). The first ultimate point needs level 41.
   - Tutorial H08 and the "Lv.40" strings assume 40.
8. **Three separate level-cap spots.**
   - `LevelCap` is 30 for unmigrated heroes and 40 otherwise (`ClassSkills.cs:62`).
   - Read has a raw 40 (`GameStore.cs:64`).
   - `Validate` has a raw 40 (`ClassSkills.cs:137`).
9. **Persisted hero copies hold old loadouts.** `PuzzleLevelProgress.kitHero` (`C/PuzzleTutorial.cs:30`) is a full `HeroSave` per cleared puzzle level. `TrainingComparisonRecord.baselineHeroJson` is another.
10. **Balance1000 hashes the core files.** An edit to `GameStore.cs`, `ClassSkills.cs`, `ClassSkillTree.cs`, `Economy.cs` and others (`tools/balance_1000.py:222-231`) forces regeneration of the 12 MB `projection.json`.

## A. Current storage model

**Version constants**
- `GameStore.MaximumSchemaVersion=21` (`GameStore.cs:11`). `AccountSave.schema` defaults to 2 (`C/GameCatalog.cs:179`).
- `Normalize` raises schema to at least 7 when a loadout exists (`:162`). `CommitClassSkills` writes 7 into memory (`ClassSkillCodec.cs:76,78`), so in-memory `Data.schema` is unreliable between saves.
- `ClassSkillLoadout`: `format="CLASS_SKILLS_V1"` and `version` 1..4 (`ClassSkills.cs:75-76,99`).
  - 1 is ids with a shared WP18.
  - 2 is slot-based passives and is the field default.
  - 3 is the tree with free base rank 1.
  - 4 is the tree, zero-based.
- `HuntEdictLoadout.version` is 1 (legacy 12-slot) or 2 (tree) (`C/HuntEdictLoadout.cs:10,32`). `HuntEdictPreset.version=1` (`:78`).
- `ClassSkillRuntimeState.version=1`, `format="CLASS_SKILL_RUN_V1"` (`C/ClassSkillState.cs:41-42`, `C/ClassSkillPersistence.cs:22`).
- `HuntEdictV2` Schema 2 / Content 1 / Global 8 / Option 2 / Policy 1 (`C/HuntEdictV2.cs:28`).
- `ClassSkillTree.json`: `version 1`, `levelCap 40`, `ultimateFrom/To 30/39`. `ClassSkills.Data.version==1` (`ClassSkills.cs:52`).
- Share codes: HED4 (`ClassSkillCodec.cs:17`), HED5 with `TreePayload.schema=4` (`C/HuntEdictPresetCodec.cs:22,36,52`), HED3 with `Payload.schema=3` (`:17`).

**`SkillInvestment {id; rank=1}`** (`ClassSkills.cs:72`)
- There is one entry per catalog skill, 37 per class.
- It is validated only inside `Canonical` (`:122`): the count must equal the catalog size, ids must be distinct, and `MinimumRank<=rank<=maxRank`.
- It has no migration of its own.
- v5 adds `modifier` and `modifierRank`. JsonUtility keeps field initializers for absent keys (proof: `T/GemServiceTests.cs:76-80` strips `gemCapacity` and gets 50). So `modifier=-1` is the correct default; 0 would mean "modifier 1 chosen".

**`ClassSkillLoadout`** (`ClassSkills.cs:73-173`)
- Fields: `format, version, heroClass, actives[4], passives[3], order[], automatic[], ultimate, ranks, options{id,choice}, presetSelections{scope,preset}, legacyEdict`.
- `IsAbsent` (`:86`) means version ≤2 with everything empty, because JsonUtility materializes missing objects.
- `Canonical` (`:97-133`):
  - format/version whitelist `:99`
  - slots `:117-120`
  - v≥3 passives must be empty `:120`
  - v4 equipped skills need rank>0 `:123`
  - `order` must equal equipped actives plus ultimate plus BASIC exactly `:124-125`
  - `automatic` ⊆ that set `:126`
  - legacyEdict canonical and same class `:127-129`
  - `ClassSkillOptions.Validate` `:130`
  - `HuntEdictSkillPresets.ValidateSelections` `:131`
- `Validate(hero)` (`:134-149`): level 1..40 at `:137`; tree branch `:138-144` (equipped and ranked skills must be Unlocked, `Remaining>=0`); departing needs an ultimate at ≥40 at `:147`.
- Migrations:
  - v1→2 runs inside `Canonical` (`:101-115`, WP18→WP19, "preserve total spending").
  - v2→3 is `ClassSkillTree.Upgrade` (`C/ClassSkillTree.cs:62-72`): clears passives and refunds below-requirement ranks to 1.
  - v3→4 is never automatic. It happens by explicit `ResetAllocation` (`:31-37`) or `StartNewHeroesWithoutSkills` (`GameStore.SkillTree.cs:13-23`).
  - An absent loadout becomes one through `ClassSkillLoadout.FromHero` (`ClassSkills.cs:87-96`), which reads legacy `skillRanks/activeSkills/passives/edict`.

**`ClassSkillTree.cs`**
- `Uses` (`:25`) is v3||v4. `MinimumRank` `:26`. `Spent` `:27`. `Remaining` `:28` = `max(0,level-(v4?0:1))-Spent`. `UnlockLevel` `:30`.
- Fixed-point `Available` (`:40-58`) clamps level to 0..40 with cache key `heroClass*41+level` (`:42`).
- `Equip` `:79-98`. `ChangeRank` `:108-117`.
- `Display` regex `[WAM]P?\d{2}|BASIC` (`:119-120`):
  - `A06-2` renders as "name-2".
  - `WP20` matches, but `Name()` returns the raw id because new ids are not in the 111 catalog.

**`GameStore.SkillTree.cs`**
- `StartNewHeroesWithoutSkills` (`:13-23`) is `ResetAllocation(FromHero)` plus `ApplyHuntEdict` for brand-new accounts. This is exactly the all-refunded result wanted.
- `ActivateSkillTrees` (`:26-47`) stages a copy, skips heroes with `classSkillValidation`, a v3/v4 loadout, or a suspended run (`:30,34`), and keeps `edictLegacyBuild??=build.Copy()` (`:35`). It calls `ApplyHuntEdict` (`:37`), then `Write(staged)` (`:41`) and adopts (`:42-43`).

**Save classes** (`C/GameCatalog.cs`)
- `BuildConfig` `:54-79`: `classSkills` `:56`, legacy `activeSkills` `:59`, `passives` `:76`, `skillRanks[12]` `:77`.
- `HeroSave` `:122-155`: `level` `:135`, `build` `:138`, `presets` (5 BuildConfig) `:145`, `edictPassiveSlots` `:148`, `edictPresets` (5) `:149`, `edictLegacyBuild` `:151`, `trainingComparison` `:131`, `trainingGround` `:132`, `classUltimateRemaining/Total` `:127`.
- `AccountSave` `:157-199`: `transactions` `:194`, `suspendedRun` `:195`, `repeatHunt` `:196`.
- `RunState`: `classSkills` runtime state `:333`, `build` `:423`.

**Legacy 12-slot projection**
- `ProjectLegacy` (`ClassSkills.cs:162-172`) writes:
  - `activeSkills` only for ids with `LegacyIndex>=0`, i.e. W01-06/A01-06/M01-06, indices 0..17 (`:66-68`).
  - `passives` for legacy-flagged ids only.
  - `skillRanks[12]=Max(1,Rank(SkillProgression.Id(class,i)))` (`:168`): i<6 is xP01-06, i≥6 is x01-06 (`C/SkillProgression.cs:23-30`).
  - `rules` filtered to equipped bridge skills.

**`ClassSkillCodec`**
- `Encode` (`:13-18`) is `HED4.`+base64(`ToJson(Canonical)`)+sha256, capped at 65536 bytes.
- `Decode` (`:19-52`) checks the hash, then requires `Encode(value)==code`. Otherwise it accepts only:

  - older `legacyEdict.globalVersion` (`:36-41`)

- `Import` (`:53-64`) routes HED4 or the legacy `HuntEdictPresetImport` path.
- HED5 wraps a HED4 string inside `TreePayload`, and `JsonUtility.ToJson(tree)!=json` is checked strictly (`HuntEdictPresetCodec.cs:52-58`).

## B. Save pipeline

**Paths**
- Saves are local only. `<dir>/hellscript-local-v1.json` plus `.bak` and `.tmp`.
- `<dir>` is `Application.persistentDataPath` or `-hellscriptSavePath` (`P/GameController.cs:45-46`). Per profile it is `accounts/guest-<32hex>` or `accounts/google-<64hex>`, indexed by `account-profiles-v1.json` (`C/AccountProfiles.cs:13-45,70-101`).
- Account switching opens another directory via `OpenAccountStore` (`P/GameController.Accounts.cs:21-25`): constructor + `StartNewHeroesWithoutSkills` + `ActivateSkillTrees` + `Save`. This is a second migration entry, and every old profile directory needs it.
- No server copy of `AccountSave` exists. Server stores sessions, live settings and combat summaries/payloads (`server/sites/README.md`; `C/ContentUnlocks.cs:131`). `server/combat_analytics.sql:21-22` reads `$.journal.initialBuild.classSkills` and `$.review.finalBuild.classSkills`.
- WebGL flushes via `FS.syncfs` (`Plugins/WebGL/PlayerAuthentication.jslib:36,40`).

**Order inside `Read(file)`** (`GameStore.cs:57-105`)
1. Parse `:61`.
2. Newer-schema throw `:62`.
3. Structural null (heroes==3, cores==8) `:63`.
4. `level<1||>40` null `:64`.
5. `level>LevelCap` or classSkills-present-but-not-Enabled throw `:65-66`.
6. `MigrateRetiredGemStacks` `:68`.
7. `HuntEdictProgression.Normalize(a,legacy:true)` `:69`.
8. `Normalize(a)` `:70` (`:119-169`). Per hero it runs `HuntEdictV2Storage.Normalize`, `NormalizePresetSlots`, `HuntEdictStorage.Normalize`, then `ClassSkillLoadout.Validate`+`ProjectLegacy` (`:159-164`); runs get `ValidateRun` (`:166`).
9. Archive `.before-content-unlocks-v2.json` `:71-75`.
10. Items and gems (schema≥2) `:76-95`, with archive `.gem-recovery-<guid>.json`.
11. `.schema{n}-before-hunt-edict.json` when schema<6 `:96-100`.

The constructor (`:32-56`) tries main, then `.bak`, then throws `InvalidDataException` if either exists but is unreadable, else creates a new account (`:40-43`). It runs `Migrate` for schema 1 (`:44-48,106-118`), then `CaptureEdictBoundary` `:53`, then `SettleLocalIdle` `:286-312`, which is the first persist of any migration.

**Registry**
- There is none. Migrations are imperative blocks keyed by `schema<N` or module version stamps, ordered by position in `Read`/`Normalize`.
- Examples of version stamps: `Tutorials.cs:116` (`schema>=17` gate), `OfflineSupplies.cs:40`, and the `HuntEdictV2.GlobalVersion` waterfall `EquipmentRecommendation.Upgrade` (`C/EquipmentRecommendation.cs:35-83`).

**Unknown newer versions**
- Account schema >21: `NotSupportedException`, file untouched, no `.bak` fallback (`:62,103`).
- Loadout version >4: `Canonical` ArgumentException, wrapped as NotSupported (`:162-163`).
- Runs: `ClassSkillPersistence` wraps errors as NotSupported, "original save is preserved" (`:55-56`).
- `GameController` shows the message and disables itself (`P/GameController.cs:67`).
- `CombatJournalData.saveSchema=MaximumSchemaVersion` (`C/CombatJournal.cs:152`) is not validated by the server.

**Backup and rollback**
- `Write` writes `.tmp`, then `File.Replace(tmp,path,path+".bak")` (`:430-436`).
- `.bak` holds only the previous generation. After the second save the pre-migration bytes are gone.
- Only an explicit copy survives: `File.Copy(file, file+".schema"+n+"-before-…json", false)` guarded by `!File.Exists` (`:71-75,96-100`), or a Guid-suffixed variant (`:88-90`).
- There is no downgrade. An old binary refuses schema 22, and the archive is the manual rollback artifact.

**Receipt / refund**
- Refund is derived, not stored: `Remaining=level-Spent`. A v5 loadout (`version==5`) is itself the idempotence marker.
- One-time notice, option 1 (transient): a `GemRecoveryMessage`-style property set in Read and merged into `Notice` at `P/GameController.cs:69-70`. It shows once because the next save no longer migrates.
- One-time notice, option 2 (persistent, if it must wait for the first window open per plan ch.7): a per-hero struct, e.g. `{version,fromVersion,level,refunded,acknowledged}`.
  - JsonUtility materializes absent classes, so test absence by content, as `HuntEdictV2Storage.IsAbsent` does (`C/HuntEdictV2.Storage.cs:12`).
  - Acknowledge via `Transact("d4-skill-ack:"+heroId,"d4-skill-ack",…)` like `AcknowledgeOfflineSupplies` (`GameStore.cs:313-315`). `EconomyReceipt{requestId,operation,committedUtc}` is at `GameCatalog.cs:201-205`.
- In-save backup exists as precedent (`edictLegacyBuild`, `:151`). For D4 prefer the file archive only, because old loadouts would not validate under the new catalog.

**Pattern to copy**
- *Closest, retire-id migration with archive and notice* (git 5a33ecef, 93995a0f, 8a54d626, 2026-09-23):
  - `C/GameStore.Gems.cs:8-27`. It is static, load-only, and also rewrites `suspendedRun` and `repeatHunt.pendingResult`.
  - `GameStore.cs:68,83-94` and `P/GameController.cs:69-70`.
  - Tests `T/GemSocketTests.cs:266-298`.
- *Loadout version bump* (git 7dc11ff1, v4, 2026-09-28). It touched:

  - `ClassSkills.cs` `Enabled`, the `Canonical` whitelist (`:99`), passive rule (`:120`), min rank (`:122`), equip rule (`:123`), `Validate` (`:138`), `RankScale` (`:65`), `ProjectLegacy` (`:168`).

## D. Migration design check

**Facts.** The 111 legacy ids split as:
- 54 keep their id. This includes A06 and M07, which are reworked and keep their id.
- 22 are absorbed as modifiers.
- 2 actives are removed: M13 and M15.
- 33 passives are removed.

So 57 ids vanish as standalone. The 6 key passives (WP20/21, AP20/21, MP20/21) and 84 modifier ids do not exist in `ClassSkills.json`. The default decision (plan D4/D10) is to refund everything.

**Algorithm.** `SkillTreeD4Migration.Apply(AccountSave)`: public static (the test assembly has no InternalsVisibleTo), pure, no I/O, and it returns a report. Call it from `Read()` before `Normalize`, and from `GameStore.Sandbox` and tests. `Sandbox` bypasses Read (`C/GameStore.Sandbox.cs:8`), and fixtures are loaded straight into `AccountSave` (`T/PuzzleContentTests.cs:93-94`).

Input: the account plus kept/removed sets derived from `legacyRemap`. Ship `legacyRemap` (or its sets) in `SkillTreeD4.json`; the plan's generator does not list it.

For each hero with `!classSkillValidation` and loadout version <5 (absent counts as 0):
1. `old = absent ? ClassSkillLoadout.FromHero(h) : Canonical(h.build.classSkills)`. This needs the legacy 111 catalog and `ClassSkillTree.json`, so keep them. Alternatively, read through a lenient DTO that needs only `heroClass, options, presetSelections, automatic, legacyEdict`.
2. Refunded points: for v3/v4, `ClassSkillTree.Spent(old)`. For v≤2 or absent, `SkillProgression.Spent(skillRanks)` (`SkillProgression.cs:20`). Points after migration equal `level`; formula `Remaining = level - (Σrank + ΣmodifierRank + Σpassive)`.
3. Build N, a v5 loadout:
   - `ranks` is always the full 20 entries in spec order, all zero with `modifier=-1`. An empty list reads as an old save (`ClassSkills.cs:86`).
   - `actives=["","","",""]`, `ultimate=""`, `passives=["","",""]`.
   - `order=["BASIC"]`. `Canonical` forbids unequipped ids (`:124-125`), so a custom order is lost. The relative order of kept x01-x06 survives in `legacyEdict.skillOrder` (`:156`).
   - `automatic = old.automatic ∩ {"BASIC"}`.
   - `options`: drop the 25 groups on removed skills (M05, W07, W10-W16, A08-A13, A15, A16, M09, M10, M12-M16, `M13:goal`). `ClassSkillOptions.Validate` (`C/ClassSkillOptions.cs:48-53`) throws on unknown groups.
   - `presetSelections`: drop the 24 `skill/<removed>` scopes. Keep `order`, `basic/<class>` and `skill/<kept>`.
4. Edict documents (`hero.edict`, `N.legacyEdict`, each `edictPresets[i].loadout.edict`, `presets[i].classSkills.legacyEdict`):
   - Only M05 can differ. Set `slots` M05→"" and `survival.defenseSkill/fallbackSkill=="M05"`→"".
   - Leave inert M05 per-skill options, because `Canonical` needs all 7 ids.
5. Re-project the legacy build via the `StartNewHeroesWithoutSkills` call (`ApplyHuntEdict`, `GameStore.HuntEdict.cs:63-67`; `HuntEdictLoadout.ToBuild`, `:58-73`).
   - Result: `activeSkills=[]`, `passives=[]`, `skillRanks=BaseRanks()`, `edictPassiveSlots=["","",""]`, rules reduced to BASIC+loot/chest/explore.
   - Preserve `useEdict`, as `GameStore.SkillTree.cs:36-38` does.
6. Presets: apply step 3 to `hero.presets[i].classSkills` and `hero.edictPresets[i].loadout`, so they become policy-only. Set `loadout.passives=["","",""]`, `ranks=BaseRanks()`. Keep `name`, `equipmentIds`, `originalCode`, `legacyBuild`, `needsReview`.
7. Other hero containers:
   - `trainingGround.setup.excluded` (`C/TrainingGround.cs:22`): filter to kept ids.
   - `trainingGround.records[].previous/best.loadout` (`:33`): null it (`HasLoadout` at `:37` uses `Uses`).
   - `trainingComparison`: null it (stale baseline hero plus two builds).
   - `guide.equippedSkillHistory` (`C/FirstPlayGuide.cs:42`, used by F06 at `Tutorials.Progress.cs:15-17`): prune ids not in D4 data.
   - `classUltimateRemaining/Total`: unchanged (still within 45..60, `ClassSkillPersistence.cs:26`).
8. Account containers:
   - `guide.puzzle.levels[].kitHero` and `tutorialSlots[].puzzle` (`PuzzleTutorial.cs:30`, replay at `:225-226`): run steps 1-5 on the HeroSave copy, or null them.
   - `guide.tutorialRun`, `suspendedRun`, `repeatHunt.pendingResult`: see F1.
9. History is left untouched. `records[].journal.initialBuild/builds/initialEdict`, `review.finalBuild/finalEdict`, `review.dps.casts[].id` and `statistics.skills[].definitionId` are never canonicalized on load (`GameStore.cs:144-147`; `C/CombatJournalArchive.cs:36,54`). UI falls back to the raw id (`P/GameUI.History.cs:16`, `C/CombatJournal.cs:86`). Reused A06/M07 rows will show the new names.
10. Make the archive in Read before any write (`.schema{n}-before-d4-skill-tree.json`, guarded by `!File.Exists`). Set the notice or receipt. Let `Write` stamp 22. Throw only `NotSupportedException`.

**Idempotence**
- v5 heroes are skipped, and `Apply(Apply(x))` must be byte-equal. Compare `ResetAllocation(empty)` at `T/SkillTreeIntegrationTests.cs:200`.
- A mixed account (one hero deferred for a run) is legal, so `Read` must not treat schema≥22 with a v<5 hero as corrupt.
- Crash before `File.Replace` leaves the file unchanged with a stale `.tmp`. Crash after it leaves a file that is already v5.

**Load-time validation for v5.** Needed in `Validate`, presets, runs and codes:
- Exactly 10+10 entries in spec order.
- `rank<=maxRank` (5; ultimates 3).
- `modifier ∈ -1..2` (ultimates -1..1), with `modifier==-1` iff `modifierRank==0`.
- `modifierRank<=min(maxRank,rank)`.
- Passive rank>0 requires `unlockLevel<=level`, and at most one key passive has points.
- `Spent<=level`.
- Tier gates via `SkillTreeD4Rules.Valid` (`D/golden/csharp/SkillTreeD4.Rules.cs:46-50`).
- Equipped skills have rank>0, and slot 4 holds an ultimate.
- `level<=60`.
